title.ja: 俺が愛したミステリー

summary.en: While lounging at a bookstore, Kogoro and Conan hear police sirens nearby. They spot Inspector Megure and Officer Takagi in a passing police car, hop in, and join them on their way to the crime scene. They arrive at an apartment building to investigate a murder. The victim is Murako Saikawa (65), a once-famous mystery novelist who lived alone, whom Conan (as Shinichi Kudo) recognizes for her masterpiece novel, The Village of Orochi. She was killed by a blow to the back of the head with a bronze figurine, with the estimated time of death between 7:00 PM and 9:00 PM the previous night, though the exact details are pending the autopsy. Location: Saikawa's apartment Victim: Murako Saikawa Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Shunichi Tono and Keizo Murata The two suspects are the first discoverers: Shunichi Tono, her editor at Mystery Publishing, and Keizo Murata, the building manager. Tono claims he visited Saikawa for a meeting from 6:30 PM to 8:00 PM the night before to make arrangements, and returned that morning to deliver some documents she had requested. He revealed that since the novelist was not answering the doorbell, he called the building manager to get the keys, and together they found her dead. Conan subtly notes to Kogoro that his detective intuition was spot on to feel something was wrong—most people wouldn't jump to calling the manager right off the bat just because a doorbell went unanswered. Prompted by this, Tono reveals a postcard containing a death threat the novelist received a few days prior. Kogoro reads the message aloud: "Dear Saikawa Murako-sensei, I'm thinking of adding your life to my collection next. I will go to visit you in the near future to take your life." Kogoro misreads the sender's signature as "Taniyoshi Ohebi," but Tono quickly corrects him, clarifying it is "Ryo Orochiya," the genius criminal from her most famous novel. Kogoro deduces that the killer used a fictional character's name to deliberately complicate the investigation, while Conan silently wonders if the culprit is staging this on purpose. To get properly set up, Inspector Megure asks Murata if he could lend them a vacant room to use as a stronghold for the investigation. Megure then asks Tono to spare a little more of his time, noting that the editor is likely the last person who met the victim. Kogoro points out that the killer must have locked the door when escaping the previous night in order to delay the discovery of the body. Since Saikawa's door was locked and both her keys were inside, the killer had to have used a spare key, which both Tono and Murata could access. Inspector Megure notes that while apartment residents are given two keys, both of Saikawa's keys were found inside her room. Officer Takagi concludes that the number of people who could use a spare key is limited. Megure points out that Tono could have made a spare key if he waited for the chance to do so. Regarding the building manager, Megure receives a call and reports that Kawanaka-kun, who was asking questions in the neighborhood looking for a lead, found someone who heard the victim and the manager having a heated argument several days ago (due to Saikawa catching him drinking on the job). Hearing these developments, Kogoro confidently states that the suspects have already been narrowed down. While investigating the room, Conan spots a small, green plastic sushi leaf ornament hidden on the floor behind a cabinet. He also notices fresh marinated ginger slices (gari) resting in the sink's corner strainer. Kogoro observes the ginger as well, the editor pointed out that Saikawa-sensei actually hated fresh marinated ginger. He explained that she disliked its sweet and sour taste. Tono suggests that since she had specifically asked him to order the sushi delivery for her the night before, she likely just threw the ginger away in the sink without eating it. Meanwhile, Conan mentally reviews the suspect list. He notes that Tono was present at the apartment around the time the murder was committed, while Murata, the building manager, clearly had a motive. He also realizes that both of these men were in a position to easily obtain a spare key to the room if they wanted one. Looking at a suspicious wire or string left on the floor, the police began to formulate a theory: the culprit may have snuck back into the room while pretending to be the first to discover the body. This would have given them the perfect opportunity to retrieve and get rid of any incriminating evidence they had left behind the day before. Once Officer Chiba told the inspector that the room was ready, the police began asking the two suspects about what happened last night. As Conan heads to the spare room, however, he remains bothered by the marinated ginger. Something about the claim that Saikawa had simply thrown it away the previous night doesn't sit right with him. As the police and Kogoro reviewed the events surrounding the murder, they established that Saikawa had been killed sometime between 7:00 PM and 9:00 PM the previous night. Tono explained that he had arrived at Saikawa's apartment at 6:30 PM. Although Saikawa had stopped writing, Tono believed she had produced enough masterpieces to warrant a compilation of her work. The two spent about an hour discussing the project. Tono had also ordered a Prime Sushi platter for her that evening. The sushi arrived at around 8:00 PM, but Tono claimed that he had to stop somewhere else after placing the order, so he left once the delivery arrived. He told Saikawa that he would bring the necessary documents the following morning. At around 8:15 PM, Tono joined his friends at a pub in front of the station and remained there until midnight. Once his friends confirmed his whereabouts, Tono had a solid alibi for the latter part of the estimated time of death. He admitted that he knew the police suspected him, but insisted that he could never have harmed Saikawa, whom he regarded as "Japan's jewel of mystery." Murata, meanwhile, denied having a heated argument with Saikawa several days earlier. He claimed that the witnesses had simply misunderstood what they saw. When questioned about the night of the murder, Murata said he had remained inside the building manager's office. However, because he had been alone, nobody could verify his alibi. This made Kogoro suspect that the manager might be hiding something. Takagi pointed out that 8:00 PM was the crucial point in the investigation. If Saikawa had been killed sometime between 7:00 and 8:00 PM, Tono could still be the culprit. However, if the murder occurred after 8:00 PM, Murata would also have to be considered a serious suspect. Megure therefore ordered the officers to split up and verify both men's alibis. Takagi, accompanied by Kogoro and Conan, went to Takarazushi to confirm Tono's account of the sushi delivery. The shop owner revealed an important detail: his Prime Sushi platter normally did not include squid or octopus. He only added them when Saikawa herself placed the order because she particularly liked both. However, on the previous night's order, he had accidentally forgotten to add them. He considered the mistake particularly embarrassing because it had happened on what might have been Saikawa's final order. When Takagi asked about the delivery time, the owner confirmed that the sushi had arrived at Saikawa's apartment at approximately 8:00 PM. More importantly, he had neither seen Saikawa nor heard her voice when he made the delivery. This led Megure to consider the possibility that Saikawa was already dead—or at least no longer in the apartment—when the sushi arrived. Before the investigation could proceed further, the editor-in-chief of Mystery Publishing arrived and introduced himself, handing Takagi his contact card. He immediately asked whether the police were treating Tono as a suspect. The editor-in-chief defended Tono, explaining that Saikawa was the reason Tono had become an editor in the first place. Tono had been a devoted fan of her work and was the one who pushed for the compilation of her novels. He confirmed that Tono had been working on plans to publish a collection of Saikawa's stories, despite the novelist having become largely forgotten by the public. When Takagi admitted that he had never heard of Murako Saikawa before this case, the editor-in-chief explained that her declining popularity was precisely why her work had been overlooked. Tono, however, continued to admire her writing and had personally insisted that her stories deserved to be published again. Despite the financial risk to the publishing company, the staff eventually agreed to Tono's proposal. The editor-in-chief explained that Tono's determination had convinced them that he genuinely wanted to make Saikawa happy one last time and was willing to put his heart and soul into preserving her work. Tono then revealed another important detail: Saikawa had been diagnosed with a terminal illness and had only about six months left to live. His revelation further strengthened the impression that Tono had no reason to kill her, as he appeared to be the person most devastated by her death and had been working so hard to fulfill what could have been her final wish. Just as the police were preparing to let Tono leave, Megure received a call informing him that the autopsy report was ready. The examination revealed rice grains and pieces of raw seafood in Saikawa's stomach, indicating that she had eaten sushi roughly an hour before her death. Based on the estimated digestion time, the police concluded that Saikawa had most likely been killed around 9:00 PM. This effectively confirmed Tono's alibi, since his friends had verified that he was already at the pub by 8:15 PM and remained there until midnight. The police apologized for treating him as a suspect, and Tono prepared to leave. Conan, however, remained uneasy. Although Tono's alibi appeared solid, he could not shake the feeling that something about the case still did not add up. Then another development emerged. Through Officer Chiba, the police received confirmation from a delivery employee that Murata's whereabouts around 9:00 PM could also be accounted for. The courier explained that he had been making a scheduled delivery to the building that evening. As he approached the building at around 9:00 PM, he saw Murata outside, apparently drunk, repeatedly ringing Saikawa's doorbell. Murata admitted that Saikawa had previously caught him drinking alcohol while on duty and had warned him that she would report him to the maintenance company. Fearing that he would lose his job, Murata said he had gone to Saikawa's apartment that night to beg her not to report him. However, despite ringing the doorbell several times, she never answered. Murata then asked the police whether they were still going to suspect him, insisting that if they did, they should at least show him some actual evidence. Because of the strong smell of alcohol coming from Murata, Takagi opened a window to air out the room. A sudden gust of wind sent the newly arrived autopsy report flying toward Conan, who managed to catch it and quickly glanced over its contents. The report listed the food found in Saikawa's stomach: rice grains, tuna, octopus, squid, egg, and other sushi ingredients. Conan smirked. He has realized what trick did the culprit used.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 園子の赤いハンカチ（前編）

summary.en: Sonoko brought Ran, who brought Conan, to visit the site in the country used as location in filming of a well-received romantic TV series, where the lead actor, who stars as a soldier, tied a red handkerchief to a tree branch to enable his lover to find him. The success of the serial went beyond expectation and the sleep rural area became a popular spot where female visitors tied red handkerchieves all over the woods, spoiling Sonoko's scheme to lure Makoto for a romantic rendezvous. They encountered a man who claimed to be part of the TV serial crew. He explains that he was the one who gave the scriptwriter the idea of the red handkerchief tied to a tree in these mountains, because he had spotted one when he was searching for a place to film. Because of the series' popularity, he had been tasked to answer fan requests. Today he had been commissioned by a fan to find the exact location of the tree with the original red handkerchief, that inspired the show. He asked Ran and Sonoko to leave a message for the fan in a guestbook at an inn, where the fan is staying. He tells them to sign the message 'Hozumi' in katakana. Ran and Sonoko agrees and leaves the message. Shortly afterwards, Hozumi was discovered, stabbed dead, at the spot.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 園子の赤いハンカチ（後編）

summary.en: Detective Yamamura shows up leading the investigation. The murder investigation narrowed to three suspects who had arrived recently at the nearby inn, based on that Hozumi had told Ran and Sonoko that the 'fan' he was meeting had checked into the inn in that day. Then they learn from the TV-station that they couldn't find 'Hozumi' on the list of employees who worked on the TV-Show. Conan realize something and run up to the mountains and digs in the ground only to find a skull. He calls Ran and Sonoko to tell them, that they should go home and make Sonoko reveal the location of the tree where Conan searched for her handkerchief for the suspects to hear. He tells them that he will go home with professor Agasa, so they don't have to worry for him. Ran, concerned for Conan getting himself into dangerous situations, calls Professor Agasa, who is on his way to pick up Conan, and tricks him into revealing the meeting place.

title.ja: 1 年 B 組大作戦

summary.en: The teacher of the Detective Boys decides to give the class a mental test. Conan is called by the teacher so the class must solve it without him. They solve it with the help of two silent out-casted students. It turns out it was a plan to include the new students so they feel more involved. The code contains numbers were assigned to members of the class: Mitsuhiko got the 1, Ayumi the 2, Conan the 3, Maria Higashio the 4, Genta the 5, Takuma Sakamoto the 6. Genta's number was the only one to be red. The students then found a paper with dice numbers, in the order 3-1-6-2-4-5, the 1 being the only red. As Conan was called out, Haibara had to play Conan's role to make the students work together to solve the code and called his name whenever Conan's name is mentioned in the solving process.

title.ja: 消えた 1 ページ

summary.en: The Detective Boys are doing a book report when Ayumi notices that the last page to her book, Alec's Adventure, has been torn off. Conan and Ayumi decide to search for Tsukasa Naito, the one who borrowed out the book last. The Detective Boys later discover that a valuable stone, the Sairai Seki (再来石, lit. "Return Stone") was stolen. Conan realizes that Tsukasa must have stolen the stone believing it is the same stone from Alec's Adventure, Futabi no Ishi (再びの石, lit. "Again Stone"), due to the same kanji and wants to use it to regain a lost object. The Detective Boys' investigate Tsukasa's house and discover a piece of the torn page confirming Conan's suspicions.

title.ja: 黒の組織の影 幼い目撃者
title.zhHans: 黑衣组织之影 年幼的目击者
title.zhHant: 黑衣組織之影 小小目擊者
title.en: The Shadow of the Black Organization (The Young Witness)
title.enRaw: *The Shadow of the Black Organization* (The Young Witness)

summary.en: The Young Witness (462) A rockstar named Roku Itagaki has been missing for the past few days. A young boy named Takumi Hashiratani claims that on New Year's Day, he witnessed a man carrying Itagaki in a bag and throwing him over a bridge. Takumi claims that the man had a dark car, a nail on arm, and that he saw a giant glowing hammer in the background. Kogoro is skeptical at first but realizes Takumi is telling the truth when the news confirms that the body of Itagaki was found in a bag floating in a river. Location: Teimuzu river Victim: Roku Itagaki Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Kiritani, Yasui, and Kannai The news report look near by river is a deadbody in a bag floating. From Takumi's testimony, Kogoro, Ran, Conan, and Eisuke search for the bridge where the body was thrown over. The Strange Illumination (463) While investigating, they learn that Itagaki's band logo was of a snake with nails piercing through it. After questioning a tattooist, they learn that the tattoo was new and only three people have gotten it. After further investigation, they are able to deduce the tattoo is on the driver's right arm due to the traffic flow on the bridge and that the only way Takumi could have seen his arm is if the steering wheel was on the right side of the car. They realize that advertisement combined with lights from a building created the silhouette of an upside down hammer; Using this knowledge, they are able to pinpoint where the culprit threw the body off from the bridge.
summary.zhHans: 黑衣组织之影系列以多组目击和线索展开组织相关调查，连接后续红与黑的碰撞线。

title.ja: 割れない雪だるま（前編）

summary.en: The Detective Boys are at a small ski resort. Conan had told Haibara and the professor about the case, Touji who witness Kir's accident and that Vermouth learn about it. It turns out that the man, who was hired by the murderer for the strange garbage job was a big fan of Mizunashi Rena and ran a homepage about her. On it he had written about meeting Touji who talked about the accident after seeing the man's stadium jumper with Kir's picture on it. Both Vermouth and Eisuke Hondou have read the web journal and seek out to meet the boy and question him about the accident. So now both Hondou and the organization knows that Kir has been injured and is probably in a hospital. The detective boys meet up with four university students who are building a snowman for an art project. Later that evening, Sakuko Kokura, one of the university students, becomes lost in the blizzard and the two groups begin their search for her. Conan finds Kokura dead at the bottom of a cliff in a lake. The police declare that Kokura's death was a snowboarding accident. However, Conan notices that the body is missing a hat, goggles, and gloves and believes that she was murdered and that one of the university students is the culprit.

title.ja: 割れない雪だるま（後編）

summary.en: Genta trips and falls into the snow and comments how it was hard and salty. Conan realizes how the murder was done and gathers the suspects along with Inspector Misao Yamamura.

title.ja: 池のほとりの怪事件

summary.en: After hearing about a burglary case from Detective Takagi and Detective Horita, the Detective Boys head to a pond to witness animal control officers attempting to capture an alligator snapping turtle that was abandoned by its owner. As the group discovers the real owner of the snapping turtle, Izumi Kimata, they are surprised to find a man named Jiro Nihonmatsu claiming that it's his turtle. Nihonmatsu says he wants to raise the turtle to make up for mistreating his own pet, a green turtle, when he was younger, so Kimata agrees to allow him to raise it. When the animal control officers discover that there's four snapping turtles altogether Nihonmatsu decides to raise all four and makes some unusual statements about turtles causing Conan to become suspicious of him.

title.ja: 怪盗キッドと四名画（前編）
title.zhHans: 怪盗基德与四幅名画（前篇）
title.zhHant: 怪盜基德與四幅名畫（上集）
title.en: Kaitou Kid and the Four Masterpieces (Part 1)

summary.en: Takeyori Oikawa claims that Kaitou Kid is targeting his painting which is to be unveiled to the world live that day. The painting is the final piece of a set of four. Advanced Notice:Tomorrow at 20:00, I'll come to collect my beloved "Seiran," from the cover of a full moon's glow. He hires Kogoro to protect the painting from Kid. They place the painting in a secluded room with guards at the door and outside the window. When a blackout occurs, the painting is stolen and Oikawa's father, who was in the room, is murdered. While the police speculate how the murder was done and whether Kid is the culprit, Oikawa receives a letter from Kid which claims he will steal the truth of him. Oikawa disfigures the letter to incriminate Kid for the murder and hands it to Conan, who had suspected Oikawa murdered his father is now certain he is the culprit.

summary.en: Kogoro takes Ran and Conan to an onsen in a rental car after being given a special deal. Kogoro then receives a call from Inspector Megure who reveals that a bomber called the police station to tell them a bomb was placed on Kogoro's car and will detonate when his speed goes below 20 km/h. Kogoro concludes the man who gave him the deal is the bomber. Attempted Car Bombing Victims: Kogoro Mouri, Ran Mouri, and Conan Edogawa Suspects: Unknown bomber

title.ja: 工藤新一少年の冒険（前編）
title.zhHans: 少年工藤新一的冒险（前篇）
title.zhHant: 工藤新一少年冒險（上集）

summary.en: Conan's class finds an oxhide wallet containing a message from Ran, who left it ten years ago. Conan shares the story of how it got there. Ten years ago, Shinichi and Ran enter the school at night to investigate the rumors of a ghost. They run into a mysterious man who claims to be Shinichi's younger brother and who challenges them to a treasure hunt; He then leaves them the wallet with a note containing the message "Quell the anger of Haido" in Japanese and a hint that he likes red things. "Quell the anger" is a pun of "drop the anchor" so the riddle refers to Haido Port. With Agasa, the pair finds another riddle hidden on a red fire hydrant which says "Clear the allegations against Toriya and demolish the liver of Goroukou" in Japanese. Conan reveals that clearing the allegation is to prove innocent, which is "white" (白 ,shiro) in police slang, which is a pun of castle (城 ,shiro), so the hint means Toriya Castle. Goroukou is a reference to Mito Kōmon (水戸黄門 ). Destroying the liver means destroying the middle, so removing the middle kanji of Mito Kōmon yields suimon (水門 , lit. flood gates). They find the next clue near a railroad crossing with red lights by the floodgates of Toriya Castle: "Erase the evidence of Okuho. With a raspy voice, endure loneliness."
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 工藤新一少年の冒険（後編）
title.zhHans: 少年工藤新一的冒险（后篇）
title.zhHant: 工藤新一少年冒險（下集）

summary.en: "Erase the evidence" means a cancellation postal mark so they head to the Okuho post office but couldn't find anything. Shinichi then solves the rest of the riddle and heads to the school and finds the next riddle on a stop sign. The letter contains kanji, some of which are also mahjong jargon, and decodes to mean Beika City Hall. Once there, Shinichi finds the last riddle on a flag pole with the Japanese flag: "S → W". Shinichi presumes it means the sunset and assumes his father created the riddle for his entertainment, with the cooperation from the mysterious man. Shinichi and Ran waited for the mysterious man to show up but never met him again. Back in present time, Kobayashi and the Detective Boys remarked that the last clue was really disappointing and seemed redundant: it was just a simple "S → W" message, and to point to the sunset, it sufficed to use "W" alone. Conan suddenly realized his deduction years ago was wrong.

title.en: The Love of Lawyer Eri Kisaki
title.enRaw: The Love of Lawyer Eri Kisaki

summary.en: Eri Kisaki is visited by Ran and Conan who came to remind her it is the anniversary of her first date with Kogoro. Eri leaves to meet someone at a café after a phone call. Shortly after Eri's cat, Goro, knocks down a vase where Ran finds a picture of a man and her mother's wedding ring. They notice the number on the back of the picture matches the number of the caller causing Ran to believe that her mother is having an affair and thus follows her to the café. Once there, Ran hears the man speak with a woman in a baby talk tone. Eri tearfully tells the man she "could not stop the trembling" and the man replies "it is just a dream".

title.ja: 悪運グランプリ

summary.en: Kogoro takes Conan out to look for a Korean restaurant in the city and witnesses a hit and run resulting in two pedestrians being injured. A witness reveals he saw the car waiting for those two before speeding into their direction and Conan concludes it was an attempted murder. Location: Rice Flower Park Victim: Shinzaburo Tatematsu and Kiyotaka Okonogi Age: 25 years old (Tatematsu) and 65 years old (Okonogi) Suspects: Kazuma Sakaki and Tomomi Ichikura The pedestrian Kiyotaka Okonogi is a wealthy man and his nephew, Kazuma Sakaki, is the prime suspect since Sakaki would be the one to inherit Okonogi's fortune. Sakaki's fiancée, Tomomi Ichikura, has an alibi since she sent a text to Sakiki about a bombing incident at a shopping mall which occurred during the time of the attack. The other pedestrian, Shinzaburo Tatematsu, reveals that the driver was the same culprit who stole his groceries and threatened to kill him. Disproving their theory Okonogi was the targeted victim.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 元太の必殺シュート（前編）

summary.en: Agasa takes the Detective Boys to a cheesecake bakery. Genta however decides to remain in the underground parking lot and continues to kick a soccer ball against a wall. When Genta hears a strange sound, he misses his kick and subsequently losses balance and falls on his head causing him to lose consciousness. When he awakens, he searches for the soccer ball only to find a German named Ludger Heinen with a severe head injury. The Detective Boys arrive upon hearing Genta's scream. Ludger points at Genta and says criminal and "El" before losing consciousness. The police arrive and reveal that the culprit was searching for money. Conan reveals that there were only three people in the parking lot during the time the attack occurred.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

summary.en: The police gather the three suspects together.

title.ja: リアル 30 ミニッツ

summary.en: Conan and Ran accompany Kogoro into a shopping mall, where he has arranged a dinner reservation at a restaurant. Since the reservation is set for 8 pm, however, Conan and Ran have half an hour to kill, so they split up to look around their favorite merchandise. An unpopular mall visitor is stabbed, though he is still alive. Location: Beika Broad Mall 2F Victim: Yukio Nishiyama Injury: Stab wound on the back Suspects: Shiori Yamaguchi, Hideki Koide, and Kaoruko Mizuno Strangely, the police arrives quite early, since a call has been made to them at exactly 7:30, just a few minutes before the deed was committed. Conan meets Haibara, who has been browsing a nearby bookshop, and they investigate the case together.

title.ja: 服部平次との 3 日間（2 時間スペシャル）
title.zhHant: 與服部平次共度的 3 天 （2 小時特別篇）
title.enRaw: *Three Days with Heiji Hattori* (2 Hour Special)

summary.en: The next day, Heiji takes Conan with him to participate in a reality television deduction competition between high school detectives Heiji Hattori, Natsuki Koshimizu, Junya Tokitsu, and Saguru Hakuba. While there, they are being tested, but Tokitsu declares that he has solved the mystery and decides to test his theory out. He says that it would take around 30 minutes. While the rest wait, they have dinner. During that they discuss the purpose of the lavender in the house, and Natsuki mentions that it reminds her of a murder mystery that took place around a year ago. Location: Cliff in Shikoku Victim: Kana Mizuguchi Cause of death: Free falling Kana Mizuguchi was accused of murdering her mistress and as a result she decided to kill herself by jumping off a cliff. Location: Lavender Mansion in Shikoku Victim: The Mansion's mistress Cause of death: Hanging Suspects: Kana Mizuguchi The mistress of the mansion was found hanged. At first, there was no sign of foul play, so the police believed it was suicide, but half a year later the case was reopened because new evidence suggested it was murder. But the suspect killed herself before she was charged. Victim: Hiroo Tsuchio Tsuchio is rendered unconcious with chloroform and bound in a locked room. This was a staged mystery for the detectives to solve. Tokitsu is murdered and the detectives realize the television programming was a hoax. Victim: Junya Tokitsu Cause of death: Blow to the head Suspects: Hiroo Tsuchio, Renzo Koya, and Natsuki Koshimizu
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 黄色い不在証明

summary.en: A hostess named Hiroko Inoue is found dead in her home by Osamu Kizuka, a colleague of Inoue's to be husband Akira Takaoka. Location: Inoue household Victim: Hiroko Inoue Cause of death: Strangulation Suspects: Akira Takaoka and Osamu Kizuka Kizuka had a planned meeting with Takaoka on that day and was the reason he found the body. As Kogoro and Conan investigate, the police conclude it to be a random burglary after Takaoka's alibi proves he was at Fukushima Prefecture during the time of Inoue's death.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 山姥の刃物（前編）

summary.en: Agasa takes the Detective Boys camping, they end up being stranded in the middle of the woods. They decide to ask for lodgings from a house owned by an elderly woman named Iwae Tanaka. At the same time, Akane Ooba and her two hosts, Raito Adachi and Fuuga Kahara, also request for lodging and Tanaka complies. That night, Mitsuhiko goes to the restroom but see's something horrifying causing him to run back to his room. Soon after they hear a woman scream and Ooba is later found with her throat slit open outside the house with Raito by her side. The police arrive and investigate all the bladed weapons in the house. Mitsuhiko then exclaims that while heading back from the restroom, the knife he saw Tanaka sharpening is missing.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 山姥の刃物（後編）

summary.en: Tanaka dismisses Mitsuhiko's accusation as his imagination and the police continue their investigation. Agasa notes that his hammer is missing and Conan discovers an officer found the hammer in the woods. Conan later finds the rumored knife with the red handle and shows it to the police. None of the weapons reacted to luminol and leaves the officers stumped.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 消えたお巡りさん

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys run into Ayumi's neighbor, Yasuyo Akimoto, who is searching for a kind bearded policemen, who she ran into multiple times last week. At the police station, they reveal they do not have an officer like that and it was against police regulation to have facial hair. The police assume that the officer was linked to a serial burglary, however Akimoto and an elderly couple disagree claiming the officer was too kind and gentle to be the burglar.

title.ja: 黒い写真の行方（前編）

summary.en: Heiji tells Conan he found someone that has knowledge on Eisuke's father; However that person is dead but his grandson, Sohei Nishigun, has a photograph of Eisuke's father. Conan, Haibara, and Agasa travel to Nishigun's apartment and realize that someone has stolen Nishigun's photograph album and deleted the data off his computer. Conan notices that the room contains perspiration from the culprit meaning the robbery occurred very recently. Conan concludes that one of Nishigun's three friends is the culprit as they are the only people with keys to his apartment.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 黒い写真の行方（後編）

summary.en: Nishigun phones all three of his friends to ask what they were doing during the time of the robbery.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 右から左へ招き猫
title.en: Beckoning Cat from Right to Left
title.enRaw: Beckoning Cat from Right to Left

summary.en: Conan and Haibara rescue a kitten from a tree and return him to his owner, Tamotsu Ishigami, the owner of a local café. A woman barges into the café exclaiming she found her boss, Kenzo Kanemaru, dead. Location: Office Kanemaru, Living Room Victim: Kenzo Kanemaru Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Tamotsu Ishigami, Fumie Imaoka, and Chika Murai After Conan and Haibara save the kitten of Tamotsu Ishigami, they go to his shop, Fumie Imaoka, a janitor finds Kenzo Kanemaru dead on his office's living room. Conan, Haibara, Kogoro, and Ishigami enter the office to confirm the Kanemaru's death. The authorities arrive. Conan notices that someone used the vacuum and threw away its contents and also finds the paw of a broken maneki neko.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 本庁の刑事恋物語 8 左手の薬指（1 時間スペシャル）
title.zhHans: 本厅刑警恋爱物语8 左手的无名指
title.zhHant: 總局刑警戀愛物語 8 左手的無名指 （1 小時特別篇）
title.en: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 8: The Left Hand's Ring Finger
title.enRaw: *Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 8: The Left Hand's Ring Finger* (1 Hour Special)

summary.en: Sato is the talk of the police department after she is spotted wearing a new ring on her left-hand's ring finger. The other officers jealously corner Takagi thinking he got engaged to Sato and had been hiding it. Much to everyone's shock, Takagi did not give Sato the ring, which leads to even more speculation. Takagi is depressed and want to know who captured Sato's heart, but he isn't able to successfully ask her. Meanwhile, Kogoro is invited to attend an interview of the mystery book writer Masataka Moroguchi. Masataka Moroguchi recently acquired a gaudy diamond ring embedded with dozens and dozens of small diamonds. The next day, Moroguchi is found dead from consumption of poison and his ring is gone. The locked room was inaccessible to an outsider except for a small window. The only key was in Masataka's palm. The room was locked and the key was in Masataka's upward facing, open palm. The only opening to the room is a small window that a child would have trouble squeezing through. The body was on the opposite side of the room, quite a distance from the window. Sato and Takagi are called to the scene. Despite these circumstances, the two officers and Conan believe Masataka was murdered by one of his three interviewers.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: テレビ局の悪魔（1 時間スペシャル）
title.zhHant: 電視台的惡魔 （1 小時特別篇）
title.en: The Devil of the TV Station
title.enRaw: *The Devil of the TV Station* (1 Hour Special)

summary.en: Yoko takes the Detective Boys and Professor Agasa to a TV studio for a tour, though they're a bit disappointed when they can't go to the Kamen Yaiba studio. When they run into Satan Onizuka, the vocalist for a visual kei rock band who's there for a TV show, they're scared at first and pass him up. However, they decide to search for his room to get his autograph anyway since Mitsuhiko recalls that his older sister Asami is a huge fangirl of Satan's band. In his room, Satan speaks to his manager and asks him for some food from three specific restaurants and a mirror to replace the broken one in the room itself. They also talk about a huge fight between Satan and the president of his production company, Tenji Urushihara, and Satan says he'll need the mirror soon to take off his make up, since he needs to catch a nap due to his lack of sleep after the scuffle. In the meantime, the children and Professor Agasa look for Satan's dressing room. A little later, a Satan without make-up and with a raincoat over his clothes meets with Urushihara and, after a chat, stabs him to death with a knife. Location: Nichiuri TV Victim: Tenji Urushihara Cause of death: Stab wound Culprit: Satan Onizuka Few later, the Detective Boys find Satan Onizuka's room and meet Satan who is somehow back in full make up, who forgives them for the impasse and gives them an autograph. Ayumi notes some origami birds on Satan's table and is delighted, with Satan even teasing the kids a little about it. Soon after, however, Urushihara's corpse is found by an employee and the police arrive at the station. The police suspect the murderer to be Satan, due to his recent fight with the victim. Satan retorts that, with his make up and costume, it would have been impossible to leave his room without being noticed. Since there is still no mirror in Satan's dressing room, it would be impossible to put on his make up and they cannot charge him with the murder. Conan still suspects Satan as the murderer, and he decides to find out how did he pull such a difficult trick.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 法廷の対決 III 目撃者は検察官（1 時間スペシャル）
title.zhHans: 法庭的对决Ⅲ 目击者是检察官
title.zhHant: 法庭的對決 Ⅲ 檢察官是目擊者 （1 小時特別篇）
title.en: Courtroom Confrontation III: Prosecutor as Eyewitness
title.enRaw: *Courtroom Confrontation III: Prosecutor as Eyewitness* (1 Hour Special)

summary.en: Eri Kisaki is asked to defend Hiroaki Takeuchi who had been accused of hit-and-run incident. However, the evidence suggests it was his wife, Mariko Takeuchi, who has committed the crime. Hiroaki calls Reiko Kujo and tells her to meet him and he will tell her the truth. Reiko, accompanied by Mariko, visits Hiroaki and sees him fall off his balcony to his death. Believing her questioning motivated his suicide, Reiko quits her job as a prosecutor.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 服部平次 VS 工藤新一 ゲレンデの推理対決！（1 時間スペシャル）
title.zhHans: 服部平次VS工藤新一 滑雪场的推理对决！
title.zhHant: 服部平次 VS 工藤新一 滑雪場的推理對決
title.en: Heiji Hattori vs. Shinichi Kudo: Deduction Battle on the Ski Slope!
title.enRaw: *Heiji Hattori vs. Shinichi Kudo: Deduction Battle on the Ski Slope!* (1 Hour Special)

summary.en: Heiji tells Conan that he met a better detective than Conan during middle school and reminisces about the case three years ago. At Yamagata Zao Onsen Ski Resort, an actor named Shohei Minowa is murdered in the same fashion as his old stunt performer, Jiro Mizugami, who was murdered four years ago at the same resort. Minowa is killed while on a ski lift and the gun is placed in his hand suggesting suicide. Minowa's bag is filled with snow to suggest that a Yuki-onna murdered him.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

title.ja: 赤と黒のクラッシュ 発端
title.zhHans: 红与黑的碰撞 开端
title.en: Clash of Red and Black (The Beginning)

summary.en: Blood Relative (Manga: 586-590, Anime: 492) Anno confirms that the picture is indeed Rena and shows them a news recording depicting Rena with the same hairstyle as Eisuke's sister's in the photograph. In the video, they learn that Rena's blood type is AB. Eisuke denies that Rena is his sister since his sister's blood was once used for his blood transfusion; Eisuke has blood type O, meaning he can only receive Type O blood. Conan suspects there is a hidden component to Eisuke's story and believes Eisuke is searching for Rena with an ulterior motive. Conan calls Jodie to warn her about Eisuke and learns that Rena's blood type indeed is AB. But Agasa brings out a point that since Eisuke was a child when he got the blood transfusion, he might have misunderstood the situation. Conan agrees that he has to have it confirmed that Eisuke's sister really did donated blood and also what Eisuke's blood type is, before he can do anything. The next day, Eisuke invites Ran and Sonoko to accompany him to the mansion he used to live in to collect his mother's belongings which were recently found. Kogoro, coincidentally, was also hired to investigate a murder at the mansion that occurred a year ago. Once there, Eisuke finds his birth certificate, confirming that he has blood type O. Meanwhile, Kogoro is with the owner of the mansion, Kakuzo Okudaira, discussing the murder of his son, Tango Okudaira. Kakuzo tells Kogoro he suspects the murderer is one of three people in the mansion. Location: Okudaira mansion study, Tokyo Victim: Kakuzo Okudaira Cause of death: Hanging Suspects: Eiko Okudaira, Kikuyo Tabata, and Hataro Segawa While Kakuzo Okudaira was in his study alone, there was a loud crash. As Kikuyo Tabata and Hataro Segawa rushed to investigate, Kakuzo Okudaira shouted "Don't open!" as they began to open the door. When Conan and Kogoro arrived seconds later, Kakuzo Okudaira was found dead, still swinging. The fragments of Kakuzo's treasured vase were found below the body along with many books, one of which was stained in an unusual pattern with blood. A trolley with a small stack of books was nearby. Location: Okudaira mansion pool, Tokyo Victim: Tango Okudaira Cause of death: Drowning Suspects: Eiko Okudaira, Kikuyo Tabata, and Hataro Segawa On the one year anniversary of Tango's murder, Kogoro was hired by Kakuzo Okudaira to re-investigate the case because he believes the murderer is one of the members of the household. Tango was found drowned in the pool with his hands and legs bound, and mouth taped. The right glove of the deceased butler was on his left hand. At the estimated time of death everyone was inside watching a film. Three days later, the left hand glove of the deceased butler was found in Kakuzo Okudaira's room which he interpreted as a threat. Victim: Hataro Segawa's older brother Cause of death: Falling of a cliff in a car Exclamation (Manga: 587-590, Anime: 493) Kakuzo shows Kogoro a photograph of Tango's body in a pool and points to a white glove Tango is wearing. He reveals that the glove was the same glove their previous butler wore before a car accident killed him, and that Tango's murder occurred on the anniversary of the butler's death. Kakuzo tells Kogoro that, three days after Tango's death, he received a white glove and now presumes the murderer plans to kill him next. After the discussion, Kogoro and Conan investigate the house searching for clues. When a blackout occurs and the sound of a vase is heard from Kakuzo's room, they arrive to find him hanged. Conan investigates and realizes three suspicious points: glue was used to keep the knot of the rope together, the broken vase with sweat near the top, and a book titled "Killer of Hades" (in kanji) with blood on it. The police declare that if the book is a dying message, the murderer must be one of the three suspects. Hades (Manga: 587-590, Anime: 494) Conan's investigation leads him to realize how Kakuzo and Tango's murder was accomplished.
summary.zhHans: 红与黑的碰撞篇章对应 EP.491—504，围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI与黑衣组织的情报战展开；页面同时将其拆分为 The Beginning、Deceased Mother's Memento、Fake Patient、Last Resort、Thirteenth 等子段。

summary.en: Eri Kisaki is getting her hair done by her barber, Minayo Hasaka, prior to having dinner with Kogoro, Ran, and Conan that evening. Kogoro, who was on his way to pick up Eri, finds a dead body at a garbage collection point. The police arrive and Conan reveals that the victim, Shiro Nagasaku, was killed while receiving a hair cut as evidenced by the hair particles found mixed in his blood. Kogoro suspects Hasaka to be the murderer but Eri counters his accusations stating Hasaka only left her sights for a ten minute period during which Hasaka left to throw away the trash at a local convenience store. Eri states that it would be impossible for Hasaka to carry a body to the bottom of a hill during that time period. During the investigation of Hasaka's salon, Conan notices that the back alley of Hasaka's salon is directly above the garbage collection point and the convenience store is in the opposite direction.

summary.en: Eisuke returns to school and Ran and Sonoko take him to karaoke to celebrate his return. Conan notices that there is a strange man following them and presumes he is an FBI agent sent to keep an eye on Eisuke. While there, Eisuke disappears to the bathroom for a suspiciously long time, and returns with a horrified expression. Shortly after the strange man is found dead from repeated beatings to the head with a blunt weapon. Eisuke Hondou is scared by seeing Tatsumi dead in the karoke box. He is the first discoverer and alerts the others. Conan suspects Eisuke to be the murderer due to his strange behavior after returning from the bathroom. However, Eisuke explains that the reason he was so horrified was that while he was heading back to their karaoke room, he stumbled into the wrong room and found two men kissing. The other man whom he saw kissing is revealed to be a woman who looks masculine since she is a body builder. The woman gets mad over the mistake, while Arimoto seems more understanding over that someone could mistake her for a man. The police decide to interrogate the four suspects, including Eisuke, for the murder.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。

summary.en: The police search the rooms of the four suspects for the blunt weapon used to murder Tatsumi Moniwa. The pictures on Moniwa's cameras were developed revealing pictures of Sonoko. Conan realizes that the man is not an FBI but a stalker who was targeting Sonoko.

title.ja: 赤白黄色と探偵団
title.en: Red, White, Yellow, and the Detective Boys
title.enRaw: Red, White, Yellow, and the Detective Boys

summary.en: After school, Conan receives a phone call from Jodie who tells him that the Black Organization has received a new member codenamed Bourbon. Meanwhile, the Detective Boys receive a request from their classmate, Kaito Sugiura, to investigate the actions of a strange man at his apartment building which his father owns. The next day the Detective Boys find that the apartment has been burnt down. Arson - Attempted Murder Location: Kaito Suigura's apartment Victim: Mr. Sugiura and Kaito Sugiura Suspects: Ryuhei Hosoi, Subaru Okiya, and Ginya Makabe At 2:30 AM, a fire started and burned the house completely. Luckily, other people weren't injured since the suspects were out and Kaito's family too. The police reveal that all the residents have safely left the building; three people, who were not at home during the fire, are suspected to be the arsonist. The police find Kaito's diary and read Kaito's entry on the day of the fire. The diary mentions three residents and clues: In the morning, the "Red man" will be able to sleep in since it is raining; the "White man" man was able to help him when he fell; the suspicious "Yellow man" returned home at night and was arguing with Kaito's father. They believe the "Yellow man" is the culprit and interrogate the three suspects: Ryuhei Hosoi, a clumsy carpenter who injures himself often; Subaru Okiya, a graduate student who waters the plants of the apartment; and Ginya Makabe, a day trader. The police reveal that Kaito has a collection of model cars and has written Conan's name in his diary as Kuroshiro (黒白 ?, lit. Black and White).

title.ja: 砕けたホロスコープ

summary.en: Kogoro is invited by Reika Shijo, a famous fortune teller, for an interview. Ran asks Shijo to read her fortune. Shijo tells her she will read it later and gives Ran her room key's diamond keychain as compensation. Later that evening, Shijo's guests realize she has been in her room for far too long. Unable to open her door, they see her through the outside window dead. Location: Reika Shijo's residence Cause of death: Stab wound Suspects: Kensuke Katsuragi, Machio Tamura, Yuuka Shiraishi, and Kurara Midorikawa Reika Shijo was murdered in a sealed room. One of her guests, Kensuke Katsuragi, climbs to the top of Shijo's room and breaks through the glass ceiling and unlocks the door. The police arrive and their investigation reveals that Shijo's room contained a specialized key which could not be copied.

title.ja: 殺意はコーヒーの香り（前編）
title.zhHans: 杀意源自咖啡之香（前篇）
title.zhHant: 產生殺意的咖啡香（上集）

summary.en: Two TV producers, Shogo Somei and Maiko Kazumi, ask Kogoro to star on his own show. Kogoro agrees and they plan a meeting for the following day. The next day, Somei picks Kogoro, Ran, and Conan up to meet with his manager, Raisaku Nakame, to discuss the show. When they arrive to Nakame's apartment on the twentieth floor, Somei reveals that Nakame had been talking about killing himself lately, prompting the idea Nakame has committed suicide. They call the apartment manager who opens the door and cuts the door chain allowing them access to the room. They find Nakame who had died because of poison in his coffee. The police suspect the possibility of murder with the hypothesis that the culprit offered Nakame poisoned coffee before leaving and told Nakame to lock his door with a door chain. Conan investigates the coffee stains and realizes the culprit was with Nakame before he died. This means the culprit somehow placed the door chain back on the door before leaving. The police suspect Somei to be the culprit and that he had tampered the scene to hide how the murder was done.

title.ja: 殺意はコーヒーの香り（後編）
title.zhHans: 杀意源自咖啡之香（后篇）
title.zhHant: 產生殺意的咖啡香（下集）

summary.en: Conan's investigation reveals that Somei tampered with the evidence to suggest Nakame was alone during his time of death. Conan reveals that there were originally two plates, two cups of coffee, and two pieces of cake. Somei took the piece of cake and placed it with the other piece to make it seem as if they were one piece. He then poured coffee from one of the cups into a plant and pretended the cup was a container for pens. For the other plate, he placed it under the spilled coffee cup to act as a saucer.

title.ja: 怪盗キッドの瞬間移動魔術（1 時間スペシャル）
title.zhHans: 怪盗基德的瞬间移动魔术
title.zhHant: 怪盜基德的瞬間移動魔術 （1 小時特別篇）

summary.en: Jirokichi Suzuki decides to bait Kaitou Kid with the Purple Nail, a pair of high-heeled footwear with embedded jewels worth a fortune, in an attempt to capture him. Owner:Jirokichi Suzuki Location:Ginza Plaza A pair of high-heeled footwear with embedded jewels worth a fortune. Maria Therasa of the Roman Empire's monarch are captivated by Purple Nail. The glitter coming from the shoes are 100-carat amethysts. He places the Purple Nail in the middle of a compact town square to prevent the Kaitou Kid from escaping with his hang glider. After announcing his challenge to the media, Kaitou Kid arrives from the sky and lands on the pedestal holding the Purple Nail. Jirokichi activates his trap and raises four twenty meter tall nets to prevent Kid from escaping the square. Kid grabs onto the Purple Nail and announces he will escape by the use of teleportation; After he disappears in a cloud of smoke, Kid appears atop the roof of a building ten seconds later. He announces to the journalists that one of the Purple Nail on the pedestal was a fake, and that he will return the next night for the second legitimate heel. The next day, Kid attempts to steal the Purple Nail in the same fashion as before. In addition, Kid challenged Conan, saying he would use the same trick, violating Thurston's magic principles. Conan naively remarked that this time Kid would teleport to one of the helicopters.
summary.zhHans: 怪盗基德相关作品以预告、变装、宝石目标和柯南的追踪对决为核心，属于独立角色专题线。

title.ja: 風林火山 迷宮の鎧武者（1 時間スペシャル）
title.zhHans: 风林火山 谜之铠甲武士
title.zhHant: 風林火山 迷宮的鎧甲武士 （1 小時特別篇）
title.enRaw: *Furinkazan - The Mysterious Armored Warrior* (1 Hour Special)

summary.en: Kogoro is hired by the Torada family to solve the murder of Yoshiro Torada. Yoshiro was swept away by a tornado and was found by an unknown culprit, who instead of helping him, left a dead centipede beside Yoshiro and left him to die. They believe the culprit is from the Tatsuo family, a family whom they share a mutual hatred for. Natural Disaster (Past) Victim: Yoshiro Torada Cause of death: Swept away by a tornado Suspects: Tatsuo family A centipede was found next to Yoshiro's body. At the same time, Heiji is hired by the Tatsuo family to investigate the death of their son, Koji Tatsuo, who was found buried under a pile of rocks, bludgeoned to death, and had a dead centipede placed beside his body. It was placed there, meaning that someone found him dying, but refused to help him. Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Torada family Koji's body was found in a pile of rocks with a centipede next to it. During the investigation, Conan, Heiji, run into a third detective named Kansuke Yamato who is investigating the same case. Their investigations lead them to believe the victims and serial killer are somehow related to an incident six years ago, where a respectable officer name Kuroto Kai was found dead during his mounted archery practice. They learn that Kai's body, which sustained injuries from falling off a cliff, died of emaciation which means he was still alive after his fall and that someone left him to die. Murder or Accident? (Past) Location: Under some trees at the base of a cliff, Nagano Cause of death: Dehydration after being unable to move from injuries from a fall Suspects: Torada and Tatsuo families No centipede was found next to Kai's body. That night, Ran and Kazuha spot the shadow of a moving Takeda Shingen armor. When Ayaka Tatsuo, hears of this, she becomes hysterical and locks herself in the bathroom. Moments later, Ayaka is found hanged on a tree with a gag around her mouth and a dead centipede under her body. They learn from the Tatsuo family that the centipedes are a reference to Takeda Shingen's soldiers which were referred to as, "The Centipedes". The families also revealed that the three victims along with Akira Tatsuo and Shigetsugu Torada were digging around and searching for Takeda Shingen's legendary treasure. Conan and Heiji's investigations lead them to believe the murderer is following the Furinkazan and that the next culprit shall die in a death related to fire. title.ja: 明治維新ミステリーツアー（探索編）
title.zhHans: 明治维新推理之旅（探索篇）
title.zhHant: 明治維新神秘之旅（探索篇）
title.en: Meiji Restoration Mystery Tour: Investigation Chapter
title.enRaw: Meiji Restoration Mystery Tour: Investigation Chapter

summary.en: Investigation Chapter The Detective Boys are at a shrine dedicated to Yoshida Shoin, a famous figure of the Meiji Restoration. While there, they witness two men attempt to wrestle a book from a woman named Kimiko Kobayakawa. After the two men flee, Kobayakawa explains that the two men are after her late grandfather's diary which contains the location of a treasure which could buy a country. Kogoro, Ran, and the Detective Boys decode the diary to find the location of the treasure. The picture depicts a fox staring at a stream full of carp with the message "Feed the carp to the fox" beside it. Kobayakawa assumes it means the stream of carp she has at her house and takes them to Tsuwano, Shimane Prefecture. On the way, they meet up with Kimiko's friend, Shigeru Kawaguchi, and her servant, Tsuneo Kikkawa. Once arriving to Tsuwano, Conan realizes what the code means and folds the picture to cover the stream resulting in the message "Below the top of the hidden Inari". They search an Inari Shrine and find a map of Hagi with the words, "Reflect the castle in the eye of the cat, and look under the mouse". While exploring Hagi, Kimiko, Mitsuhiko, and Haibara are kidnapped by the two men from before. Hostages: Kimiko Kobayakawa, Mitsuhiko Tsuburaya, and Ai Haibara Age: 21 years old (Kimiko) Suspects: Men wearing sunglasses Decipherment Chapter The kidnappers call Kobayakawa's phone and demand Conan's group to find the treasure before nightfall. Conan realizes that the map of Hagi has the same shape of a cat. He overlaps the picture of a cat from the diary with the map and realizes the location pinpointed by the picture points them to a temple. Once there, Conan realizes that in the previous riddle, "mouse" was referring to the English word mouth. Conan finds the next clue in a stone lantern, and explains that the opening of a lantern is called a fire mouth. The clue contains a ripped page of the diary which tells them they should go to a cave infested with Kappas to construct a map. Kikkawa directs them to Akiyoshi cave, the only cave containing a lake. Once there, Conan realizes the diary page contains panels of a jumbled map and organizes them accordingly to the cave's kanji. Once organized, the map tells them to find the pair of dragons where a fox rock shall point to a rock of light. Conan asks Kikkawa to direct them to place with two waterfalls. Upon arrival, the group discovers a shadow of a fox cast by rock formations and at the tip of the shadow, they find a rock with a mirror inside. The group pushes the rock which reveals a cave underneath and navigates through it with the help of the constructed map.

title.ja: ワインレッドの告発

summary.en: Kogoro and Shiratori are invited somewhere in the mountains of Tokyo as guests to a wine appreciation party hosted by Murozo Honjo, a wine collector, in order to celebrate the 70th birthday of Shinya Hirose, a famous wine critic. While exploring the villa, Ran and Conan notice Honjo in an argument with Goro Akamaru, a wine critic. From afar, Conan witnesses Honjo smashing a brick into Akamaru's skull. Location: Outside of the villa Victim: Goro Akamaru Injury: Blunt force trauma Culprit: Murozo Honjo Conan runs to their location but is unable to find evidence of the assault. While Conan investigates, he notices a thread in a barrel, and realizes Akamaru's body was stored there but had been moved to a different location so he would not be found. Conan realizes the only room he had not investigated is the wine storage room which is secured by a system requiring Honjo's fingerprint. During the wine tasting ceremony, Honjo's prized wine has been found to had the dregs mixed with the wine, ruining the taste. Conan examines the bottle and finds a bloody fingerprint. This leads him to conclude that Akamaru regained consciousness while imprisoned in the wine cellar, and ruined Honjo's wine in an act of revenge. Since he hasn't returned, he's likely still trapped there. The question is, how to get into the wine cellar?

title.ja: 殺人犯、工藤新一（1 時間スペシャル）
title.zhHant: 殺人犯，工藤新一 （1 小時特別篇）

summary.en: The group are all heading home in Kogoro's rental car, when they discover a man who was strangled within his car on the highway. They then stopped to investigate. Victim: Gunpei Furuki Cause of death: Strangulation Suspects: Riko Mizohashi, Atsuo Chuda, and Futoshi Shimodori The police are able to stop traffic by ordering a toll gate to refuse cars passage. Shinichi and Heiji reveal that the victim died while driving evidenced by his body temperature. They are able to narrow the list of suspects to three people by examining the time on their toll tickets and matching it with the victims. The three suspects reveal that the victim was a famous street racer who went under the name Gunpei who quit racing when he caused the death of a man named Akira during a race. The three each have a motive for the murder. Shinichi and Heiji notice that there are holes in the car window by the side of the driver's seat and realize how the murder is done. Accidental death (Past) Victim: Akira Shimodori Cause of death: Car crash Culprit: Gunpei Furuki During a street race with the rain, Furuki crashes Akira's Silvia from the highway, causing his death.

title.ja: 憎しみの青い火花（前編）

summary.en: The antidote to the APTX 4869 begins to wear off and Shinichi is about to change back to Conan. Ran holds onto him and refuses to let him go but is tranquilized by Haibara and Shinichi is able to become Conan again without anyone noticing. On another day, the Detective Boys are on a camping trip when Professor Agasa's car runs out of gas, stranding them in the middle of the mountain. A man named Goki Sudo drives by and refuses to help their situation. Soon after, Sudo drives to his home atop the mountain and an explosion occurs. The Detective Boys arrive to find Sudo dead. The police investigate and declare the death as an accident caused by a lit cigarette and spilled gasoline which vaporized in the garage. As the police interrogates Sudo's fiancée, Ena Ginbayashi, Conan reveals Sudo was not smoking a cigarette and that something else caused the explosion. Due to Ena's inconsistency with her story, Conan deduces the explosion was a planned murder by Ena.

title.ja: 憎しみの青い火花（後編）

summary.en: Conan interrogates the party guests at Sudo's home and learns Ena has been persuading her husband to wear his wool sweater under his fleece jacket and to use his classic car for the past three weeks.

title.ja: 真犯人からの届け物
title.en: A Present from the True Culprit
title.enRaw: A Present from the True Culprit

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are at their usual diner but learn that their waitress' brother is a suspect in a murder. Victim: Takafumi Torihira Cause of death: Gunshot wound? Suspects: Sugihito Enomoto The waitress, Azusa Enomoto, is interrogated by the authorities about her older brother, Sugihito Enomoto. When a package containing cookies is delivered to Azusa, she leaves to go shopping while Takagi accompanies her. Takagi returns revealing Azusa escaped from him and is deduced to be meeting her brother.

title.ja: 仮面劇に秘めた悪意
title.en: The Malice Hidden Behind the Masque
title.enRaw: The Malice Hidden Behind the Masque

summary.en: Kogoro is invited by the manager of a theater to investigate strange occurrences. While Conan goes off to investigate on his own, he overhears Hiroshi Komazuka, one of the main actors, plan on switching a fake rapier with a real one to murder Robert Banno, another main actor, in the sword fight scene of the play. Komazuka realizes Conan overheard him and traps him in a sarcophagus prop in the storage room. Robert sets up a trap on the stage in order to electrocute the actor named Atsushi Yabuki. When Robert learns that the fake rapier has been switched with the real one, he decides to pursue Yabuki to trade roles with him so he may murder Yabuki in person. Yabuki agrees and as Robert leaves, Yabuki reveals his plan to poison the wine Komazuka drinks during the play. Location: Storage room Victim: Edogawa Conan Culprit: Hiroshi Komazuka Komazuka trap him in a sarcophagus prop in the storage room after he heard his crime.

title.ja: 柔よく謎を制す（前編）

summary.en: Eri invites Ran and Conan to dinner along with her friend Yuko Arisawa. Yuko tells Eri that someone is stalking her husband and wants her to help. Her husband, Shiro Arisawa, calls her and reveals he is currently attending a wake and will be home in two hours. While eating at a hotel restaurant, Yuko tells them she strongly admires Hajime Kajimoto, her former judo senpai and the current coach of Japan's judo team. After dinner, Yuko takes them all to her house and there, they find Shiro strangled with his necktie. Yuko's strange behavior causes both Conan and Eri to suspect her for murdering her husband, but they are unable to disprove her alibi.

title.ja: 柔よく謎を制す（後編）

summary.en: Ran decides to phone her father to ask for help, but he is busy playing mahjong. Eri tells Conan and Ran that in the past Kogoro would always played a recording of the police siren and say he is busy solving a case when he was actually at a bar drinking.

title.ja: 都市伝説の正体（前編）
title.en: The Truth Behind the Urban Legend (Part 1)

summary.en: A person who murders people with a hammer, dubbed "Hammer Man", has been seen escaping to an apartment after assaulting a woman. Along with present victim, the "Hammer Man" attempted three murders in the past, making the total number of victims to four. Sato and Takagi stalk out the apartment and are later accompanied by Conan, Ran and Sonoko. They explained that the owner of the apartment were out of the country, but his parents revealed that a male friend of his is borrowing the place, but the parents don't know that friend's name. The neighbors has told the police that the man lived there for a while with his girlfriend. But it seemed that she has left him, and the man stays indoor all day and only comes out at night. A home delivery courier, a bike delivery woman, and a pizza deliverer were seen to leave that apartment and were then interrogated. The three reveal they did not meet their client and instead followed notes specified for them. The courier was instructed to leave the package outside the door, the woman was told to pick up the package, and the pizza man was told to leave the pizza on the table and take the money from an envelope. They then realize that while interrogating the three, no one was watching the apartment. They enter the apartment to find a masked man unconscious. Conan removes the mask and notices that the man was knocked unconscious by a hammer and deduces hammer man has impersonated one of three deliverers from before.

title.ja: 都市伝説の正体（後編）
title.en: The Truth Behind the Urban Legend (Part 2)

summary.en: Conan investigates the apartment and finds the bathroom to be too clean and that there is no underwear in the dryer.

title.ja: 初恋の傷跡

summary.en: The next day, a TV show features the case with this serial killer, which is three days away of being definitely closed. A popular criminal psychologist named Douji Hiramune is one of the guests and he arrogantly challenges the serial killer to reveal himself, even daring him to come kill him if he wishes so. Hiramune happens to live in the same apartment complex as Ayumi, where the Detective Boys are staying over since she's home alone. Haibara and Ayumi go for food and drinks, and when they return Haibara reveals to Conan that she saw a mysterious man whistling Let It Be which is the serial killer's trademark. Conan immediately contacts Takagi, Chiba and Sato and tells them that the killer is around. He then tells the others to stay put and runs out of the Yoshida apartment, finds Hiramune's flat and sees the door is open. He steps in and finds Hiramune murdered, with the letter "Z" slashed into his back and his throat slashed... exactly like all but one of the serial killer's victims, who died either 20 (three of them) or 15 (the last one) years ago. (The victim who wasn't stabbed, Matsumoto's best friend/Megure's mentor Morimura, was ran over by the killer's car during the first days of the murder investigation, bleeding to death in Matsumoto's arms. Additionally, Matsumoto later confronted the suspect they were chasing after and got slashed across his eye, gaining his trademark scar.) Location: Douji Hiramune's room in Ayumi's apartment complex Victim: Douji Hiramune Cause of death: Slash wound Suspects: Dokurou Kibo When Conan tries to answer the door, Hiramune wasn't answered it, so he decided to open the door, which the door isn't locked. He tried to find Hiramune. When he reach into Hiramune's room, he saw Hiramune died. He open his shirt from the back, and saw the "Z" word on his back. The police department arrive and are confused as the letter they were expecting was "N" as the previous victims had the letters "E", "S", "W" and were thought to be cardinal direction. Location: Boukawa's house Victim: Tsuguharu Boukawa Cause of death: Slash wound Culprit: Serial killer from 20 years ago 20 years ago, a 50 year old doctor Tsuguharu Boukawa was wounded by a serial killer with the katana from his house. Location: Mugita's house Victim: Atsunori Mugita Cause of death: Slash wound Culprit: Serial killer from 20 years ago 2 days later, a 42 year old Tohto university associate professor in the science and technology department Atsunori Mugita was murdered by the same killer with the same katana from 2 days ago. Victim: Superintendent Morimura Cause of death: Hit by a car Culprit: Serial killer from 20 years ago The police were questioning suspicious cars around the residences of the two victims when one of the suddenly ran away. Superintendent Morimura was died getting hit by a car due to his duty on trying to stop the car. Attempted Murder (Past) Victim: Kiyonaga Matsumoto Injury: Slash wound in the left eye Culprit: Serial killer from 20 years ago Superintendent Matsumoto went after car that car, his left eye was wounded by the very same katana that was the murder weapon. After snatching the sword, he slashed the suspect across his back. Location: Nabei's house Victim: Susumu Nabei Cause of death: Slash wound Culprit: Serial killer from 20 years ago 5 years later, 34 year old lawyer Susumu Nabei was killed by same killer with a kitchen knife in his home. Conan and the police notice Hiramune's left hand was on his keyboard on the keys "Ctrl" and "C" and his right hand holding the wire of his mouse. Takagi and the Detective Boys decide to accompany him and his interrogation of the victim's relatives: Boukawa's widow, Mugita's younger brother, and Nabei's son. Conan than realizes the victims share one thing in connection, Mahjong. It's confirmed that 20 years ago, all the victims save for Morimura attended a popular Mahjong parlor on a regular basis. Later, Takagi comes to the conclusion that a man named Dokurou Kibo is the serial killer. Aside of his past as an ex-con, Kibo had some very incriminating actions und his belt: he used to bicker about different themes with the victims in the parlor, and the last one (which he had with Hiramune alone) finished with him flipping their table (and damaging the tiles on it) while loudly swearing to kill them. After talking with said parlor manager, Takagi takes one of the old and damaged Mahjong tiles and keeps it in his pocket. In the meantime Matsumoto, having learned about Takagi's more daring attitude in this case and how he and Satou were planning to go to a spa once it was all over, fears for Takagi's safety. He says that many times, when a someone in the police makes a promise to his loved ones, he or she is likely to die in the line of duty; he adds that Morimura was one month away from getting married and died when, during the case, he got reckless in an attempt to impress his girlfriend.

title.en: The Secret of the Vanished Masterpiece
title.enRaw: The Secret of the Vanished Masterpiece

summary.en: The Detective Boys decide to investigate a spooky château but realize a man is currently inhabiting the house and had remodeled the garden. The next day, the man living in the château, Rokuro Wada is revealed to have died. They learn from Keiichi Yagami, Wada's agent who sells his paintings, that Wada had been working on a masterpiece at the château for three months. They decide to search the château for the painting but to no avail. Afterwards they are visited by Wada's old aunt Saeko Takato and her caretaker Mina Eguchi who reveals that Wada sent them a letter telling them to visit the château tomorrow to view the masterpiece. Eguchi reveals Wada's masterpiece is going to help Takato regain her memories which she lost from an accident a year ago. Conan finds a photo revealing a château Takato owned in the past and realizes what Wada's masterpiece is.

title.ja: 怪盗キッド VS 最強金庫（前編）
title.zhHans: 怪盗基德VS最强金库（前篇）
title.zhHant: 怪盜基德 VS 最強金庫（上集）
title.en: Kaitou Kid vs. the Strongest Safe (Part 1)

summary.en: Jirokichi Suzuki receives a letter from the thief, Kaitou Kid which reveals that Kid plans on opening Jirokichi's impenetrable safe, the Iron Tanuki. Advanced Notice:It came to me, Senior Advisor Suzuki. That we should stop these senseless bouts of ours and take on the compliant nature of a newborn. When darkness consumes the moon, await me at the grand safe kept precious in your family home and look forward to my surpassing it. A safe that was constructed during the Tokugawa shogunate period by the master of traps, Samizu Kichiemon, just prior to his death. The letter however is not written in Kid's usual style raising the idea that an imposter is after Jirokichi's safe. Sonoko invites Ran, Kogoro, and Conan to Jirokichi's house. After examining the security of the safe, Kaitou Kid's card, in its usual style, is found confirming Kaitou Kid's plan to open the safe. Conan suspects that Kaitou Kid is one of the three newly hired workers of Jirokichi. Jirokichi however continues to proclaim it to be the work of an imposter, causing Conan to suspect Jirokichi as Kid himself.
summary.zhHans: 怪盗基德相关作品以预告、变装、宝石目标和柯南的追踪对决为核心，属于独立角色专题线。

title.ja: 怪盗キッド VS 最強金庫（後編）
title.zhHans: 怪盗基德VS最强金库（后篇）
title.zhHant: 怪盜基德 VS 最強金庫（下集）
title.en: Kaitou Kid vs. the Strongest Safe (Part 2)

summary.en: The nearly hired maid and adviser inform Conan of Jirokichi's strange behavior. They reveal that after dinner, two plates are always missing and Jirokichi always brings his cane with him to the safe. Jirokichi asks the maid for a hand and they head to his room. Jirokichi leaves with his bodyguard for a drive. Shortly after, an unconscious Jirokichi is found tied up and his room and a note of Kaitou Kid is found on the safe. This causes the whole police force that are guarding the safe to abandon their position and chase after "Jirokichi".
