summary.en: Forty years ago, Yuri was charged of transporting a jewel for a live drama, but was never found back until in 2015, when a construction worker and a real estate agent found her body inside a rusty car at the bottom of a dried up Ogouchi Dam. Forty years ago, after Yuri's disappearance, the Tears of Borgia also disappeared. As of now, they are still missing. In the scenario of "I Killed Them", a thief known as Red Hood targets the jewel of a rich family and, to avoid getting robbed, the owners decide to let the real jewel on the maid's fingers while a fake one is hidden in the safe but Red Hood is no other than the butler with whom the maid has fallen in love. Someone has killed Mizusawa before the planned arrival of Kogoro at the real estate agency at six and erased all the data on his phone. The culprit also tried to burn all the evidence. Responding to Sho's invitation to his workplace, Kogoro goes there but no one answers. He enters by the unlocked front door, finds the unconscious body of Sho Mizusawa and is trapped in a dangerous fire. Will he escape?

title.ja: 恐竜につぶされた男
title.en: The Man Crushed by a Dinosaur
title.enRaw: The Man Crushed by a Dinosaur

summary.en: Someone cut off Kuchiki's prized dinosaur skeleton's wires which caused it to break and fall. The same person who cut off the wires planned that it fall one the director and it did, instantly killing him.

title.ja: ラジオお悩み相談（挑戦編）
title.zhHans: 广播电台烦恼咨询（挑战篇）
title.zhHant: 廣播電台的煩惱諮詢（挑戰篇）
title.en: The Radio Questions and Concerns Show (Challenge Arc)
title.enRaw: *The Radio Questions and Concerns Show* (Challenge Arc)

summary.en: At night, after Kijima's fight with Towako, the culprit went outside, called the victim before and beated her with a metal rod, causing her to bleed to her death.

title.ja: ラジオお悩み相談（謎解き編）
title.zhHans: 广播电台烦恼咨询（解谜篇）
title.zhHant: 廣播電台的煩惱諮詢（解謎篇）
title.en: The Radio Questions and Concerns Show (Solution Arc)
title.enRaw: *The Radio Questions and Concerns Show* (Solution Arc)

title.ja: 汽笛の聞こえる古書店 2
title.zhHant: 能聽見汽笛聲的舊書店 2

summary.en: After they fought in the bookstore café, Sawada went out and was found dead later with a bloody rock nearby. Since Yujiro has Sawada's blood on him, he is the prime suspect.

title.ja: 迷宮カクテル（前編）
title.zhHant: 充滿謎團的雞尾酒（上集）

summary.en: Kogoro is invited to Black Bunny's Club by his client. Amuro mentions Shinichi's involvement in the previous case to Ran, who says that they were instructed not to talk about the case by their teacher. To avoid any further discussion on Shinichi, Conan invites Amuro to the club. Kogoro agrees. While eating, Yuri starts to struggle and falls on the floor after she drinks a sip of her glass of champagne. The suspects are the three who could have touched her glass: Fukamachi, sitting at her right, Morooka, who approached her, and Murakami, who spilled wine on her cuffs to make her change them. Nine hours later, after leaving for the Black Bunny's Club and encountering a murder there, Amuro and Akai come face to face, their guns pointed at each-other.

title.ja: 迷宮カクテル（中編）
title.zhHant: 充滿謎團的雞尾酒（中集）

summary.en: During the case, Amuro has a sudden flashback to Elena Miyano treating his wounds and telling him goodbye. He wonders why he suddenly remembered her. In a flashback with a young Amuro being treated by Elena, it is revealed that Amuro is half-Japanese. Bullies used to make fun of his hair and that was the reason he got into fights with them. He was injured and Akemi brought him to her parents' clinic. Elena Miyano, who was never too frank with any patient, seemed to be very friendly with Amuro. On asking why, she replied to her husband Atsushi that she's half-Japanese too. The Karasuma Group offered to sponsor Atsushi Miyano's research but he was reluctant to accept their offer considering strange rumors surrounding the organization among his colleagues about being a shady group. However, he agreed to think about it after Elena announced that she was pregnant with another child.

title.ja: 迷宮カクテル（後編）
title.zhHant: 充滿謎團的雞尾酒（下集）

summary.en: By process of elimination showed by Conan, through presenting possible situations that the suspects might use before and/or on the time of the murder, they were able to single out the culprit.

title.ja: 昆虫人間のヒミツ
title.en: The Secret of the Insect Man
title.enRaw: The Secret of the Insect Man

summary.en: Genta brings Conan, Ayumi, and Mitsuhiko to Kuronosu, a small village, so he can catch "insect men" at a town organized event where townspeople are disguised as insects. After running to a sound they thought was the cry of the insect man, the Detective Boys find out that it is only the sound of bulldozers working the land in a forest. The workers get angry and chase them until they are able to go back in town. There, they meet two kids dressed as insects who tell them what is happening in the village currently. Using a picture-story show, they explain that there was once a government official that went in Kuronosu to plan the construction of public baths and casinos in the forest land for the villagers. Unfortunately, the mayor opposed the project as the forest had cultural and historical value since it was the legendary nature-loving Princess Gaga's supposed resting place. The mayor devised a plan and kicked out the official from the village and then planned to open an insect man ranch in the forest instead. Since villagers opposed, the mayor retired a year ago and bought the forest with his own money and moved bulldozers over the place. The mayor then died from a heart attack before being able to put his plan in action. The villagers found out that the whole idea of an insect man ranch was a fraud and a scheme of his to dig up Gaga's grave and sell its treasures. Location: Kuronosu Village Victim: Kuronosu Village Culprit: Chosuke Murano A year ago, Murano planned to open an insect man ranch although it was all a scheme so he could dig up Princess Gaga's treasures and appropriate them for himself. The adults of the village were all angry and decided to try to find the treasure by using the map of the forest he had left in his pocket while the children remained in town. While the boys prepare ramen for the Detective Boys, Conan investigates by himself the backstory of the village and tries to find out why the mayor did that. While investigating, Conan goes to the post office, the medical clinic and the town hall to gather more information but there is still one piece of the puzzle missing. On the other hand, the Detective Boys dressed themselves as insect men and headed to Gaga Shrine's forest where the forest is. They get themselves in trouble as they are cornered by the construction workers. Conan, after hearing them yelling, runs to help them but they are forced to climb to a three to escape. On top of the three, Conan figures out the truth. Location: Gaga Shrine, Kuronosu Village Victim: Conan Edogawa, Ayumi Yoshida, Genta Kojima and Mitsuhiko Tsuburaya Culprit: Townspeople on the excavation site The adult working in the forest saw the Detective Boys and tried to kidnap them since they were in the way.

title.ja: 謎解き水上バス（前編）

summary.en: Kogoro and Conan walk past Beika Park and see Megure, Takagi, and Chiba along with witnesses on a canvassed area. They decide to look further into it. After returning from the bar, Eiji was struck by a metal pipe in the park and died instantly. After their father's death, Eiji was believed to abuse his mother and Yuichi was probably the protector. After interrogating Takase, the police get a call from officers stationed at the Kadowakis. When they arrive, the house was burned completely and Yasuko's dead body had already been brought by forensics. Yuichi was found uninjured.

title.ja: 謎解き水上バス（後編）

summary.en: Kogoro and Conan walk past Beika Park and see Megure, Takagi, and Chiba along with witnesses on a canvassed area. They decide to look further into it. After returning from the bar, Eiji was struck by a metal pipe in the park and died instantly. After their father's death, Eiji was believed to abuse his mother and Yuichi was probably the protector. After interrogating Takase, the police get a call from officers stationed at the Kadowakis. When they arrive, the house was burned completely and Yasuko's dead body had already been brought by forensics. Yuichi was found uninjured.

title.ja: プードルと散弾銃（前編）

summary.en: While her party was ongoing, a mysterious masked man hopped on the yacht and shot her to death with a shotgun before fleeing the scene by jumping on the boats next to it. An hour before the party, while Morishima was making preparations for the party, the mysterious masked man snucked from behind him and hit him with his shotgun's rifle butt before attaching him and gagging him inside a locker in the boat. Hyodo engaged to her only so he could pretend to be a consultant and make her invest 50 million yen into his services which only benefited himself. Anna caught wind of it and demanded retribution from Hyodo who was unable to pay her back and they broke up. To justify that he wasn't the culprit, Hyodo says he was robbing Anna's apartment at that time and that the proof is that he left his gym card "by accident" before he left.

title.ja: プードルと散弾銃（後編）

summary.en: At night, while Hyodo was searching for something, someone hit him from behind with a shotgun's back which killed him.

title.ja: 未亡人と探偵団
title.en: Miss Lonely and the Detective Boys
title.enRaw: Miss Lonely and the Detective Boys

summary.en: The detective boys become friends of a widow, when she was dating with a man, the man dies. Location: Tomoko Komori's house Victim: Kohei Kajiki Cause of death: Cerebral contusion after falling Kajiki fell to his death after accidentally grabbing on to a rotting balcony railing while drunkenly trying to pick up his cell phone. Conan notices a few weird clues and believes it to not be a mere accident.

title.ja: グランピング怪事件

summary.en: Sonoko, Ran, and Conan are going to a "glamping park", a luxury camping, when they witness a murder. Location: Okuhoku Glamping Park Victim: Keidai Tosaki Cause of death: Suffocation from anaphylactic shock Suspects: Kyoko Tosaki, Hiroshi Tanabe, and Mika Miura Tosaki was found dead on the ground with crab sticking out of his mouth, his face covered in marker, a note in his hand, and dressed in women's clothing. It is revealed that all of the suspects moved the corpse to another's room and put thing in the corpse. Now Conan needs to investigate who is lying.

title.ja: 毛利小五郎大講演会（前編）
title.zhHans: 毛利小五郎大演讲会（前篇）
title.zhHant: 毛利小五郎的盛大演講會（上集）

summary.en: A day before Kogoro’s grand lecture, Eri Kisaki arrives at the drink bar where Kogoro, Conan, and Ran are sitting and discuss the event. Conan notices an article about a professor committing murder in one of the files Eri is holding when she accidentally drops it, and he also becomes aware that someone is watching them. Before Kogoro’s lecture, he is still drinking, much to Ran’s dismay when he states that he must have some alcohol in himself to make others laugh. The Detective Boys also send him a gift, wishing him good luck before they depart to watch a football match in the stadium nearby. In the middle of the fun when Junko Hishida, Yusaku Ujimori, Naoya Tsunohazu, Kosuke Amagi, Kiho Furui, Mei Tsukuba, Kenichiro Inokoshi, and Hideki Tsukinogi are having conversations with Kogoro, The former HISHIDA manager, Mokichi Reizei, is scolding Junko for the bad infrastructure he is witnessing, only to be disrupted by Inokoshi. Kogoro falls asleep as a result of the heavy drinking session, much to the dismay of Ran, Conan, and Haibara, with Haibara teasing that Conan should use his voice-changing bowtie. However, it looks like that the little detective won’t have time to watch the football match with the Detective Boys as planned, as Furui’s scream when she sees the blood gushing out after hearing no responds from Inokoshi, who asked her to get coffee, catches the attention of Haibara and Conan.

title.ja: 毛利小五郎大講演会（中編）
title.zhHans: 毛利小五郎大演讲会（中篇）
title.zhHant: 毛利小五郎的盛大演講會（中集）

summary.en: Kogoro’s lecture was postponed as a result. Takagi reveals the evidence that proves Reizei’s testimony is correct. Conan and Haibara have to investigate the first murder again. They begin to discover something from the newspaper left from the scene, until Tsukaba disrupts the two and suggests them to tell their discover to Kogoro. The footage from the security camera at 2:55 p.m is the evidence that proves Mokichi Reizei is not the culprit of the murder of Inokoshi, meaning that he is indeed the one behind Junko's death. Reizei figured out his effort to make Junko understand the intention of respecting the former boss of the company is worthless, so he killed her in the process. The culprit for the first murder is Hideki Tsukinogi. Tsukinogi admits that he was the bodyguard for Inokoshi 1 year ago when the two encountered a strange woman, the woman was discovered to be Inokoshi's ex-lover who also got abused by him. However, after Tsukinogi explained everything and brought her to the police, Inokoshi fired him and spread rumours that drove Tsukinogi's company to bankruptcy. Conan is bothered with how Tsukuba was able to solve the case as well. Kogoro’s lecture begins with the intended schedule with the attendance of the surprising guest that was thought to never be in the first act of the lecture, Eri Kisaki.

title.ja: 毛利小五郎大講演会（後編）
title.zhHans: 毛利小五郎大演讲会（后篇）
title.zhHant: 毛利小五郎的盛大演講會（下集）

summary.en: Feeling suspicious, Conan discusses the cases along with Haibara, the Detective Boys, and Takagi. Meanwhile in the lecture, Mei Tsukuba reveals that she was the one to invite him, and has him deduce about a case that was abandoned by Eri Kisaki. Conan investigates and finds out that the newspaper clips were pointing to a case of murder that happened a year ago when a professor's assistant stabbed his master for stealing his research works.

title.ja: 大怪獣ゴメラ VS 仮面ヤイバー（序）
title.zhHans: 大怪兽哥美拉VS假面超人（序）
title.zhHant: 大怪獸哥梅拉 VS 假面超人（序）

summary.en: Nichiuri TV celebrates the opening of their new office building in Osaka and announce the production of the movie "Kaiju Gomera vs. Kamen Yaiba" by Taiho Pictures. Conan, Kogoro, Ran, the Detective Boys, Heiji and Kazuha are all there to take part in the filming as extras. TV producer Yonekura gets killed when a large monster action figure falls on him in the warehouse. Conan and Heiji deduce there were two culprits and that they are his subordinates Mihara and Kouchi, who killed Yonekura for taking credit for their work. Mihara and Kouchi try to escape arrest in Yonekura's car but Mihara is stopped by police. Kouchi drives off and crashes the car into a river. A bomb in the car goes off and kills him. Location: Nichiuri TV station, Osaka Victim: Isato Yonekura Cause of death: Stab wound Culprits: Takeru Kouchi and Yoshihito Mihara They ambushed him in the props room and dropped a large monster action figure on him. The fangs of the figure impale him to death. Location: Road near Osaka's Nichiuri TV station, Osaka Victims: Ran Mouri and Kazuha Toyama Age: 16 years old (Ran) and 17 years old (Kazuha) Attack types: Vehicular assault Culprit: Takeru Kouchi Trying to escape police, Kouchi drove Yonekura's black Lincoln Navigator that he had just stolen without his partner-in-crime Mihara since he was caught by the police. Since he didn't to stop his car, he nearly ran over Ran but she was saved on time by Fumimaro Ayanokoji who just happened to come by. Kazuha, who was walking with Ran, escaped getting ran over since Ran pushed her on the side. Bombing-Accidental Murder Location: Road near Osaka's Nichiuri TV station, Osaka Victim: Takeru Kouchi Cause of death: Explosion from car crash impact After driving past Ran, Kouchi sped but a taxi came from another runway and Kouchi was forced to turn at his right and crashed into the nearby river. The unstable explosive inside the car caused it to explode and kill Kouchi on the spot. It is believed by the police that the original target to be killed by the explosive was Yonekura and not Kouchi. The next day, Fumimaro Ayanokoji joins the investigation as Yonekura was connected to a scriptwriter Onda, who died in Kyoto the day before Yonekura's death when he drove off a cliff. Onda drives a red car on even days and a blue car on odd days but he died in the red car on an even day. Yonekura and Onda worked together on an independent film 20 years ago. A third death occurs in Suemura, an employee of Taiho Pictures, when a bomb explodes at an abandoned warehouse. Suemura was also a part of Yonekura's team 20 years ago. The bomb used matches the one that was in Yonekura's car and the police suspect a bomb was also used in Onda's death. They learn of a fourth member of the team 20 years ago in Katsuji Ishizawa and look for him only to find him bound and gagged in the kitchen of his own home. Bombing-Murder (Past) Location: Takaragaike road, Kyoto Victim: Takashi Onda Time: 2 days ago at night Cause of death: Explosion from car crash impact While Onda was drunk, he drove on Takaragaike and his car exploded killing him instantly. The explosive used was acetone peroxide, just like in Kouchi's car crash accident. Location: Unnamed company warehouse near Osaka Castle Victim: Ryohei Suemura Cause of death: Explosion Otaki comes to the filming site and brings Heiji and Conan to another case which just happened : Ryohei Suemura, an employee for the company which produces Kamen Yaiba vs. Gomera was killed when he opened a box of explosives (the same used in the previous murders) in an abandoned warehouse which was to be used to film some movie scenes. Ishizawa's brought to a hospital. He had been starved for two to three days with bruises all over. Conan and Kogoro investigate Ishizawa's residence. They deduce Ishizawa was locked in his room on the second floor, broke out and fell down the stairs but couldn't explain why he didn't go outside for help. Conan notices a newspaper in the entranceway with a story on Yonekura's death. Conan meets with Haibara, who tells Conan about how Yonekura, Onda and Suemura all paid off their debts ten years ago and, at around the same time, there was an unsolved robbery of 120 million yen by a four-man group. Also, before his death, Onda was close to bankruptcy after failed investments. Conan deduces the robbery was committed by Yonekura's team and the deaths were due to a falling out but can't work out the culprit. Conan considers the possibility that Yonekura killed Onda after being blackmailed but he couldn't explain why Yonekura's car had a bomb. Haibara suspects Ishizawa staged his confinement but Conan didn't find evidence of that. Conan couldn't explain why a bomb was only planted in one of Onda's two cars or why the bomb in Yonekura's car had no timer or detonator. Location: House in Sakai Victim: Katsuji Ishizawa While staking out his house, the police find out he has been bound and gagged inside it and that he was just barely alive. Fortunately, he survived and has been brought to the police hospital to recover. Location: Mansion in Kobe Victim: Old couple and two employees Robbed items: 120 million yen (approx. 1 million $ / 33.4 million ฿) Suspects: Isato Yonekura, Katsuji Ishizawa, Ryohei Suemura, Takashi Onda and an unknown person Ten years ago, four people robbed a mansion in Kobe and took away 120 million yen. Later investigations made it clear that the culprits were likely to be the four members of "Team Yonekura". While analyzing the proof that was on DVD, they find out that indeed the four of them were part of it but that there was a fifth member, the one who filmed the video. Location: Nichiuri TV Station, Osaka The culprit tried to kill Koichi Ishizawa by putting bombs at the place he worked. It turns out he didn't go and thus, Heiji and Conan have to disarm the bombs before the guests are hurt.

title.zhHans: 大怪兽哥美拉VS假面超人（破）

The bomb used matches the one that was in Yonekura's car and the police suspect a bomb was also used in Onda's death. Bombing-Murder (Past) Location: Takaragaike road, Kyoto Victim: Takashi Onda Time: 2 days ago at night Cause of death: Explosion from car crash impact While Onda was drunk, he drove on Takaragaike and his car exploded killing him instantly. Haibara suspects Ishizawa staged his confinement but Conan didn't find evidence of that. Conan couldn't explain why a bomb was only planted in one of Onda's two cars or why the bomb in Yonekura's car had no timer or detonator. Location: House in Sakai Victim: Katsuji Ishizawa While staking out his house, the police find out he has been bound and gagged inside it and that he was just barely alive. Fortunately, he survived and has been brought to the police hospital to recover. Later investigations made it clear that the culprits were likely to be the four members of "Team Yonekura". While analyzing the proof that was on DVD, they find out that indeed the four of them were part of it but that there was a fifth member, the one who filmed the video. Location: Nichiuri TV Station, Osaka The culprit tried to kill Koichi Ishizawa by putting bombs at the place he worked. It turns out he didn't go and thus, Heiji and Conan have to disarm the bombs before the guests are hurt.

summary.en: There, they meet a mysterious lady, Mari Hayashi, who reveals herself to be quite rich. They help her get to the location she wants and later head there by themselves. As they arrive, they see a robber trying to steal the heavy bag Mari was carrying and rapidly stop him. As they ask her about the bag's contents, she just nods and goes away. Later, they meet her again and ask her where was her bag as she was walking empty-handed. She reveals to them that Manabu Saikawa, who works for her family has been kidnapped and that the bag had the ransom money, 30 Million Yen. The four of them then go to the ransom location to find out the money has been taken. In the morning, while Yuko Kaede was working, she received a call saying that Saikawa was kidnapped and that a ransom was to be given so Saikawa could be freed. After going to the Hayashis' house to investigate, Kogoro gathers all suspects to reveal that Saikawa staged his own kidnapping so he could get the money. Saikawa then angrily throws the bag at them and runs away. At night, while Soichi was returning home, someone came from behind and struck him with a rock.

title.zhHans: 加贺千金推理之旅（后篇）

summary.en: The next morning, the police carries Soichi away and tell the people involved that Soichi will recover. Kogoro and Conan find some gold dust on the crime scene and deduce that Takumi Kondo might be involved with it since he works in gold crafting. Kondo reveals he only went to meet him and didn't hit him. Back at the house, they receive a call saying that Rintaro Hagino was kidnapped. By listening to the call, Conan deduces they have to go to Komatsu, which has the only airport in the area and that Hagino must be held captive there. At the train station's entrance, Conan and Ran stumble across Saikawa, who was trying to go by undetected and they chase him to a house where Kogoro is in front of, having been given the authority to bring Hagino's ransom money. They arrive at the house along with Kaede, Kondo, Mari and the police which have been called to come. Kogoro finds Hagino and unties him asking him where was Saikawa. There, Conan stuns Kogoro with his wristwatch to expel the truth.

summary.en: Naeko is rushing to the police station due to daydreaming about Chiba finally recognizing her again when she meets Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys. While waiting for the traffic light to allow them to walk, Naeko teaches the boys about traffic signs, which are heard by a mysterious man who also looks furious about traffic laws after they are allowed to go. At work, Sato is discussing with Yumi and Naeko about her stakeout when Takagi and Chiba come to inform Sato to help them with their stakeout, Yumi then pushes Naeko toward Chiba to create an opportunity for their conversation, but Chiba doesn’t recommend her in the stakeout because she looks like a secondary student taught by the police. Later that day, Naeko is having a Karaoke with Shiroi Yagi and Touko Momosaki, who are also raising suspicion about a stalker targeting them. After Yagi takes the drunken Naeko home, Momosaki receives a strange request from a mysterious man that we might have seen earlier, however, this does not turn out very well for her as this was a set up to lure her into her death. When she was fighting with a masked man while returning house, she is stunned in the ankle and later killed by the masked man.

summary.en: Yumi recalls when she, Yagi, and Momosaki charged three men for breaking traffic laws, specifically: Kengo Aono was charged for smartphone usage while driving, he even forgot his driving license. Yuuzou Shiroyama was charged for driving without equipping seatbelt and overdue inspection (driving license expired, as some specific driving licenses would require prolonging when expired). All three of them reacted harshly because they were in a hurry at the time, but were eventually taken to the police station for resisting an officer on duty. Conan leaves the scene to go to school with Haibara and the Detective Boys, on the way, he tells them about the scene of the murder. Sato asks Yumi for the information of the three suspects before the latter goes back to her department and sees Naeko praying for Momosaki. Meanwhile, Yagi arrives at the place where she had assumed the culprit is staying at and confronts that person. This doesn’t turn out to be very good for her as she suffers the same fate as the previous victim, leaving a phone that is trying to call 7155 before getting it smashed as well. After being tasered from the apartment, she was thrown off the balcony. However, she wasn't dead completely.

summary.en: Shiratori, Chiba, and Sato are asking an old woman if she’s ever seen a suspicious person or known Yagi, to which she answers not at all. When the police tell the lady where Yagi fell, she begins to express her fear as there was a woman who lived there and jumped out of the building exactly one week ago. But before Sato can ask for more information about the suicide, there is a scream stating that there is someone died, so they arrive at the place where the one who screamed points at. In a shocking turn, Yumi is the one lying down exactly where Yagi did earlier, at first Sato cries for her death but is later surprised when learns that Takagi forgets to inform her and the others that Yumi asked him if she could lie there to see what had Yagi tried to look at, which was the no parking sign. At this moment, Sato remembers that in the first scene, at the direction Momosaki was looking at, there is also a no parking sign like this one. Takagi also informs that the number Yagi was trying to make a call was 7155, so Yumi tries to call Naeko to confirm if Karaoke has a song corresponding to that number, to which she says no. Everyone decides to go ask for information somewhere else while Yumi goes home following others' recommendation.

title.en: The Secret of the Search for his Wife
title.enRaw: The Secret of the Search for his Wife

summary.en: A man named Masaki Higuchi is showing a poster of his missing wife Tomomi Higuchi to several people while he is getting wet from the rain. Ran and Conan approach him with an umbrella to offer him shelter and ask to see the poster. Ran immediately recognizes Tomomi from her workplace, a florist shop. Masaki asks for their help and Ran suggests he talk to her father Kogoro Mouri, known as "Sleeping Kogoro". At the detective agency, Masaki tells them what he knows. He had planned a date with his wife Tomomi at an expensive restaurant but she never showed up. Kogoro asks if maybe she ran off, but Masaki tells him that that is impossible as they had a happy life together. As evidence, he reveals that her phone and wallet were left behind, something a person running away would never do. Masaki asks Kogoro to investigate the case for him which he accepts. Kogoro along with Conan question Masaki's neighbors, getting different statements from them but nothing to lead them to Tomomi. Victim: Tomomi Higuchi Masaki Higuchi asks Kogoro to solve the mystery behind his wife's disappearance, which he thought was strange. As Kogoro and Conan are walking around the neighborhood, they hear Masaki arguing with someone and go to investigate. They find detective Takagi with two officers. Kogoro asks what is wrong and Masaki reveals that Takagi came to dig up his garden because they believe Masaki killed his wife and buried her in their own backyard. Masaki lets them dig stating that they will not find anything as he believes Tomomi is still alive. However the officers find Tomomi's body in the garden, much to Masaki's shock and grief. Location: Higuchi house Victim: Tomomi Higuchi Cause of death: Stab wound from pruning shears Suspects: Masaki Higuchi Takagi and some officers come and dig in the ground and find what was Tomomi's body. Masaki then becomes the prime suspect.

title.ja: 追跡！探偵タクシー

summary.en: Kogoro received a request from a Ginza barmaid working in Beika to find her missing armadillo. The woman recalled that her pet went missing on their way home around the Birinmon Bridge. She suspected that the armadillo must be in the fish market near the bridge, and worried that he (the armadillo is a male) could have been slaughtered by the fish wholesalers for meat. Location: Birinmon Fish Market Victim: Ginza barmaid's Armadillo Suspects: Birinmon Fish Market's wholesalers A barmaid in Ginza asked Kogoro to investigate a missing armadillo belonging to a her. He went to Birinmon fish market to ask the wholesalers working in Birinmon Fish Market if they saw Armadillo because she was certain that the armadillo went to that market. At the Birinmon Fish Market, Kogoro recalls his conversation with the barmaid to the tuna wholesaler to explain why he was looking for an armadillo in a fish market. The wholesaler holds his big knife and says: So you mean Birinmon Fish Market slaughtered the animal for meat? He warns the detective that they are all honest fish wholesalers before spraying water on Kogoro’s face to chase him off. Kogoro receives the same treatment for three more times with three different tuna wholesalers, for some reason. Kogoro is frustrated with the fact that he gets sprayed with water every time he asks for the armadillo’s whereabouts, so Conan suggests they both go home instead. A taxi also arrives at the location the two are standing, so they decide to have this one take them home. Inside, the driver of the taxi reveals himself to be one of Kogoro’s biggest fans, even going as far as blurting out that he wants to be married to Kogoro Mouri. The detective has no problem with this, and tells the driver to go any route he wants, as long as he drives them home. This reminds the driver about a pair of brothers he picked up yesterday because they did not use the shortest way to travel to their destination, and to thank Kogoro for using his service, he decides to do the same to Kogoro and Conan. Location: Somewhere around a park in Birinmon city (their destination) Suspects: Two singing brothers wearing sunglasses While talking to the extremely talkative taxi driver that is bringing Conan and Kogoro home, he told them about two mysterious brothers not using the fastest route to go somewhere near a park in Birinmon city. The three arrive at a parking lot that is both near a river and a park in Birinmon city. The driver asks Kogoro about the true purpose of the brothers while Kogoro, but he had been sleeping for a while, and he rushes for a toilet instead of answering the question as soon as he wakes up, leaving Conan with the driver. Meanwhile, everyone inside the park in Birinmon City is practicing for the upcoming Ghost Chimney Festival, and the noises of it catch the attention of Conan and the driver, so the two decide to go there. This festival attracts so much public attention that the organizing committee has to use a safe to keep the money made from the festival. During the event, some roads will be restricted to make it easier for that money to be transferred to the bank via their vehicle. Conan, after hearing the details of the festival, understands why the brothers chose to go the long way. He explains it to the driver and Kogoro, who has just returned from the toilet.

title.ja: 割れた金魚鉢

summary.en: Kogoro was hired by Yoshihiro Tsuchida to protect him, but failed because he is murdered. Location: Goldfish Investments company Victim: Yoshihiro Tsuchida Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Atsuko Bando and Mitsuru Kitamura When they heard a scream, Kogoro and Conan headed inside the building, and found Tsuchida dead near the entrance of his office. After Kogoro and Conan saw Tsuchida's body, they later find the dead Yuto Kajiura, president's secretary. Location: Goldfish Investments company Victim: Yuto Kaijura Cause of death: Stab wound on the chest Suspects: Atsuko Bando and Mitsuru Kitamura They then turned their heads and saw another body lying in the adjacent room, the dead Yuto Kajiura.

title.en: The Case On the Opposite Shore
title.enRaw: The Case On the Opposite Shore

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are watching birds, but Conan proposes another game to them called "human watching". While teaching the Detective Boys how the game works, trying to determine people's jobs and occupations by watching them, they stumble upon detectives Takagi and Chiba apparently on a stakeout. Location: Shibata house Victim: Mika Shibata Suspects: People at the park The police officers are on a stakeout to watch Mr. Shibata carrying the ransom. They are waiting to see who will approach him and arrest that person, since it is likely to be the kidnapper.

title.enRaw: Leading a Detective Around By the Nose

summary.en: Missing item: Mrs. Kaetsu's brooch While at his office, Kogoro receives a request from Kanae Kaetsu, a client whose mother's brooch was stolen. They have to follow letters left by the robber to find out the truth. Target: Kanae Kaetsu Attack types: Car ramming While on the road to the second location said by the robber, a car approaches them and tries to ram them, but fails to as Kogoro manages to move themselves aside. Target: Kanae Kaetsu Attack types: Falling flower pot At the third location, the duo avoid at the last minute a falling flower pot. Target: Kanae Kaetsu Attack types: Flying golf ball While going out of the fourth location, Kogoro catches a flying ball directed towards them. Nagakura murdered a diet member he hated two years ago. He was found out and arrested by Kogoro. Nagakura committed suicide before his trial began in prison.

title.ja: 完全犯罪のススメ
title.en: An Encouragement of the Perfect Crime
title.enRaw: An Encouragement of the Perfect Crime

summary.en: Takagi and Sato request Kogoro's help investigating multiple criminal activities that were plotted by the help of a mastermind. A criminal advisor who has been giving criminals plots for the "perfect crime". Target: Takashi Ishigami Modus operandi: Odorless gas explosion Culprit: Tatsumi Wada When they arrived at Hamanaka's place, they are able to solve all the current crimes Hamanaka has provided, except for one, which was ordered by Tatsumi Wada. They have to find out who is the target and where is the weapon placed.

title.ja: 坊っちゃん亭へようこそ（前編）

summary.en: Someone kicked and hit a stray cat, but it had a yellow and pink thread between his claws, which is a clue towards the culprit. They go out the veterinarian clinic an see police car, but when they go there, they see the main suspect of the cat assault case dead, in the pond of Bocchan Restaurant. While investigating, the police find out the suspects have personalities very different from the characters they play: Bocchan didn't care about justice, Nodaiko had serious anger issues, Yama Arashi was a crybaby, Madonna was in fact a skilled fighter and Red shirt did in fact care for his customers. Also, Kiyo is later revealed to not be a modest old woman, and also smokes. The next day Conan and his friends search for any clues that might have been left by the culprit in the park. They found some blood stains in a corner. To inform about the situation, they went to restaurant only to find out that the manager Red shirt had died. The main suspect for Uranari's murder, Red shirt, who was fighting along with Uranari for Madonna, is found dead with a suicide note next to him.

title.ja: 坊っちゃん亭へようこそ（後編）

summary.en: Conan decides to investigate by himself and finally figures out the truth.

title.ja: キッド VS 高明 狙われた唇（前編）

title.zhHant: 基德 VS 高明 被盯上的嘴唇（上集）
title.en: Kid vs. Komei: The Targeted Lips (Part 1)

summary.en: Heiji and Kazuha are invited by Kogoro, Ran, and Conan to Jirokichi's Suzuki Museum to witness the world's largest conch pearl, the Fairy's Lip. Once again, they meet inspector Nakamori who reveals that once again, Kaitou Kid plans to steal it, but there is another law enforcer, inspector Taka'aki Morofushi from Nagano's prefectural police. He reveals that he went to Tokyo to retrieve something that was adressed to him and that he was curious, so he assisted Nakamori's investigation. Naeji Torigoe, the Fairy's Lip's current owner, shows up and tells Jirokichi that if the jewel was to be stolen, he had to pay him back generously, with a large smirk. At the same time, Moena Yamamoto, a company employee, is able to break through security and asks Torigoe to give the jewel back, because it actually belonged to her grandfather who received it after successfully operating a rich caribbean businessman decades ago. Torigoe shoves her away and sees that he discovered it in Mie Prefecture's Ago bay just a few years ago. After listening to their conversation, Kaitou Kid, disguised as a riot squad member, decides to act and makes inspector Nakamori walk on one of his cards stuck on the floor, saying he will steal the jewel tonight. Will he succeed? The Fairy's Lip is the world's largest conch pearl, mounted on a silver ring. Its colors are fruitful and shiny, making it hard to miss.
summary.zhHans: 怪盗基德相关作品以预告、变装、宝石目标和柯南的追踪对决为核心，属于独立角色专题线。
