title.zhHans: 基德VS高明 被盯上的唇（后篇）
title.zhHant: 基德 VS 高明 被盯上的嘴唇（下集）
title.en: Kid vs. Komei: The Targeted Lips (Part 2)

summary.en: Kaitou Kid disguises as Kazuha to steal the Fairy Lip. Meanwhile Heiji wants to confess his feelings to Kazuha, who in fact is Kid in disguise. Will they succeed in their missions?
summary.zhHans: 怪盗基德相关作品以预告、变装、宝石目标和柯南的追踪对决为核心，属于独立角色专题线。

title.ja: 二つの素顔（前編）

summary.en: Kogoro is hired by a beautiful woman called Masako Muto, a housewife, to search her husband Issei Mutou, a company president. Kogoro and Conan then go to Muto's residence, but found nothing except Issei's name card. When Conan and Kogoro arrives to his "company", they discover that it was only a virtual company. Later, Masako hands over Issei's wallet found by the police to Kogoro, and using the receipt inside the wallet, Conan found out a place where Issei might be. It turns out to be a second-hand factory owned by Issei. When they finds Issei, he scares and says that he lied to his wife because he wasn't a company president, but a factory owner. Kogoro then says that he doesn't need to give up and that his wife still needs him, persuades him to return to his house with her wife and tell the truth. Masako then thanks to Kogoro for all and says that she is happy with her husband. But all the happiness go away in any time. In the chapter end, a silhouette appears pouring gasoline to a body and then setting it on fire, most likely the body is Issei Muto's.

title.ja: 二つの素顔（後編）

summary.en: Kogoro and Conan discover that an employee called Sadahiko Nonaka is missing. Meanwhile the police investigate, Conan find some clues and discover a shocking truth.

title.ja: 会社解散パーティー

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are eating at a restaurant. At the same moment, in the restaurant's private room, a company is having dissolution party. But after giving a speech, the company president, Jiro Kureno falls dead onto the floor. Location: Restaurant private dining room Cause of death: Poison needle Suspects: Junnosuke Toda, Hiroo Kamijou, Eiji Koshimoto, and Mayu Narita After receiving rose bouquet, Jiro suddenly feeling pain, before collapse onto the floor.The murder weapon was a needle with poison in the rose bouquet. After the interrogatory, Eiji Koshimoto, merchandise manager and former college of the president went to the toilet, but he did not come back. Later, a waitress finds Koshimoto strangled with a suicide note in his body. Location: Restaurant storage room Victim: Eiji Koshimoto Cause of death: Strangulation

title.ja: いがみ合う乙女達

summary.en: Ran, Sonoko, and Conan are in the shopping mall, where they meet model girls promoting a new toy seal. Later, they heard a scream, and found one of the models is dead. Accident? or Murder? Location: Beika shopping mall storage room Time: Around 2:30 PM Cause of death: Falling Suspects: Mina Komoro, Mai Fukamoto, and Yuko Oyodo After hearing a loud scream, Sonoko, Conan and Ran head to the storage room only to find Mai Fukamoto pointing towards Ayaka's corpse. After early investigations by the police, a letter addressed to Mai and was found. They also found Mai's brooch near the crime scene. All suspicion goes towards Mai, even though she denies it. Conan then investigate and found out the real culprit.

title.ja: 歩美の絵日記事件簿
title.zhHans: 步美的绘画日记事件簿
title.zhHant: 步美的圖繪日記事件簿
title.en: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary
title.enRaw: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary

summary.en: One day, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are walking to school, when they notice Sadaharu Nishimura, Masako Ogino, and Yuji Fujioka admiring an expensive watch displayed at Kaneko Jewelry Store. The watch itself is only one of five produced around the world. After school, they meet Takagi, who is handing out leaflets about robbery around the district. Conan then start thinking about the possibility of the watch being stolen. Location: Kaneko jewelry store Target: "Blue Diamond Limited Tourbillon Cage No.3" watch Suspects: Keita Kaneko, Sadaharu Nishimura, Masako Ogino, Yuji Fujioka, and Kumazawa Construction employees Several days later, Ayumi shows her picture diary book to Conan. After seeing the pictures in the diary, Conan deduces the culprit.

title.ja: オートマティック悲劇（前編）

summary.en: A young man called Fusaya Oide arrives in front of the Mouri detective agency, wanting to hire Kogoro to solve the mystery of the death of his father, Raita Oide. Last week at 4:30, Oide Raita falls asleep onto the floor, only to later die. At the same time, a robber enters the house to steal whatever belongings they can find. Kogoro and Conan then met An Oide, the daughter of Raita and older sister of Fusaya, and Io Oide, the victim's wife and Fusaya's mother. Suddenly, due to the shock of losing her husband, Io loses consciousness. Meanwhile the ambulance takes Io to the hospital, Kogoro and Conan see a strange woman smiling. Later, Conan and Kogoro find out that an employee of Tebai engineering called Yasushi Taira was the robber. He robbed the house while Raita Oide was sleeping on the floor. However, it turns out that he was not the murderer. So, the robbery-murder case was two separate cases.

title.ja: オートマティック悲劇（後編）

summary.en: The true identity of the woman is Kuremi Soho, who also is a pharmacist and a former classmate of An Oide. She was jealous of An's engagement, but she was not the culprit of his father's death.

title.ja: 町家カフェでの事件

summary.en: Ran, Sonoko, and Conan are in a townhouse cafe, when later, the manager Satoshi Tomita is found unconscious on the floor. Location: "Sweets" cafe Victim: Satoshi Tomita Injury: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Chitose Sakai, Kenji Nonaka, and Yoshihisa Furukawa When Nonaka enters the bathroom, he discovers the manager lying on the floor after being struck in the head. The suspects are a part-time worker, a cafe owner in the neighborhood and a customer. The police suspects Nonaka because he didn't have an alibi, but Conan, with help of some clues, discovers the real culprit.

title.ja: 代役・京極真（前編）

summary.en: Conan, Ran, Sonoko, Masumi, and Makoto are walking on the street after watching a movie, when they find a man taking a woman hostage. Fortunately, Makoto knocks down the criminal to later see Shigematsu Tomioka telling that all of the scene was a drama shooting. Since the actor was unconscious, Makoto is chosen as the understudy. They later meet an actor, an actress, a production assistant and a makeup artist. The actor, Saiya Tokuzono is so annoying because he made a joke by making the actress, Nanako Jinmei to sign an autograph using an electric pen. When Makoto and Tokuzono go to an abandoned building, the staff prepares to film some scenes. When the director asks for Tokuzono, the actor suddenly screams and falls, and Makoto is the main suspect because he was in the same floor when the murder took place. When Conan, the girls, and the staff are in the yard of the building, they see Tokuzono falling from the window, and later see Makoto checking from the same window where the actor fell. The police investigate the scene and also include the staff as suspects. Later, the assistant director finds something in the room of the murder. After looking at the camera recordings, the assistant director, Daisaku Odori somehow managed to figure out the identity of the murderer and starts to blackmail the culprit.

title.ja: 代役・京極真（中編）

summary.en: Conan discovers some clues but he has not discover the culprit yet. Sera starts asking Ran about Shinichi's sickness and where Conan was when Shinichi was around. Conan later learns about the deceased production assistant called Nishibe, who was also Hideka's boyfriend. When all of the staff were drinking some drinks that were bought by Yota and Takagi, the assistant director suddenly falls poisoned onto the ground. When all the staff were drinking some drinks bought by Yota and Takagi, Odori suddenly falls onto the floor while checking his phone. Later, Sera almost discovers Conan's true identity after he responds normally when she called him Shinichi Kudo.

title.ja: 代役・京極真（後編）

summary.en: Conan tries to convince Sera that he is not Shinichi, but Sera does not believe him. She then asks Ran and Sonoko if there is any child that looked more mature around Conan, and they both mention Haibara. While playing games with the Detective Boys at Agasa Residence, Haibara tells Agasa that thirty years ago, her father worked as a member of Shirohato Pharmaceuticals R&D team. However, the company went bankrupt twenty-five years ago and her parents decided to open a small clinic. Meanwhile, after some investigation, Conan solves the case using Sonoko's voice.

title.ja: 能ある鷹は罪を隠す
title.en: The Skilled Hawk Hides His Crime
title.enRaw: The Skilled Hawk Hides His Crime

summary.en: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran are in the mountains when they see a hawk, Kogoro disturb the hawk but is stopped by a falconer called Tetsu Akashiba. He yells angrily at him to be careful with hawks. Later, they are at Takehara Cafe, a cafe managed by Genichi Takehara and his wife Satoko, where a festival is being held. They also meet a local farmer called Masahiko Ishima who made puffed rice. The cafe owner later goes hunting boar. The main event of the festival is sending the hawk to a target. When the hawk is arriving to the target, the hawk suddenly falls down and a gunshot is heard. They found Genichi Takehara dead. Victim: Genichi Takehara Cause of death: Gunshot wound on chest Suspects: Tetsu Akashiba, Satoko Takehara, and Masahiko Ishima When the hawk almost finish the race, it falls to the floor and a gunshot sound is heard. Not long after that, the cafe owner is falling dead onto the floor. The police arrives and investigates. It seems to be an accident, but is this true? After finding a few clues, Conan discovers the culprit and the trick behind this murder.

title.ja: スマイルの里の陰謀

summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys are invited to "Smile Village" elderly facility. Suprisingly, the old women who live there are fans of the Detective Boys, and they are very rich. The Detective Boys then have suspicion on the owners. Location: Smile Village Victims: Azami Azagami, Botan Hotaka, Sumire Sumida and Sakura Sakuma Age: 77 years old (Azami and Sumire), 73 years old (Botan) and 78 years old (Sakura) Type: Nursing home scam Culprits: Tango Hohoemi, Waltz Hohoemi and Ondo Shibuzura (?) After seeing the owners' bizarre smiles, the Detective Boys decide to further investigate their whereabouts. While spying on them, they learn that the couple wants to use the old women's money that they are managing to buy resorts in Dubai.

title.ja: 憎しみのフライパン

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are invited by "Oshiro" Venture Company for attending the demonstration of their new frying pan. After the demo, the president, Naoyuki Omura, is scheduled to give a speech, but he is found dead in his office. Location: Venture Company "Oshiro" President's Office Victim: Naoyuki Omura Cause of death: Stab wound on chest Suspects: Masakazu Koshiro While the police are investigating, an explosion occurs at the research building, and they found Masakazu Koshiro lying dead, along with a suicide note. Location: Venture Company "Oshiro" Research Building Victim: Masakazu Koshiro Cause of death: Explosion Suspects: Naoyuki Omura Conan later found president's wallet and a bloody knife in the research building, while the police discover a bottle of slepping pills and a gas valve in president's office. The police conclude that both the president and the chief plan to kill each other. However, after discovering hamburger sauce stain on president's office wall, and some melting metal on research building AC controller, Conan discovered the true culprit.

title.ja: 迷惑な親切心

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are in a restaurant, when they overheard Tomoya Kusano talking about his kindness to his friend Hajime Yamanashi. Conan notice an angry suspicious man in hoodie. Later, Tomoya Kusano is found dead in the toilet. Victim: Tomoya Kusano Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Shin Kotani The police investigate the scene and the man in hoodie, Shin Kotani, seems worried. Is he the culprit?

title.ja: ピアノソナタ『月光』殺人事件（前編）
title.zhHans: 钢琴奏鸣曲《月光》杀人事件（前篇）
title.zhHant: 鋼琴奏鳴曲《月光》殺人事件（上集）（重製版）

summary.en: Kogoro recieved a strange letter from a man named Keiji Asoh, asking him to investigate something on Tsukikage Island in the Izu coast, under Tokyo's jurisdiction. Kogoro, Ran, and Conan go to the island to only discover that Keiji Asoh had died twelve years ago. Keiji Asoh killed his family, set his house on fire, and played Beethoven's Moonlight Sonata as his house burnt around him. They then meet Narumi Asai, who told them where to meet the mayor. At the community center, they discovered a room with a piano, where the former mayor was found dead two years ago. Two years ago, Kazuaki Hirata heard the Moonlight Sonata playing from the community center and discovered the body of the mayor slumped over the piano. Although he died from heart attack, the similarity to the death of Keiji Asoh caused the islanders to think the piano has been cursed. While the group are waiting outside, suddenly the first movement of Moonlight Sonata is played, and Hideo Kawashima was found dead in the piano room. Hideo Kawashima's sodden body found slumped over the cursed community piano as the first movement of Beethoven's Moonlight Sonata played in the background. Water marks show the body had been dragged to the piano through a back door in the piano room which leads to the sea. Conan then realized that the murder will happened again, and they decide to sleep at the piano room, along with the policeman and Narumi Asai.

title.ja: ピアノソナタ『月光』殺人事件（後編）
title.zhHans: 钢琴奏鸣曲《月光》杀人事件（后篇）
title.zhHant: 鋼琴奏鳴曲《月光》殺人事件（下集）（重製版）

summary.en: Conan realised that the music sheet left with the victims are codes. The old policeman then revealed that Keiji Asoh left some music sheets in his safe. While they are trying to unlock the community center storage room, Conan heard a sound coming from piano room. He then saw a suspicious person checking below the piano. Conan try to chase the person, but the person ran away. Conan tripped and found Shuichi Murasawa unconsious on the floor. Not long after that, Ken Nishimoto is found hanged in the storage room, along with music sheets. Ran found Ken Nishimoto's hanged body in the storage room. At his feet was coded sheet music purporting to be his will. Although it wasn't playing, the third movement of Moonlight Sonata was recorded on the tape cassette nearby. After looking at Keiji Asoh's last music sheets, Conan realized who is the culprit.

title.ja: 米花商店街ダストミステリー
title.zhHant: 米花商店街的垃圾之謎
title.en: The Beika City Shopping Center Garbage Bin Mystery
title.enRaw: The Beika City Shopping Center Garbage Bin Mystery

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys found out that each morning new trash are appearing at the site where there used to be a garbage bin. Meanwhile, there is an arguement between Beika shopping center store association members about whether they should use store association budget to reinstall new garbage bin. At the same moment, Ran's teacher asked the class to submit ideas for entertaining the guests coming to Tokyo for WSG. Mysterious Appearances Location: Beika Shopping Center Appearing objects: Trash Suspects: Beika shopping center store association members, crows After cleaning all day the streets of the shopping center, the Detective Boys notice that each morning, new trash appears at the site where there used to be a garbage bin. They have to stop the serial litterer.

title.ja: 36 マスの完全犯罪（前編）

summary.en: Kogoro received a letter from someone called Taisei Nichihara, asking him to investigate the suicide of his old friend, along with a piece of paper containing a cipher that is claimed to have been found at the feet of the body. Kogoro, along with Conan, Amuro, and Wakita then arrived at an abandoned church deep in the mountains of Nagano. They later meet five other guests who are high school classmates of Taisei Nichihara, and revealed that Nichihara is the one who committed suicide. Suddenly, the nearby parking lot collapses, and all cars parked there fall into the ravine. Amuro notices that the parking lot sign is brand new, despite the church being very old. Wakita senses that there will be serial murders happening. Unfortunately, the Nagano police can't come to the church, because the tunnel that leads to the church was blocked by a snow avalanche. Komei then smells gunpowder around the avalanche, implying that the avalanche was caused by a human. The nine people are forced to spend a night in the church.

title.ja: 36 マスの完全犯罪（中編）

summary.en: Kogoro then informs the Nagano police about the murder. He later sends a video of the crime scene. While watching the video, Komei notices Amuro, and feels that he has met Amuro somewhere before. Meanwhile, Amuro suggests that they form pairs. Fujide with Koura, Nishino with Kawasaki, Conan with Amuro, and Kogoro with Wakita. Conan and Amuro then decide to go investigate the toilet first. They talk about who might be the culprit. Suddenly, Conan asks Amuro if he knows RUM. Amuro replies that no matter whether he answers that he has met RUM or not, Conan will start investigating everyone around him, so he can only tell Conan that RUM is impatient. Meanwhile in the chapel, the others hear some odd noise. Nishino then decides to draw by lot again which pair should check the noise, this time using mint cases. In the end, Nishino and Kawasaki are the ones who check the noise. After Amuro and Conan return, Nishino suddenly enters the chapel hurriedly, asking who is sending messages to Kawasaki and making him head to the bath. Later, they hear Kawasaki's scream, and when they arrive, Kawasaki is dead. Amuro deduces that Kawasaki got poisoned by cyanide, but Wakita finds out that there is no cyanide in the water Kawasaki consumed. They also find another code sheet on the floor. Unfortunately, Kogoro can't contact the Nagano police because there is no service.

title.ja: 36 マスの完全犯罪（後編）

summary.en: Nishino decides to lock himself in the study room until the police arrive. Meanwhile, Amuro thinks that since the culprit invited nine people, there must be something related to the number 'nine'. All four detectives then find out who the culprit is.

title.ja: 毒を入れたのは誰

summary.en: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are at the party venue hosted by Kogoro's client, Shuji Sasano, the second president of Sasano Finance. Sasano had received a death threat. Apparently, the three guests who came to the venue had a grudge against the president. Later, Sasano collapses after drinking a glass of wine. He was poisoned. Kogoro and Kobayakawa then show the suspicious movements of the guests caught by the surveillance cameras installed. Suddenly, Kobayakawa reveals that he is the real Shuji Sasano, and it turns out that the one murdered is Kobayakawa. Location: Party Venue Victim: Rokuro Kobayakawa Cause of death: Poison from the wine? Suspects: Shintaro Toki, Terumi Hanaoka, Akira Enoshima, Kimiyuki Tachikawa, and Nanase Oizumi After the murder, it turns out all the people there has motives to murder Sasano, or rather disguised Kobayakawa. His guests were tricked in the past with Sasano finance company's dirty metods to gain money, the maid is his first tricked victim's daughter and the chef, who it turns out is the maid's boyfriend hated Sasano and defended her girlfriend. Conan starts investigating and finally solves the case.

title.ja: 復讐者（前編）

summary.en: When Megure, Takagi, and Chiba arrived at Yoji Natsukawa's office, they meet Kogoro and Conan. Kogoro and Conan decide to assist them. The group then meet Yoji Natsukawa, Miyako Akiba, and Ryuzaburo Fuyuki. Natsukawa says that no one have a grudge against Haruyama, while both Akiba and Fuyuki don't know about Haruyama. The next day, Kogoro and Conan decide to question Natsukawa, but they found him dead instead. Natsukawa is also found dead in his office with the same method from the previous murder. After that, Akiba and Fuyuki admit that ten years ago, four of them cheated Takashi Komoto out of a large sum of money. Komoto then left Japan. One day, Haruyama saw Komoto peering into his shop. No one believed him until he was murdered. The police then found out that Komoto returned to Japan one week ago. They also found the hotel where he was staying and collect his fingerprints, confirming that he is the murderer. Komoto also revealed to a hotel employee that he has an incurable illness. The next day, Chiba accompanies Akiba to Shikigawa Valley. Suddenly, there is a loud noise, so Chiba goes check the noise. Not long after that, Komoto appears and attempts to stab Akiba. When Chiba goes to check the strange noise, Komoto appears and attemps to stab Akiba. Akiba manage to avoid the knife. Unfortunately, Komoto slips and fall down into the river. However, his body is never been found. He also hasn't show up at the hospital.

title.ja: 復讐者（後編）

summary.en: That night, Fuyuki received another phone call from the culprit, admitted that he is not Komoto. He suggested that Fuyuki would pay him a large sum of money in exchange for not getting killed. Kogoro deduced that it is a trap. The next day, the police secure the area around Fuyuki's office, but Kogoro and Conan decide to investigate the case more. After question the witnesses, Conan deduced the culprit.

title.ja: 落とし物は事件のにおい
title.en: The Lost Article That Smells Like a Case
title.enRaw: The Lost Article That Smells Like a Case

summary.en: Ayumi found a bracelet at the park. Conan then notice tire tracks and bloodstains in front of the park. Victim: Shinobu Yamaki Missing object: Bracelet They then found the owner, Shinobu Yamaki. However, when they arrive at his house, they are greeted by his sister, Risa Yamaki. They return the bracelet to Risa. Conan decide to follow Risa, and found out that Risa could not contact her brother for a week. She visits her brother's friend, Yutaka Oi, who says that Shinobu might meet Yagi or Kogure. Conan later is discovered by Detective Boys following Risa, thus losing her. They decide to split up looking for Risa. Risa then visit Keita Yagi. After hearing about Shinobu disappearance's and the bracelet, Yagi decide to help her. The Detective Boys later manage to find Yagi's apartment and ask if Risa visited him, but he admit that he did not meet anyone that day. Meanwhile, Risa is being tied on the sofa. Location: Yagi's apartment

title.ja: 笑顔を消したアイドル

summary.en: The officer Futoshi Yamasato just got transferred to Beika Town 4th block police box on that day, when he received a report about dine and dash. However, after arriving at the restaurant, the case have been resolved. The waitress feels that the woman who did dine and dash looks like Kayoko Kakurai, whom he is a big fan. Location: Restaurant Danny's Dining Victims: Waitress and manager Time: Earlier that day Culprit: Kayoko Kakurai? At Mouri detective agency, Yamasato tell Kogoro that similar case also happened three months ago when he worked at Haido Town police box. Dine and Dash (Past) Location: Sasai New Haido Ramen Culprit: Kayoko Kakurai? He also tell the fact that on the evening the dine and dash happened at Haido, there was a DDPP handshake event at Haido City Hall. Kayoko Kakurai is so popular at that event because of her smile, and the other DDPP members starting to get jealous of her. They start bullying her, and as the result, her smile disappered from her face. Currently, Kayoko Kakurai is having a hiatus after that incident. Unfortunately, Kogoro suddenly asleep because he drank too much beer. Later, Ran arrives at home and says that she, Sonoko, and Sera saw Kayoko Kakurai at Beika Park in a van with her manager. Suddenly, Kakurai started to cry. Conan then solve the case using Kogoro's voice.

title.ja: 山菜狩りとクローバー（前編）

summary.en: Maika Zenda decides to kill her would be husband, Toji Fukikoshi, in front of his villa. Several hours later, Zenda picks up the Detective Boys, along with their teachers at the station. Using Zenda's car, they go to pick wild plants. Later, while Ayumi and Zenda are searching for Zenda's earring, Conan, Haibara, and Rumi find Fukikoshi's body under the tree just next to the rear of the car. Yamamura arrives and investigates the scene. He finds out that when the Detective Boys took a photo immediately after arriving, there was no corpse under the tree. Yamamura's assistant then reveals that Fukikoshi is a marriage swindler wanted by the police. Meanwhile, Ayumi is searching for a four-leaf clover, which was found while she was searching for Zenda's earring. Ayumi plans to give the clover to Zenda as a lucky charm. Hearing that, Rumi recalls Kohji Haneda's dead body and covers her right eye.

title.ja: 山菜狩りとクローバー（後編）

summary.en: Yamamura's assistant finds the villa where the murder happened. Inside the villa, there was a woman whose hands were covered with blood. Yamamura suspects the woman to be the culprit. Conan later finds the four-leaf clover, and realizes how the body suddenly appeared under the tree.

title.ja: 愛しすぎた男
title.en: The Man Who Loved Too Much
title.enRaw: The Man Who Loved Too Much

summary.en: When Kogoro and Conan are going to buy some ingredients for dinner, they run into a crime scene in a house owned by a couple. It seems that the victim was burglarizing the house and that the husband killed him in self defense when he was about to attack his wife. However, Conan found out some evidences showing that the couple is lying. Location: Sakuragawa household Victim: Susumu Masuoka Cause of death: Blunt-force trauma Suspects: Shohei Sakuragawa

title.ja: 魔王と呼ばれた小説家
title.en: The Novelist Known as the Demon King
title.enRaw: The Novelist Known as the Demon King

summary.en: Kogoro and Conan happens to walk by a famous writer's house. They see patrol cars surrounding the house and meet Megure and Takagi. Takagi reveals the famous writer was found shot to death in his house. Both Kogoro and Conan check the crime scene with Megure and Takagi. Location: Shintaro Tawake's house Victim: Shintaro Tawake Cause of death: Gunshot wound on abdomen Suspects: Naoya Akaike, Miyuki Degawa, Ryunosuke Bito, and Haruo Chigasaki Seemingly, the victim Tawake was shot while he was sleeping on the sofa. In addition, the victim was killed in a room that sunlight isn't permitted to pass through, due to the north-facing window the room possess. The estimated time of death is around noon, and most likely he was shot by the shotgun that was tossed nearby the sofa. After a tremendous search with regards to the crime scene, Conan discovered several clues that might come handy towards the case. Firstly, there are blood stains scattered on that north-facing window. However, surprisingly, the curtains aren't contaminated by the blood stain. This implies that the crime might have been carried out with the curtains opened and was closed by the culprit in all likelihood. If that is the case, then why didn't the culprit bother to do that? Secondly, the house that is located in front of that north-facing window seems to be vacant, which all shutters of it are closed. This is a great environment for the crime because that it will not be spotted by the neighbour, plus that there is also a construction going around nearby this conceals the sound of the shotgun. Last but not least, the forensics guy come across with a wooden tiny bench which has blood deposited as well. Conan once again contemplates: "Why would that be necessary?" Tawake's four apprentices discussing the case. After a while, Conan and the police meets the four apprentices of Tawake. The cropse was discovered by Akaike and Degawa, they all claim that they didn't touch the crime scene. Owing to the death of this mystery author, Akaike then cancels the appointment of dentist he asked yesterday which was instructed by Tawake himself. Through their conversations, the police notices that they all call their teacher the "Demon King". The reason turns out to be that Tawake forces his apprentices to be ghost writers for him. That is, to write books for him, and publish it with only a few modifications of his. Furthermore, Tawake's reputation doesn't look so great according to his apprentices. He had always pledged them that they will gain the chance to debut one day if they persistently write books for him. Nonetheless, that isn't the case as he lied towards them. As the four of them have don't get along with the victim very well, they now become the crucial suspects of the case, this leads to the verification of their alibis. Finally, they were only able to confirm Akaike's alibi. The rest was apparently writing when the crime was implemented, so they don't have alibis, they then get into a quarrel to blame each other for the crime. Since the victim was fed with sleeping pills before his death, Akaike deduces the murderer must be an outsider because if the culprit is capable of slipping the pill, he will also be able to just directly poison him. "Is this the truth?" Conan looked at himself in doubt. "Wait a minute," the bloodstain behind the curtains, the noisy construction area, the north-facing window, the contaminated wooden bench, as well as... The shotgun that belongs to the victim... These trivial clues have now jointed together, Conan then picks up a small piece of aluminium foil from the floor. All of his perplex have now faded away utterly, he chuckled: "I have finally figured out the trick that the culprit used."

title.ja: 張り込み

summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys see Chiba at convenience store, so they decide to follow him to a newly constructed apartment where he is on stakeout with Takagi. They are looking for the person who robbed a jewelry store among the third floor residents of the apartment across the street. Location: A jewelry store in Haido Suspects: Kasumi Amano, Mitsuki Hanai, and Tsunahiko Kuwai They are having stakeout on the residents after they caught a serial bulgar who has the rings from the jewelry store and testified that they stole it from third floor rooms of the apartment. Victim: All third floor residents Time: Several days ago Robbed items: Rings from the jewelry store Culprit: Unnamed arrested robber Later, in order to see if there is some jewelry left inside the rooms, the Detective Boys decide to throw their toys to the balcony of each room, and pretend to take the toy.

title.ja: モノレール狙撃事件（前編）
title.zhHans: 单轨电车狙击事件（前篇）
title.zhHant: 單軌列車狙擊事件（上集）

summary.en: While riding the Yurikamome Line towards Wangan Island, Kogoro and Conan witness a man sitting next to them getting shot through the arm from the window. After stopping the bleeding with a scarf borrowed from another passenger, they order the train to stop and explain the situation to a station employee through a phone call. After staff arrived, Kogoro and Conan run towards the place where the culprit could have shot from and ask the staff to call the police. By looking around the surroundings, Conan figures out the shooter must have been posted in a particular apartment building and he convinces Kogoro to go with him there. At the MPD, Megure sends Takagi to the crime location.

title.ja: モノレール狙撃事件（後編）
title.zhHans: 单轨电车狙击事件（后篇）
title.zhHant: 單軌列車狙擊事件（下集）

summary.en: The group consisting of Kogoro, Conan and Takagi later arrive at the fish market. A police officer already stationed there informs them of something having happened in the parking lot. There, they find a wholesaler who has been assaulted probably by the same man they are pursuing, since he says that he was attacked from behind after noticing a large bag, most likely containing the body. Since his clothes and his turret truck were stolen, the group deduces that the culprit used them to blend in with the wholesalers. Detective Chiba then calls them from MPD and informs them that he has gathered information regarding the resident of apartment 505. The resident is Ichiro Akiyama, a leasing company worker who recently went unemployed, and a suspect in a robbery from four months ago. The drivers were delivering 150 million yen to the bank, but they were robbed by two people. One of them might be Ichiro Akiyama, but he had an alibi at the time of the robbery.

title.ja: 骨董盆は隠せない（前編）
title.zhHant: 無法隱藏的古董盤（上集）
title.en: The Antique Tray Can't Be Hidden (Part 1)

summary.en: Agasa tells Conan that he hired an antique appraiser to appraise an antique tray that he got from the treasure hunt back then. Meanwhile, Haibara is disturbed by Sera who is observing the house. Conan then explain how Sera was suspicious about her. Subaru then visits the professor, allowing Sera to come inside. Before Sera can ask anything, Subaru interrupts her by asking Agasa about the appraisal. Agasa says that he is just on the way to get the result. Agasa also mentions that the appraiser wants to show the Chinese black lacquer tray which is said to be worth 100 million yen. Three people own the same tray, and they hire the same appraiser. At first, Sera doesn't want to come along, so that she can talk to Haibara who seems not interested too. However, when Haibara also wants to come along, Sera suddenly wants to. They decide to go to the appraiser's house using Agasa's car. Upon arriving, Agasa tries to call the appraiser, Hogen Nishitsu, but there is no response, so he goes inside to search for Nishitsu. Meanwhile, Nishitsu is showing the real antique tray to someone and telling the person that the tray is not theirs. Hearing that, the person knock out Nishitsu using a spear. Before they manage to retrieve the tray, they hear Agasa's voice.

title.ja: 骨董盆は隠せない（中編）
title.zhHant: 無法隱藏的古董盤（中集）
title.en: The Antique Tray Can't Be Hidden (Part 2)

summary.en: During the investigation, Sera remarks that Haibara uses a difficult expression for a first-year grade school student. She begins to ask if Haibara also took the same thing Conan did. Subaru then interrupts her, saying that nowadays grade school students have smartphones to look up anything. He also mentioned that Agasa often uses complicated words, so that it wouldn't be odd if Haibara uses some of his words. Later, Agasa tells the police about the bloody fingerprints at the back of the real tray. However, it turns out that the culprit has put the same bloody mark on the other two trays. Agasa then mentions that when the tray was flipped sideways, the crane's beak is at the same spot as the blood. However, after flipping the trays with the blood at the top, none of the crane's beak is at the same spot as the blood. Sera then asks Subaru how he immediately recognized her as a girl despite she was wearing a helmet. Subaru answers her that her bottom is quite feminine. Conan then asks Subaru why he doesn't tell Sera about him. Subaru says that he wants to keep Sera out as much as possible.

title.ja: 骨董盆は隠せない（後編）
title.zhHant: 無法隱藏的古董盤（下集）
title.en: The Antique Tray Can't Be Hidden (Part 3)

summary.en: Chiba comes back and brings a small box that Nishitsu want to show the clients according to the housekeeper. It is Agasa's box that contains the dish he asked Nishitsu to appraise. Later, Subaru, Conan, and Sera take a look at the dish and noticed that there is a bare crack mark on the dish. Subaru then flips the dish sideways. Suddenly, three of them realized something. Conan then asks Agasa about the crane's beak direction. After asking Chiba about any bloodstain in one of the boxes, Conan, Sera, and Subaru know the culprit's identity and the owner of the real tray.

title.ja: 悪友たちの輪舞

summary.en: Three people who are troublemakers are found dead. After the police found 30 million yen in Yasuho Shida's apartment, Conan suspects that they are the culprit of the robbery three days ago. Victim: Takeshi Mitsumoto Cause of death: Blunt-force trauma Suspects: Yorimitsu Hosaka Victim: Yorimitsu Hosaka Cause of death: Stab wound in the chest Suspects: Yasuho Shida Location: Apartament Victim: Yasuho Shida Cause of death: Poison inside a bottle Suspects: Takeshi Mitsumoto Location: Haido City Suspects: Takeshi Mitsumoto, Yorimitsu Hosaka, and Yasuho Shida Three days ago, 30 million yen in cash was stolen from a financier in Haido City. He was robbed by three masked men. Conan deduces that they become greedy and decide to kill each other. Later, Chiba meet a child named Mamoru Nishikawa, who saw a suspicious man trying to enter Shida's apartment. Chiba later suspects the victim's middle school teacher, Kokichi Minamide. Chiba discovers that Minamide had tried to reform those three victim's behavior during middle school, but his efforts never paid off. Chiba deduced that Minamide decide to kill them after he heard that they stole 30 million yen. In the end, Minamide is confirmed to have an alibi. They continue to search the suspicious man. Meanwhile, Conan ask Mamoru more about the suspicious man. He later found the suspicious man in another apartment building.

title.ja: 呪いのミュージアム

summary.en: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko are visiting Ancient Oriental Culture Museum to buy the famous Egyptian god keychain. When they are going to pay the keychain, the Anubis statue falls onto Hiroaki Uchida's body, and he is found dead. Location: Ancient Oriental Culture museum Victim: Hiroaki Uchida Cause of death: Blunt force trauma from the falling Anubis statue Suspects: Ken Kowata, Takuto Ishikawa, Yuko Uchida, and Kiyoshi Yamada The museum director, Ken Kowata, feared that it is Anubis' curse, but Conan notice that there is a wound on the victim's head. He also notice the broken platform where the statue was, which seems has been tampered with. From the security camera, they found out that his wife, Yuko Uchida, also visited the museum that day, along with another visitor, Kiyoshi Yamada. Conan also suspects the museum director and his employee. All of the suspects have no solid alibi. Takagi decides to check the victim's and the suspects' backgrounds. He finds out that Hiroaki was involved in many minor crimes, like cheating, brawling, and debt. Later, he receives a phone call from the museum director, who admits that he knows the culprit. However, the culprit is approaching Kowata, and he ends the call. The police rush to the museum, only to find Kowata is being cursed by Anubis. He drops the guest book before being taken to the police station. Conan then finds out that Yuko has written some code that refers to the place where she will meet someone in the guest book.

title.ja: 汽笛の聞こえる古書店 3
title.zhHant: 能聽見汽笛聲的舊書店 3

summary.en: Michiko Yoshikawa invites the Detective Boys to Kosuke Omura's writing class, as she wants to learn how to write a novel. The class is held at Ryoji Nojima's house, who sponsored Omura for his books. When Nojima reads how the children write a story, he decides to take them to the basement, where he keeps many valuable books. He asks the group to start reading the book he handled for references. During lunch break, Michiko reveals that she cut her finger on a book. Ayumi then gives Michiko a band-aid. Moments later, she suddenly collapsed. She is later taken to the hospital. Location: Ryoji Nojima's house Victim: Michiko Yoshikawa Injury: Poison from a book cover? Suspects: Ryoji Nojima, Kosuke Omura, and Nagisa Takeuchi The police found out that one of the book has a highly-concentrated poison on it. Conan then realizes that the book cover color is Paris Green. It is later being confirmed by Yujiro Tamaki that it is the color that was produced using a powerful poison in the past. Michiko most likely touched the book unconsiously. However, after Conan found a book with bloodstains and a scratch on the shelf, he knows who is the culprit.

title.ja: 大岡紅葉の挑戦状（前編）
title.zhHans: 大冈红叶的挑战书（前篇）
title.zhHant: 大岡紅葉的挑戰書（上集）

summary.en: As Ran came home, she recieve a message from Momiji Ooka, asking Shinichi to solve some code from a deceased housekeeper of a wealthy family. Some hours ago, she also asked Heiji to solve the code, promising that he will do whatever she want if he solve the code faster than anyone. They later gather at Haido Chuo Building roof. Later they arrive at a pancake shop, where there is a huge line. When Momiji mention about add and subtract, Conan and Heiji solve the code. All the code has a sentence written "From your footbowl loving mother". The first three codes has the word "foot" in bold. The character for foot can also mean "add". Meanwhile, the last code has the word "bow" in bold. The character for bow can also mean "subtract". When all the codes are laid over each other, there is a sentence written Haido Harbor Warehouse 4. However, both of them solved the code simultaneously. They later followed the decoded message and headed to the said location What they found there was, a murder scene. The eldest son of the four brothers is found dead. Ran, Kazuha, and Momiji scream after seeing the body.

title.ja: 大岡紅葉の挑戦状（後編）
title.zhHans: 大冈红叶的挑战书（后篇）
title.zhHant: 大岡紅葉的挑戰書（下集）

summary.en: The police come and investigate the scene. The victim and the three suspects are brothers, whose mother is the said housekeeper who make the code. They all have burn marks on their palm, as a result of saving their mother from a jingisukan pot 30 years ago. Momiji and Hattori finds out that on the harbor, there will be a yearly lovely spot for great social media posts. Heiji plans to confess to Kazuha, while Momiji plans to stop him. The three brothers mention that the first brother was giving away a watch with leather band and a leather jacket. However, when the other brothers give him some canned crabs, chocolate, and nuts, they were returned back. Conan then realized who is the culprit.

title.ja: 言えない目撃者

summary.en: A random attacker is targeting women. Two victims survived, but Himena Shinozaki is not lucky. Location: In front of Hikaru Komori's apartment Victim: Himena Shinozaki Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Mysterious man Someone named Hikaru, who lived near the crime scene, witnesses the murder. The next day, the police are investigating the crime scene when Kogoro, Conan, and Ran appears. Conan notices that someone is looking from a house nearby. A woman tells him that it is Komori residence, where Hikaru and his mother live. Hikaru is known as shut-in, currently unemployed, and a Yoko Okino's big fan. Kogoro and Conan try to question Hikaru, but he only text his mother that he did not see anything. Conan deduces that Hikaru might actually see something or the culprit might saw Hikaru. Later, Conan notice that one of Hikaru's shoes is dirtier than other shoes. His mother then realizes that some Yoko Okino sneakers is missing. Kogoro, Conan, and Ran decide to go home. When there is a news coverage about Yoko Okino Dome Tour, Conan realizes what actually happened.

title.ja: カーテンの向こう側

summary.en: Agasa and the Detective Boys are having dinner at a restaurant. Mitsuhiko notices silhouettes of two people sitting in front of each other from the apartment across the restaurant and informs the others. The man approaches the woman and seemingly wants to kiss her. However, the man suddenly starts attacking the woman. Location: Yuko Kokubun's apartment Victim: Yuko Kokubun? Methods: Beating and strangling Suspects: Yuko Kokubun's boyfriend A police officer quickly arrives at the scene. From the intercom, the woman admits that she is living with a large dog and what the Detective Boys saw was the dog playing with her. To confirm this, the officer asks the woman's permission to look around, but she only permits the police to come alone. The police later confirmed that only the woman is living there and nothing happened. The next day, the Detective Boys go to Detective Agency to ask Conan about the case. They explain what happened and how the couple looked from their perspectives. They later argue and Mitsuhiko mentions that they've got everything backwards. Hearing that, Conan thinks again about the case and realizes what actually happened.

title.ja: ケーキを愛する女のバラード
title.en: Ballad of the Woman Who Loved Cake
title.enRaw: Ballad of the Woman Who Loved Cake

summary.en: The Detective Boys are exploring an abandoned building when they find a woman crushed by ruins. Suddenly, the woman then wakes up scaring the Detective Boys and fainting the. Soon Conan wakes them up. When they follow the blood trail that is left by the woman, they arrive to Western Confections Paradise, a confectionery shop. They found a woman with red clothes with a blood stain in her leg and they suspected her to be the woman who was crushed. They decide to follow her. The woman walks to Western Confections Paradise main factory. As Conan and the Detective Boys plan to enter throughservice entrance, suddenly the secretary of the confectionery company Yayoi Ito screamed. The president of the company, Akira Ogawa, is found drowned in red bean paste. Location: Western Confections Paradise main factory Cause of death: Suffocation Suspects: Hiroshi Ogawa, Hanako Ogawa, and Yayoi Ito The younger brother of the victim and also vice-president of the company Hiroshi Ogawa arrives and tells the secretary to call the police. Hiroshi finds his wife Hanako Ogawa's handkerchief next to the body. He later calls Hanako to make an alibi. The police, along with Kogoro are unable to find out the culprit.However, Conan manages to solve the case first.

title.ja: 警察学校編 Wild Police Story CASE. 松田陣平
title.zhHans: 警察学校篇 Wild Police Story CASE.松田阵平
title.zhHant: 警察學校篇 Wild Police Story CASE. 松田陣平
title.en: Police Academy Arc Wild Police Story CASE. Jinpei Matsuda
title.enRaw: Police Academy Arc Wild Police Story CASE. Jinpei Matsuda

summary.en: The story takes place several years ago at the Metropolitan Police Department Police Academy. One night, Rei Furuya and Jinpei Matsuda are having a duel. They punch each other at the yard. Matsuda hates Amuro, who "really wants to become a police officer". That night, Hiromitsu Morofushi has a nightmare about his parents' death when he was a child. He is later awoken by a sudden knock on the door, finding an injured Rei, who is asking for some band-aids. The next day, all students gather at the yard. Kenji Hagiwara, Hiromitsu Morofushi, Rei Furuya, Jinpei Matsuda, and Wataru Date are in the same class. Their instructor is Hachizo Onizuka. When Onizuka asks why Rei and Jinpei are injured, Date reasoned that they are too excited when they tried to catch some cockroaches. As a self punishment, Date instructs the class to run an extra lap. Onizuka can't manage to talk more with them as they start running. Another instructor comments that Onizuka has taken five troublesome students. Rei who always getting into fights with other students, Hiromitsu who is traumatized by his parents' death, Date who can't let go of his father retirement from the police force, Kenji who has good communication skill but only uses them to attract women, and Matsuda who has outrageous behaviour and lack of cooperativeness.

title.ja: 空白の一年（前編）

summary.en: Kogoro just finished his investigation report when he heard someone almost got hit by a car. Kogoro then discovers that the man, Ritsuo Esaka, does not remember what happened during the past year. They later go to detective agency, where Esaka tells about how suddenly one year has passed, and how he recovered his original memory while forgetting the memory from the past year. He checked his train card history and he used to left from and returned to Koneru. They conclude that he must have lived in Koneru for the past year. Meanwhile, there is a news about Akira Kisugi, a con artist who suddenly disappeared six months ago and was found buried in the mountains of Wakabadai three days ago, partially skeletonized. Later, they go to Koneru, and ask a police there if he knew Esaka, but the police does not recognize him. Kogoro then try to use shock theraphy to make Esaka regain his memory, but it does not work. Esaka later becomes scared to know if he had done something bad, so he runs away. Apparently, they find out that the police they previously meet is a serial burglar faking as police, so they try to ask the real police at Koneru Station police box. The police recognized Esaka, and says that he was found by an old man named Takuzo Kinbara.

title.ja: 空白の一年（後編）

summary.en: The police say that it is a suicide because there is a suicide note written on the laptop, and the apartment was locked, with two keys a re found inside the room. There were also two phone call made by Esaka, one to Hida Industries construction company, and one to weather information system. It turns out that Esaka was at Wakabadai on June 10, the same day where Akira Kisugi was murdered, and there was also a lightning strike on that day. The police deduce that the murderer is Ritsuo Esaka. However, Conan finds out that one of the cup is placed differently on the shelf, which means that someone was there with Esaka before his death. Later, they go to Wakabadai and ask people if they recognize Esaka. A woman who owns takoyaki shop says that on that day, Esaka was chased by a dog and he climbed a pole. Later, he saw something, before a lightning appeared. The direction he saw is the street where Akira Kisugi's residence and a temple located. Conan deduces that Esaka saw the culprit, and only tried to kill him recently because they don't know where he live, which also means that the culprit lives in Koneru. However, among the suspect list, no one lives in Koneru. They later asked Takuzo about it, but he haven't heard anything about it. Hida, Mizutani, and Mamoru later decide to help Kogoro searching anything suspicious.

title.ja: モデル、毛利蘭

summary.en: Ran is scouted as a model for a painting by Ryuji Kasuga. That day, Conan accompany Ran because he is worried. Later, he senses something from the garden. While he is investigating, he meets the gardener, who mentioned that something has happened with two previous models. Attempted Murder (Past) Victim: Ayu Nagahata Method: Pushing from stairs Suspects: Ryuji Kasuga After being Kasuga's first model, she suddenly was pushed from a staircase. Attempted Murder (Past) Victim: Machiko Nogami Method: Pushing into traffic Suspects: Ryuji Kasuga After being Kasuga's second model, she is pushed to the street and attacked. Both models were pushed around the same place where Kasuga scouted them, and they admit that they saw Kasuga on the day of incident. Machiko recalls that she heard a clattering sound. Meanwhile, Yoshio is searching something in Kasuga's late wife's room, and he finds some photos of Kasuga and his wife taken at some specific places. At the same time, Kasuga is finishing Ran's potrait painting. Conan then tells Kogoro that the garderner revealed that Kasuga's wife passed away six months ago and he was depressed and could not enter his studio. After a while, he found some models and start painting, but both models end up being attacked by someone on their way home on the day the painting was finished. After hearing that, they quickly run to Kasuga's house.

title.ja: 太閤名人の将棋盤（初手編）
title.zhHans: 太阁名人的将棋盘（初手篇）
title.zhHant: 太閤名人的將棋盤（初手篇）

summary.en: While on the way home from school, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys meet Shukichi, who in chance heard the group conversation about the term "yaocho" (match fixing). It was because of the death of Kimiharu Nishikido, a shogi player who was suspected of match fixing. Victim: Kimiharu Nishikido Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Mina Katsumata, Shoko Uryu and Kosuke Hishinuma Nishikido was found dead after disappearing amidst allegations of match-fixing. He was beaten to death, and next to his body was an upside-down shogi board with one of its legs removed. Later, Shukichi leaves for an important meeting, but the group meet Yumi, who is following Shukichi because he is acting strange. Haibara then says that Shukichi might have an affair. Yumi decides to take Conan with her. Shukichi then enter a donut shop. While waiting for Shukichi, Conan asks Yumi if she has meet Shukichi's parents. Yumi says that Shukichi was adopted by the super rich Haneda family when he was trying to be a professional shogi player, so that Shukichi could fullfill Kohji Haneda's dream. Yumi also aware of Shukichi's biological family, betting that the whole family is also carfree like him. Conan, who knows about the family, says nothing about it. Yumi then realizes that they are in front of Star Donut, which Yumi sugested Shukichi to go. Yumi is happy, but only for a while, because Shukichi is later seen talking to two women. She then approaches him, only to find that the two women are happy to meet Yumi. The two women, Mina Katsumata and Shoko Uryu, are young shogi players who are attending shogi study session. Shukichi is involved because he is asked by Chikara Katsumata, Mina's father. They arrive at an apartment, where another young shogi player, Kosuke Hishinuma, is waiting. There is also another shogi player, Yasukiyo Genda, who is waiting in the apartment. However, Genda is not answering the bell, so they enter the building using the spare key brought by Mina. They arrive at the room and found the door is not locked. After some searching, Hishinuma finds Genda's body in the kitchen. Victim: Yasukiyo Genda Cause of death: Strangulation Suspects: Mina Katsumata, Shoko Uryu and Kosuke Hishinuma 10 minutes after everyone left the apartment, they came back only to stumble across Genda's dead body, who seems to have been strangled to death with and electric chord. Next to him was an upside down shogi board with two legs removed. Shukichi touchs the kitchen counter and notices something near mixer, toaster, and ice trays. Takagi and Sato later arrive at the crime scene. Shukichi, knowing the reason why Yumi followed him, has a small argument with her, before get interupted by Sato. Sato and Takagi starts questioning the others, suspecting that they might pretend to buy food and kill Genda. Hishinuma, who bought cups of coffee, said that the water heater is broken, and the stove is not hot. Mina bought freshly baked bread, and there is no microwave, so it is impossible to reheat the bread. Shoko bought some ice cream, and they had checked the freezer to make sure there is no ice cream before go to buy it. They also meet each other before heading to the apartment and they didn't bring any food beforehand. Sato deduces that the murder might be the work of an outsider, and a serial murder. There is a shogi board with two missing legs next to Genda. In Nishikido case, a shogi board with one missing leg was found. It was revealed that Genda and Nishikdo were friends. The shogi study session is originally run by Genda, Nishikido, Yuhei Kishimoto, and Kinji Uryu. Kinji, who is Shoko's older brother and Mina's boyfriend, committed suicide. After that, Kishimoto became depressed. Location: Uryu's house Cause of death: Hanging Some time ago, Kinji Uryu committed suicide under mysterious circumstances. It seems that shortly after, Yuhei Kishimoto started to develop depression from Uryu's death. Conan warned that there might be more murders, since there are two remaining legs on the shogi board. Sato plans to talk to Kishimoto, so she asks Hishinuma. He later points out from the window the house next to a public bath. However, a smoke appears from that place. Sato then warns the others that they might be the next target. Sato and Takagi meet Yuminaga at the crime scene. Kishimoto is found burnt in the house, and might still alive before the fire started because his rectal temperature hadn't fallen much. Next to Kishimoto, a shogi board with three missing legs is found. Yuminaga then surprised that Conan, who is observing the shogi board, is there. Location: Kishimoto's house Victim: Yuhei Kishimoto Cause of death: Stab wound Suspects: Mina Katsumata, Shoko Uryu and Kosuke Hishinuma Just after the suspects talk about Uryu's suicide, they see a house on fire from the window of the apartment building, and realize it is Kishimoto's house. As the Sato and Takagi arrive there, Inspector Yuminaga who first arrived tells them that it was completely burned, but the cause of death doesn't seem to have been the fire, since it didn't react to it. Also, a shogi board with three legs missing was next to it. That night, Shukichi goes to the culprit house to encourage them to turn in to the police. The next day, while on the way home from school, Conan recalls the case. He was interupted by Genta who was annoyed by capsule toys machine, so he decides to mix up the machine. Later, he get a phone call from Yumi. Shukichi has been missing since last night and she asks Conan if he knows where Shukichi is. Conan recalls that Shukichi might notice something. Yumi also mentions that Shukichi seems to forget something when they left the apartment, but after he came back, he admitted that it was a mistake on his part. Yumi then ends the call. Chiba and Naeko, who are with Yumi at the time, deduce that Shukichi might be shocked after Yumi tried to tail him. Hearing that, Yumi is angry, then teases both of them for getting along so well. However, they admit that they had an argument last night. Meanwhile, Shukichi is abducted by the culprit. After he enters the room, the culprit use stun gun to knock him out and tied him to the leg of a table. Shukichi deduces that the culprit is waiting for police announcement, but he already prevent that. Location: Culprit's apartment Victim: Shukichi Haneda Suspects: Mina Katsumata, Shoko Uryu and Kosuke Hishinuma Shukichi heads to the culprit's apartment after finding the truth behind Genda's murder and asks the culprit to turn themselves in, but is knocked out by the culprit. Conan then call Akai to help him find Shukichi. Yusaku, who is also in the living room with Yukiko, decide to help with the case too. After Conan mentions the things that was on the kitchen counter, Yusaku finds out something that can be use to fabricate an alibi. Conan, recalling what Genta was doing earlier, also finally solves the case. Akai, without his Subaru disguise and only use a hat and a sunglasses, picks up Conan with his Subaru car in front of Ramen Ogura. Conan says that Shukichi's phone is not active. Akai deduces that Shukichi decide not to bring along the phone containg information about his close friend. He then calls Shukichi's other phone, which is used for secret conversation with him. Shukichi, knowing that Akai is calling him, answer the phone, and asked the culprit to do blind shogi. Akai then uses GPS to find Shukichi's location.

title.ja: 太閤名人の将棋盤（妙手編）
title.zhHans: 太阁名人的将棋盘（妙手篇）
title.zhHant: 太閤名人的將棋盤（妙手篇）

summary.en: While on the way home from school, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys meet Shukichi, who in chance heard the group conversation about the term "yaocho" (match fixing). It was because of the death of Kimiharu Nishikido, a shogi player who was suspected of match fixing. Victim: Kimiharu Nishikido Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Mina Katsumata, Shoko Uryu and Kosuke Hishinuma Nishikido was found dead after disappearing amidst allegations of match-fixing. He was beaten to death, and next to his body was an upside-down shogi board with one of its legs removed. Later, Shukichi leaves for an important meeting, but the group meet Yumi, who is following Shukichi because he is acting strange. Haibara then says that Shukichi might have an affair. Yumi decides to take Conan with her. Shukichi then enter a donut shop. While waiting for Shukichi, Conan asks Yumi if she has meet Shukichi's parents. Yumi says that Shukichi was adopted by the super rich Haneda family when he was trying to be a professional shogi player, so that Shukichi could fullfill Kohji Haneda's dream. Yumi also aware of Shukichi's biological family, betting that the whole family is also carfree like him. Conan, who knows about the family, says nothing about it. Yumi then realizes that they are in front of Star Donut, which Yumi sugested Shukichi to go. Yumi is happy, but only for a while, because Shukichi is later seen talking to two women. She then approaches him, only to find that the two women are happy to meet Yumi. The two women, Mina Katsumata and Shoko Uryu, are young shogi players who are attending shogi study session. Shukichi is involved because he is asked by Chikara Katsumata, Mina's father. They arrive at an apartment, where another young shogi player, Kosuke Hishinuma, is waiting. There is also another shogi player, Yasukiyo Genda, who is waiting in the apartment. However, Genda is not answering the bell, so they enter the building using the spare key brought by Mina. They arrive at the room and found the door is not locked. After some searching, Hishinuma finds Genda's body in the kitchen. Victim: Yasukiyo Genda Cause of death: Strangulation Suspects: Mina Katsumata, Shoko Uryu and Kosuke Hishinuma 10 minutes after everyone left the apartment, they came back only to stumble across Genda's dead body, who seems to have been strangled to death with and electric chord. Next to him was an upside down shogi board with two legs removed. Shukichi touchs the kitchen counter and notices something near mixer, toaster, and ice trays. Takagi and Sato later arrive at the crime scene. Shukichi, knowing the reason why Yumi followed him, has a small argument with her, before get interupted by Sato. Sato and Takagi starts questioning the others, suspecting that they might pretend to buy food and kill Genda. Hishinuma, who bought cups of coffee, said that the water heater is broken, and the stove is not hot. Mina bought freshly baked bread, and there is no microwave, so it is impossible to reheat the bread. Shoko bought some ice cream, and they had checked the freezer to make sure there is no ice cream before go to buy it. They also meet each other before heading to the apartment and they didn't bring any food beforehand. Sato deduces that the murder might be the work of an outsider, and a serial murder. There is a shogi board with two missing legs next to Genda. In Nishikido case, a shogi board with one missing leg was found. It was revealed that Genda and Nishikdo were friends. The shogi study session is originally run by Genda, Nishikido, Yuhei Kishimoto, and Kinji Uryu. Kinji, who is Shoko's older brother and Mina's boyfriend, committed suicide. After that, Kishimoto became depressed. Location: Uryu's house Cause of death: Hanging Some time ago, Kinji Uryu committed suicide under mysterious circumstances. It seems that shortly after, Yuhei Kishimoto started to develop depression from Uryu's death. Conan warned that there might be more murders, since there are two remaining legs on the shogi board. Sato plans to talk to Kishimoto, so she asks Hishinuma. He later points out from the window the house next to a public bath. However, a smoke appears from that place. Sato then warns the others that they might be the next target. Sato and Takagi meet Yuminaga at the crime scene. Kishimoto is found burnt in the house, and might still alive before the fire started because his rectal temperature hadn't fallen much. Next to Kishimoto, a shogi board with three missing legs is found. Yuminaga then surprised that Conan, who is observing the shogi board, is there. Location: Kishimoto's house Victim: Yuhei Kishimoto Cause of death: Stab wound Suspects: Mina Katsumata, Shoko Uryu and Kosuke Hishinuma Just after the suspects talk about Uryu's suicide, they see a house on fire from the window of the apartment building, and realize it is Kishimoto's house. As the Sato and Takagi arrive there, Inspector Yuminaga who first arrived tells them that it was completely burned, but the cause of death doesn't seem to have been the fire, since it didn't react to it. Also, a shogi board with three legs missing was next to it. That night, Shukichi goes to the culprit house to encourage them to turn in to the police. The next day, while on the way home from school, Conan recalls the case. He was interupted by Genta who was annoyed by capsule toys machine, so he decides to mix up the machine. Later, he get a phone call from Yumi. Shukichi has been missing since last night and she asks Conan if he knows where Shukichi is. Conan recalls that Shukichi might notice something. Yumi also mentions that Shukichi seems to forget something when they left the apartment, but after he came back, he admitted that it was a mistake on his part. Yumi then ends the call. Chiba and Naeko, who are with Yumi at the time, deduce that Shukichi might be shocked after Yumi tried to tail him. Hearing that, Yumi is angry, then teases both of them for getting along so well. However, they admit that they had an argument last night. Meanwhile, Shukichi is abducted by the culprit. After he enters the room, the culprit use stun gun to knock him out and tied him to the leg of a table. Shukichi deduces that the culprit is waiting for police announcement, but he already prevent that. Location: Culprit's apartment Victim: Shukichi Haneda Suspects: Mina Katsumata, Shoko Uryu and Kosuke Hishinuma Shukichi heads to the culprit's apartment after finding the truth behind Genda's murder and asks the culprit to turn themselves in, but is knocked out by the culprit. Conan then call Akai to help him find Shukichi. Yusaku, who is also in the living room with Yukiko, decide to help with the case too. After Conan mentions the things that was on the kitchen counter, Yusaku finds out something that can be use to fabricate an alibi. Conan, recalling what Genta was doing earlier, also finally solves the case. Akai, without his Subaru disguise and only use a hat and a sunglasses, picks up Conan with his Subaru car in front of Ramen Ogura. Conan says that Shukichi's phone is not active. Akai deduces that Shukichi decide not to bring along the phone containg information about his close friend. He then calls Shukichi's other phone, which is used for secret conversation with him. Shukichi, knowing that Akai is calling him, answer the phone, and asked the culprit to do blind shogi. Akai then uses GPS to find Shukichi's location.

title.ja: ホワイトアウト（前編）

summary.en: Agasa takes Conan and the Detective Boys to a ski resort in the mountains outside Tokyo. On the way, they meet Kengo Ishibashi and Takeru Yokoyama, whose car is stuck in the snow. The group decides to help those two people move their car out of the snow and back onto the road. After helping, Ishibashi asks for contact information, and opens the back door of his car. Ayumi then notices something frightening inside the car, there are two rifles inside some cases with bullets. Ishibashi says not to worry as they are merely there to enjoy some hunting for sport. Some time later, the Detective Boys arrive at the ski resort. Meanwhile, there are two other people, Masaki Mori and Taro Tannai, who wish that they don’t get dragged into more trouble after dealing with some in the past. Ishibashi and Yokoyama then arrive at a cabin. They later start walking through the forest carrying their rifles with them. Suddenly, Ishibashi asks Yokoyama about the medicine Ishibashi's company developed. However, since the medicine has a side effect, Yokoyama refuses to use it at his hospital. Hearing that, Ishibashi pulls out his gun, saying that his medicine will be adopted as long as Yokoyama is out of the picture. He also admits that he already tampered with Yokoyama's gun, so he can't use it. Yokoyama in disbelief tries to use his gun to no avail, Ishibashi then throws away his gun and pulls out a knife from his jacket. Both of them then start fighting and struggling over each other.

title.ja: ホワイトアウト（後編）

summary.en: Conan and the Detective boys arrive at the cabin safely. Meanwhile, Ishibashi's accomplices ask him if he really wants to kill the children. Ishibashi reasons that he already killed a man so it is too late to reconsider. He planned to follow the path left by the kids, but Conan had thought ahead and had covered it up halfway using his snowboard. At the ski resort, as the snowstorm continued to become more intense, Agasa tries to call Conan but is unable to reach him. Fortunately, to his surprise Conan managed to get a weak signal, and managed to call Agasa. However, because the signal is weak their sentences end up breaking apart. Conan quickly tells Agasa about the murder and how the culprit Ishibashi is chasing them. He asks Agasa to call for the police and a rescue team before the call got cut off, as the snowstorm become more intense. The roof of the cabin where they are taking refuge at starts shaking, and Conan decides that they have to move as the cabin would most likely break apart before the storm could subside. Conan knows that there is another bigger cabin with electricity and with a telephone that uses landlines. Using ropes to keep them together, they start walking through the blizzard. Conan keeps track of the next cabin with his glasses.
