title.en: Police Academy Arc Wild Police Story CASE. Wataru Date
title.enRaw: Police Academy Arc Wild Police Story CASE. Wataru Date

summary.en: Around one month after entering police academy, Matsuda and Rei are now friends. Kenji remains popular among women student. Some women ask Kenji to bring along some guys, especially Amuro, who is called blond foreigner. Hearing that, Date is angry, and both women run away. Later, he meets Hajime Tomori, who has come to get the dirty clothes. During lunch time, a male student afraid that the English teacher will call him during class. His friend then advised that he should get Rei to teach him, as Rei is blond and half, and even bets that he is better than the English teacher. Hearing that, Date gets up from the seat, and grabs the student's shirt before scolding him. Date also takes the toothpick in his mouth and breaks it, as he doesn't like seeing it. After that, he goes back to his seat. Kenji then asks if Date has a crush on Rei. Both Date and Rei are shocked hearing that, before Date can defend himself that he has got a girlfriend. The others become silent for a while, before they went shocked. That night, Date call his girlfriend Natalie, and tells her about the situation during lunch and his days in police academy. Natalie later ask if they are going to meet his father, but Date says that they can ignore him.

title.ja: 空飛ぶハロウィンカボチャ

summary.en: Beika Shopping Centre is holding a jack-o'-lantern carving contest for halloween. One night, Kuwano and Kajiyama are walking home at night when they pass a road with jack-o'-lantern placed in front of the houses. Suddenly the wind blows strong, and three ghosts with jack-o'-lantern-shaped head appear. The next day, Conan goes to Poirot because Kogoro and Ran are going out. There, Azusa is making some jack-o'-lantern and, in exchange for a milk tea, she asks Conan to help her. They later talk about the story behind halloween. Azusa then mentions about the appearance of jack-o'-lantern ghost, which became a hot topic after many people saw it last night. Conan then ask about Amuro whereabout, to Azusa answers that he is taking a few days off. She wishes that could put a collar on Amuro and keep him at Poirot. She decide to ask Conan something about Amuro, but get interupted by Tamie Kono, Tomomi Kashiyama, and Satoshi Mizunuma, whose jack-o'-lanterns have been stolen. Victim: Tamie Kono, Tomomi Kashiyama, and Satoshi Mizunuma Age: 50 years old (Kono), 29 years old (Kashiyama) & 60 years old (Mizunuma) Robbed items: 3 Jack-o'-lanterns Conan and Azusa decide to check the neighborhood to find who stole the jack-o'lanterns.

title.ja: 歩美の絵日記事件簿 2
title.zhHans: 步美的绘画日记事件簿2
title.zhHant: 步美的圖繪日記事件簿 2
title.en: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 2
title.enRaw: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 2

summary.en: Conan, Agasa, and the Detective Boys are on the way home, when Ayumi notice a crowd surrounding a building. There is a light flashing repeatedly from the building, making a morse code for "SOS". They then decide to look inside the building. There, they found Masaru Danno tied inside a room, while using his feet to turn the light on and off. After being rescued, he tells them that there is a bomb inside the building, before fleeing the building. The Detective boys follow him, but Conan stays inside to find the bomb. Danno then go back inside to take Conan away from the building. Victim: Masaru Danno When Conan and Danno is outside, the police already arrived. Chiba says that they received an anonymous call about the light. Later, Danno tells the police that when he went to deliver a package to some nasty-looking guy, a gun fell out of the guy's pocket. He later got struck on the head from behind. After he wake up, he heard the culprits discussing about blowing up the whole building. The bomb squad later find a possible bomb inside a box in the building. However, it turns out that the box only contains an ordinary alarm clock. Takagi decides to leave the rest of investigation to the forensics team. Not long after that, Chiba recieves a phone call, informing him that there was an armed robbery at Kaneko Jewerly. Conan later finds out what actually happened. Location: Kaneko Jewelry Victim: Keita Kaneko Robbed items: Jewels

title.ja: 言えないアリバイ
title.zhHant: 無法言說的不在場證明

summary.en: Cona, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are going out, when they see a police officer. An old lady admits that ahe was pushed by a strange young woman from the stairs. However, there is no one who witness the incident. Injury: Pushing from stairs Suspects: "Strange young woman" Conan then realizes that there is a man standing on the alleyway near the scene, and ask him if he saw someone suspicious. However, he admits that he did not see anyone, before leaving the scene. From the man's behavior, Conan thinks that he is suspicious. Mitsuhiko and Genta then follow the man, while Conan, Ayumi, and Haibara ask people around if they have see the man. Apparently, he was seen at a nearby cafe. The cafe owner says that he is Kanieda, who live in Shikabone, an hour away from Beika by car. The owner knows his name because there was a phone call from someone looking for Kanieda. When the owner ask if there is someone named Kanieda from Shikabone, the man repeatedly says the name and the town. It seems that the man was meeting someone at 1:00 pm, but the other person could not make it. She then hand over Conan a lighter, which seems belong to that man. The group later gather at Beika Station, where the man named Kanieda was last seen. Mitsuhiko and Genta have no idea on what the man was doing, as he was attracting too much attention for a suspicous person around Beika. After about an hour, he went to Beika Station and get on the train. Conan then wonders why the man have to recieve call at a cafe while he has a cell phone. Conan also find it odd when the man get on the train that head to the opposite direction from Shikabone. That train stopped one station over at Midoridai, so the group then go to Midoridai and search for the man. Surprisingly, the man is found arrested by Takagi and Chiba, and is brought to Midoridai police station. There, Megure is interogating him. Takagi then tell Conan and others that the man is Eiichi Usui who lives in Midoridai. Usui is the main suspect for the injury case involving Takeru Hachiya, who was found injured by Sueko Kakimoto at Midoridai Park. Sueko testified that she saw someone got into an argument with Hachiya several days ago, and because she had seen the culprit several times, she thought that the culprit also live in Midoridai. Near the crime scene, a pen with Usui's initial was found. Location: Midoridai Park Victim: Takeru Hachiya Time: Around 1:00 pm Injury: Blunt-force trauma Suspects: Eiichi Usui Usui admits that he have a grudge against Hachiya, but admits that he haven't been to the park. When Megure asks him where is he when Hachiya was attacked, he can't tell Megure. He even try to make a lie but not convicing enough. Conan then says that Usui is innocent, as Usui was at Beika around 1:00 pm, the time when Hachiya was attacked. Conan also hands over Takagi the lighter that should belong to Usui. However, Usui denied that he had been to Beika, and Usui's fingerprints were not found on the lighter. The Detective Boys then leave the police station, wondering why Usui did not say that he has an alibi. Conan then decide to check Shikabone telephone book, and found someone named Akira Kanieda. They decide to go to Shikabone and ask Kanieda. The next day, the Detective Boys go to Shikabone to meet Kanieda. However, Kanieda's neighbor says that Kanieda got hit by a car yesterday afternoon on the other side of the station and is in the hospital, unconscious. They later follow the neighbor to the hospital. Surprisingly, Kanieda looks similar to Usui. Location: South side of Shikabone Station Victim: Akira Kanieda Time: Yesterday around 1:00 pm The neighbor then wonder what Kanieda was doing at the south side of the station, when Kanieda thinks it is bad luck. Turns out that about a year ago, Kanieda's mother had some dentures made by a well-known dentist on the south side of the station named Kanzo Saruwatari. Not long after that, his mother was found dead while sleeping after the dentures got caught in her throat. Kanieda, during the funeral, blamed the dentist for making a poorly made dentures which killed his mother. Conan then get confirmation that the accident also happened around 1 pm. After asking around for more details, he finally solves the case.

title.ja: 警察学校編 Wild Police Story CASE. 萩原研二
title.zhHans: 警察学校篇 Wild Police Story CASE.萩原研二
title.zhHant: 警察學校篇 Wild Police Story CASE. 萩原研二
title.en: Police Academy Arc Wild Police Story CASE. Kenji Hagiwara
title.enRaw: Police Academy Arc Wild Police Story CASE. Kenji Hagiwara

summary.en: Date, Matsuda, Hiro, and Rei are having a gathering at a restaurant with some female police academy students, which is held by Hagiwara. However, he is late. The women talk about the fact that Date already have girlfriend, while Matsuda don't. Meanwhile, Hiro and Rei are enjoying eating some food. Hiro says that even he could make it and will show Rei how, before mentioning that Rei don't know the first thing about cooking. Hearing that, one of the women want to try the food Rei made even if it is bad. Matsuda then join the conversation, saying that Rei's interest in women other than older lady doctors is zero. Another woman then jokingly threaten Matsuda that she will arrest him if he keep saying unkind things. Later, Hagiwara arrives. He tell the group that he was helping an old woman getting up the stairs, looking for her "very lucky "fortune, and bought her another "very lucky" fortune. The women are impressed by Hagiwara behavior, but Date feels that he is just lying. After eating, Hagiwara invites the woman to karaoke. On the way, a man appraoches Hiro. Turns out the man is the person Hagiwara helped before going to the restaurant. AFter the man leaves, Matsuda adds that Hagiwara doesn't lie about that kind of thing, although he use "old woman" instead, knowing that it would be received better. When looking back at the man, Hiro notice a girl. The girl resembles another girl from his childhood, who had passed away.

title.ja: 復讐のフィギュア

summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys are visiting a group of university students who are members of the figure club. However, one of the students, Kazuya Shiraishi, is not happy with their visit, because they have a project that needs to be finished tomorrow. While Kazuya is working alone in the room, an explosion was heard and a blackout occurs. Conan tries to approach the room, but Naoto Mizuhara prevents him from going. A second explosion then occurs, and smoke is seen from the room. The door is locked, and Keiji Aoki asks Conan to call the fire department. Victim: Kazuya Shiraishi Cause of death: Smoke inhalation from Explosion Suspects: Naoto Mizuhara, Keiji Aoki, and Saki Midoriyama After hearing the two explosions, Naoto and Keiji futilely attempt to open the door and as a result Shiraishi dies from smoke inhalation. Unfortunately, Kazuya inhales a lot of smoke and passes away. The police later come to investigate the scene.

title.ja: 豚汁は命がけの合図
title.zhHans: 猪肉汤是拼上性命的信号
title.zhHant: 肉湯是賭上性命的暗號

summary.en: Kogoro and Conan are walking around, when they see some police cars in front of a apartment. They decide to help the investigation. Victim: Lisa Hewitson Cause of death: Stab wound Suspects: Satoshi Komaki Conan, Kogoro, Takagi, and Chiba later go to Takashi Hara's apartment, who is Lisa's boyfriend. Hara says that Satoshi Komaki, the owner of the bar where Lisa worked, might be responsible for the murder, because Lisa always complained about Satoshi hitting on her. Later, they go to see Satoshi, who revealed that he has a private relationship with Lisa. However, he refuse to tell his alibi, instead he ask the police if they should investigate the murder weapon, fingerprints on wine bottle, or the jacket the culprit wearing. Satoshi then says that Hara might be the culprit, because Hara always making eyes at his employees. He later tell the police that he was at home when the crime happened, and ask them to ask his wife Mihoko to proof the alibi. The police then go to Komaki's apartment, and ask Mihoko about Satoshi's alibi. Later, Conan notices that there is a mic on the figurines on the table. Kogoro then ask how Mihoko married to Satoshi. Two years ago, he was engaged to Ryohei Oi. However, Ryohei was stabbed by unknown assailant. A suspect was arrested for the murder, but they died in prison, and it seems like it was a wrongful arrest. Location: Wedding hall Time: December 7 (2 years ago) Cause of death: Stab wound Suspects: Satoshi Komaki Turns out after that incident, the company she worked at suddenly went bankrupt, her sister was being stalked, her father's factory caught fire, and her mother fell off a train platform. After the series of unfortunate events, she meet Satoshi and got married. Conan realizes that Mihoko is lying. He then search for the incident that happened on December 7, before telling Takagi and Chiba through messages that the room is bugged, and because of that, Mihoko can't tell the truth. Takagi decides to use eye blinking as a signal for "yes" or "no" for Mihoko. After they get the real answer thorough blinking, Takagi whispers to Mihoko that the police will ensure her safety. Later, Mihoko says that she should cook for her husband. When Kogoro see some vegetables, he deduces that she want to cook pork soup, or rather signaling morse code through chopping the vegetables. They then observe if there is a hint she try to make. Suddenly, Satoshi comes in with his bodyguard, and force the police to leave the apartment. Before leaving, Conan gives a good luck charm to Mihoko.

title.ja: 天罰くだる誕生パーティー（前編）
title.zhHans: 天罚降临的生日派对（前篇）
title.en: The Birthday Party of Divine Punishment (Part 1)

summary.en: Ran, Sonoko, and Sera are invited by Yumi Sekizawa, their classmate, to her and her sister, Remi Sekizawa's birthday party. Conan is having mouth ulcer, but Kogoro is attending a neighborhood association meeting, so Conan ended up attending the party. Later, Ran asks him to take his medicine. The medicine is stored in the case where he is keeping the APTX4869 antidote Haibara gave him for his school trip. Sera sees the antidote and asks Conan about it, but Conan refuse to answer her. Sera then calls Mary to report about the antidote. Mary instructs Sera to steal the antidote. The group then meet Remi, Yumi's sister who become a model. They also meet her manager Mitomu Kushiyama, Remi's high school classmate and pastry chef Tsuguo Hatsune, and hair and makeup artist Mizutoshi Hanasaki. Yumi reveals that Hanasaki has hit on and been rejected by Remi despite having a wife and kid. Remi also complained that he even hit on her the other day. It is also the reason why Remi invited Ran, Sonoko, and Sera, so that Hanasaki can't try hitting on her. The party goes well, and it is the time for the birthday cake. People sing "Happy Birthday", while Hatsune brings the cake into the room. After blowing the candle, Remi notices that Hanasaki's glasses are glowing in the dark. The cake then get distributed while the projector shows Remi and Yumi's childhood photos.

title.ja: 天罰くだる誕生パーティー（後編）
title.zhHans: 天罚降临的生日派对（后篇）
title.en: The Birthday Party of Divine Punishment (Part 2)

summary.en: Vermouth revealed that she has been wandering around the city for some time while disguied as Tsutomu. This allowed Mary's colleagues to spotted Tsutomu and asked Mary to fly back to London, and let three years passed before "Tsutomu" appeared again to avoid suspicion. Mary actually already had suspicion, and had instructed Sera to inform MI6 if she did not make it back in time, and to leave London immediately. Vermouth then wondered if she should disguise as Mary and pay Sera a visit. Mary questioned that, given that Vermouth even did not know her existence until just now. Vermouth then decided to proceed with her objective. She placed the pill on her mouth and kissed Mary, forcing the pill to enter Mary's body. After that, Vermouth wondered how it feet to depart from the world by the poison created by her younger sister. Later, Mary screamed in pain, and fell down from the bridge into the river. Vermouth then quickly left the bridge. Mary managed to went back to the hotel, and tell Sera that she got shrunken. The police later found a large amount of poison on Hanasaki's cake. When Takagi is pointing out the position of Yumi's bag during the murder, he notices a stain on the floor. Sera says that the stain was not there before Hanasaki was killed.

title.ja: 赤いヒツジの不気味なゲーム（前編）
title.zhHans: 红色绵羊的恐怖游戏（前篇）
title.zhHant: 紅色綿羊的恐怖遊戲（上集）

summary.en: Ryota Beppu goes to Mouri Detective Agency, asking Kogoro to save his girlfriend, Ami Takigawa, who has been kidnapped by "The Red Sheep". Starngely, the culprit did not demand a ransom. Ran and Conan feel that they have saw a red sheep in the past. Around midnight, Ryota goes to Beika Park as The Red Sheep instructed, while Kogoro observes through the bushes. Suddenly, someone appears and run towards Ryota. It is Ami, who supposed to be kidnapped. Later, Ami reveals that it is just a game to test her boyfriend's courage and love, which is popular on social media. Knowing that, Kogoro scolds the couple. At the same time, Conan is wandering around the street, when he is found out by Ran. It seems that both are curious about "The Red Sheep". Suddenly, from Beika bridge tunnel, someone in a red sheep coustume appears. However, the red sheep just passes through them. Ran and Conan then go into the tunnel, where they find a dead body. The police arrives and investigates the crime scene. Kogoro later also arrives. Conan then mention that the red sheep's horns left a mark on the tunnel ceiling. The dead man is Tetsusaburo Wakabayashi, owner and head cook of a resturant called "La Mucho". Kogoro then remembers that both Ryota and Ami works at "La Mucho". He later go to find the couple.

title.ja: 赤いヒツジの不気味なゲーム（後編）
title.zhHans: 红色绵羊的恐怖游戏（后篇）
title.zhHant: 紅色綿羊的恐怖遊戲（下集）

summary.en: The next day, all people gathers at "La Mucho", where Kogoro reveals his deduction.

title.ja: 目暮、刑事人生の危機
title.en: The Threat to Megure's Police Career
title.enRaw: The Threat to Megure's Police Career

summary.en: Several days ago, Iwao Yamakabe was found dead at Tenma. The police then try to contact his family, but he seems to live alone. When a police officer arrives at his house at Hikaridai, he is surprised to find the living room have signs of scuffle, and the money inside the safe had been stolen. When a vase with Yamakabe's blood found at the scene, the police conclude that Yamakabe was murdered at his house around 7:00 p.m. Location: Yamakabe's house? Victim: Iwao Yamakabe Cause of death: Blunt-force trauma Suspects: Kyosuke Temukai Two days after the case, the police found the main suspect: Kyosuke Temukai. Megure recognizes him from a murder case happened three ago, where Temukai, who worked at a government office, was one of the suspects. At that time, to prove his innocence, he confessed that he had been secretly meeting a certain businessman. However, his government office learned about the meeting, and he was fired. Currently, he operates a publishing company, where he try to get close to successful people and make them write autobiographies. Yamakabe is one of those people, and it seems he was avoiding Temukai. The police later come to Temukai's apartment. Temukai says that he was working alone at the time of the murder. Megure then mentions that Temukai had detroyed his own car in a one-car accident on the morning after the murder. However, Temukai keep insisting that he didn't kill Yamakabe. Despite the lack of evidence, Megure is willing to risk his career before the chief section, and proceed to arrest Temukai. However, the next morning, after the news reported the arrest, Yasuko Chikaba comes to the police station and confesses that she had a meeting with Temukai at her house in Tenma from the evening until around 9:00 p.m. That is the moment when Megure knows that he has fallen into Temukai's plan. Megure then goes to Mouri detective agency, and tells Conan and Kogoro the full story. Kogoro decides to help Megure.

title.ja: 森川御殿の陰謀（前編）

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are invited by Yuzan Morikawa to a remote island under Tokyo jurisdiction, where Morikawa mansion is located. Yuzan, whose body has been consumed by late-stage cancer, asks Kogoro to help him and his lawyer, Hiroki Oi, rewriting the will, and to select one person that is worthy of inheriting his legacy. Later, the group have a small tour around the mansion, lead by chief butler Yuka Shito. While they are looking at the tank room, they meet the first son Yuichiro, who is researching a new flavor for the soft serve. After that, they go to reception room, where they meet the second son Yujiro, and the third son Yuzaburo. However, it seems that the siblings always having a fight over the inheritance. When it is dinner time, Yujiro doesn't show up. At fisrt, nothing feels wrong. After dinner, Oi reminds the whole group that the will shall be rewritten tomorrow afternoon. However, both Yujiro and Yuzaburo doesn't show up during breakfast. The others decide to check their rooms. Yujiro is not found in his room. Meanwhile, they found Yuzaburo lying dead in his room.

title.ja: 森川御殿の陰謀（後編）

summary.en: Oi then reveals that he secretly call the police as he predicted that the police will arrive after the will has been rewritten. Yuichiro express his fear as his brothers had been killed and he is clearly the next. He then decides to return to his room. Kogoro, Conan, and Ran return to their room and discuss the identity of the culprit. Meanwhile, Yuichiro successfully make a new flavor of the soft serve. He goes to the roof and enjoy the soft serve. He is very happy with the flavor, and with him being the only one alive, he will get all the inheritance. However, a loud sound is heard, and Yuichiro fall into the backyard. He got one shot through the heart from behind and died instantly. Conan deduces the position of the shooter, and later finds a rifle lying inside the tool room. He also smell something familiar. Conan then ask Yuka to show him Yuichiro's room. After investigating the room, Conan knows what happened.

title.ja: 少年探偵団の肝試し
title.zhHans: 少年侦探团的试胆冒险
title.zhHant: 少年偵探團的試膽冒險
title.en: The Detective Boys' Test of Courage
title.enRaw: The Detective Boys' Test of Courage

summary.en: The Detective Boys are watching the famous horror videomaker "Sadao and Toshiko" duo at Agasa's house. After hearing that they can make money if the video go viral, they decide to make their own video. They decide to go to an abandoned hospital, where the rumors said that there are crying red baby demon, mummy in a wheelchair, and crazy long-haired lady doctor holding a scalpel. There is also a mysterious locked room on the third floor, which is room 304. Mysterious sightings Location: Abandoned hospital Elements mentioned: Crying red baby demon, mummy in a wheelchair, crazy long-haired lady doctor holding a scalpel on the third floor On the first floor, they find a black cat. Conan notices that the cat is pretty friendly for a stray cat. On the second floor, they find a mummy in the wheelchair, but the mummy is just a doll. Conan notices that the doll is new, and there are some newspapers from the same day six months ago lying around the room. One of the newspaper reported about a murder-robbery. Robbery-Murder (Past) Location: Unknown location in Tokyo Time: Six months ago Cause of death: Gunshot wound Culprits: Junji Maruo and Tomoe Kito The culprits are still on the run. They finally arrive at the third floor, slowly approaching room 304. The door to room 304 is full of red-colored handprint. When Haibara plans to approach the door, the black cat suddenly passes through her feet. The cat is seen approaching someone, which reveals to be a long-haired lady doctor holding a scalpel. The Detective Boys then run away from the building. Later, Conan checks the video recorded by Mitsuhiko and finds something.

title.ja: 牧場に墜ちた火種（前編）
title.zhHans: 坠落于牧场的火种（前篇）
title.en: The Spark That Fell on the Ranch (Part 1)
title.enRaw: *The Spark That Fell on the Ranch* (Part 1)

summary.en: Amuro get a call from Kazami, who says that he is being trapped in a room, where there is a corpse lying on the bed. Amuro decides to help Kazami. Later, the Detective Boys along with Kobayashi dan Wakasa are on the bus heading to Hatoyama Farm. They plan to get a new chicken for the school, replacing the old one that just died. On the bus, there are three other people who also heading for Hatoyama Farm. One of them is watching a video and Mitsuhiko tries to find out about the video. Suddenly, the man gets angry and grabs Mitsuhiko's hand, asking him to erase the video. Fortunately, Amuro is also on the bus, and successfully resolves the situation. Arriving at Hatoyama Farm, they find out that there is no one in the office. There is no chicken left in the ranch, and there is a huge hole in the side of the ranch. While some people go to the toilet, Ayumi sees a chicken wandering around. She plans to tell Conan, but he is talking to Amuro, so she decides to quietly chase the chicken. When everybody gathers again, they realize that Ayumi is missing. They later divides into two groups: Kobayashi with Conan, Mitsuhiko, and Amuro, while Wakasa go with Haibara and Genta. When the others start searching, Amuro finds a bishop shogi piece on the ground, which he feels he has seen it before.

title.ja: 牧場に墜ちた火種（後編）
title.zhHans: 坠落于牧场的火种（后篇）
title.en: The Spark That Fell on the Ranch (Part 2)
title.enRaw: *The Spark That Fell on the Ranch* (Part 2)

summary.en: Conan deduces that the three men come to the farm to find a meteorite, while Amuro deduces their job based on their behavior. Meanwhile, Haibara, Genta, and Wakasa, using a handmade lamp, find some documents on the floor, and there is a broken yellow highlighter above of it. Someone has stepped on the highlighter, leaving some footprints nearby. They also find two rocks that perfectly fit each other. However, by using the compass, the rock is not a meteorite, but an ordinary rock that got colored. When Genta finds some magnets on the desk, Kazami then deduces that Gisuke found the meteorite and had it appraised by an expert. however, the expert said that it was an ordinary rock. They got into argument and the expert decided to ignore him, unaware that they stepped on the highlighter. After realizing that he had been scammed, Gisuke killed himself. Conan then deduces that the main goal of Umisuke is to get revenge on the person who drove Gisuke to suicide. When Ayumi says that the trees she saw was wrapped with something long and skinny, Conan and Amuro realizes that those are some explosives Umisuke had stolen, and he plans to lure the three suspects to the location so that he can kill them.

title.ja: 幽霊になって復讐を

summary.en: Two weeks ago, Kogoro and Conan meet Takayuki Suguro at Beika Central Hospital. He said to his wife, Sayaka, and his secretary, Tateru, that he have six months left to live. He was glad that he took out a life insurance policy Tateru insisted, even though Takayuki was opposed to it. However, several days later, Takayuki was found dead at his house. It was a murder made to look like a suicide. Location: Suguro household Victim: Takayuki Suguro Cause of death: Loss of blood through a slit wound on the wrist Suspects: Masato Oshikawa Later, Takayuki's best friend, Yoji Kanda, arrived. The day before he got a call from Takayuki, asking him to come. It seems that Takayuki was angry with someone and couldn't forgive them. Several days later, someone spread a rumor that Takayuki's ghost has appeared. Kogoro and Conan and wondered who did that. Later, they hear some police car passing through detective agency. Later, they arrive at the scene, where they see Sayaka and Tateru. Masato Oshikawa, the suspect in Takayuki's murder, is found dead in his house. Location: Masato Oshikawa's house Victim: Masato Oshikawa Cause of death: Loss of blood through a slit wound on the wrist The police conclude that his death is a suicide, which is done in the same way as Takayuki's murder. Sayaka and Tateru admits that they are the ones who spread the ghost rumor. Because they lacked evidence, they spread the rumor to frighten Masato. Conan then notices a suspicious man, saying that it was his fault, before goes away from the scene. The man is Fukusuke Omori, a restaurant owner. He is the one who told Masato about the rumor, but Masato didn't seem to be concerned. That means he is not the culprit. Kogoro decides to question Tokuko Hanai, the former housekeeper of Suguro household. Tokuko tells them about the relationship between Sayaka and Tateru that she first saw two years ago, which is the main reason she stopped working. Kogoro then asks Yoji about the insurance policy. The insurance has a special accident clause, which states that if the policyholder is killed or dies in an accident, the beneficiary receives double teh payouyt. Kogoro deduces that both Sayaka and Tateru kill Takayuki to get the insurance money. Conan is not convinced with Kogoro deduction. Later, he spots a clause which states that the money can't be collected in the event of suicide within three years after signing the contract. Conan finally knows what actually happened.

title.ja: あの人を取り戻したい

summary.en: At morning in Kasuba town, a guy accidentally runs over an old man after trying to avoid a cat. The only witness is an old lady. The culprit of the accident, Hajime Inukai, lies after saying that he will drive to the hospital to save the man. Location: Kasuba Town Victim: Daijiro Butsumaru Cause of death: Car accident Culprit: Hajime Inukai A man runs over Butsumaru after trying to avoid running over a cat. The only witness is an old lady. The victim's name is Daijiro Butsumaru, who is a company president and a large estate owner. After seeing the hit-and-run case in the TV, the victim's wife Emiko Butsumaru asks for Kogoro's help to bring her husband back. Later they recieve a call of an unknown person, who offers Emiko to buy her husband's body for 10 million yen, or else she will never see his body again, and also they mention that they knows she needs it. Grave robbery - Extortion Victim: Daijiro Butsumaru Suspects: Unknown culprit The culprit hides the body after Inukai buried it. They also found Inukai in Kasuba Town, who confess everything and the location of the buried body, but it turns out the unknown person who offered to sell the body robbed it from there, so Inukai isn't the culprit of the stolen body. The culprit decides to raise the price to 30 million yen. Later, Kogoro and Conan discover the main safe in Butsumaru House who only opens with facial recognition, and Emiko says that all of the "memories" are inside the safe, that's because she is willing to pay that quantity. After the Kasuba police arrest Inukai, Megure and Takagi arrive to the house, and reveal that Butsumaru had rented an apartment in Kasuba city and that's probably the motive why he was there at the time of the accident. Meanwhile, Emiko is mad for something. Conan asks Emiko if she noticed something strange in Daijiro, she only says that he received a call of Kadokura telling him that he will be okay and he also tells him that he will arrive to work late. Conan then connects the pieces to solve the case.

title.ja: わるいやつら

summary.en: The Detective Boys, without Haibara and Ayumi, are walking in the street when they hear screams in a house. It turns out a lady and her daughter felled of the stairs and they treat the boys like they are robbers. The young woman's husband is trying to help the women, but they treat him as a servant. Location: Hirasawa household Victim: Seiko Hirasawa and Kaori Hirasawa Age: 68 years old (Seiko) and 27 years old (Kaori) Cause: Fall from stairs Then, the Detective Boys, this time with Ayumi, are in a park and they see the husband of the house buying food. Ayumi recognizes him and says he is Ryoji Hirasawa, the husband of the daughter of Hirasawa family, a family who owns various properties around the city. The mother Seiko Hirasawa and the daughter and Ryoji's wife Kaori Hirasawa are part of the family, when Ryoji, who previously worked in an insurance company who had business with the Hirasawas married to the daughter. Ryoji trips and falls, but the Detective Boys help him and accompany him to the house. The women keep treating Ryoji as a servant and order him to cook for them, while they go jogging, but a minutes later the boys hear a scream, and find that the women were hit by a car. Location: Intersection near Hirasawa household Victim: Seiko Hirasawa and Kaori Hirasawa Age: 68 years old (Seiko) and 27 years old (Kaori) Modus operandi: Hit by car Suspects: Kinue Hasegawa The women are delivered to the hospital in an ambulance. Meanwhile, Conan managed to follow the car that ran over the women, and the driver is a young lady. Conan follows the woman who arrives to Beika Hospital and talks to Ryoji, who is also there. It seems the lady is an employee of the same insurance company employee mentioned before.

title.ja: 警察に居座った男
title.zhHant: 不肯離開警察署的男人
title.en: The Man Who Camped Out at the Police Station
title.enRaw: The Man Who Camped Out at the Police Station

summary.en: A man is arrested for the murder of his rival. He confesses but his description of how the murder was done didn´t match with the real situation. Is that really the case, or there's another culprit? Location: Odawara house, Sebundai Town Victim: Shuhei Odawara Time: Between 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM Cause of death: Strangulation or blunt-force trauma? Culprit: Yosuke Katsuki

title.ja: 沖野ヨーコと屋根裏の密室（前編）
title.zhHans: 冲野洋子与阁楼密室（前篇）
title.zhHant: 沖野洋子與閣樓裡的密室（上集）
title.en: Yoko Okino and the Locked Attic (Part 1)

summary.en: Ran tells Kogoro that the butter sandwiches he ate were past their expiration date. She thinks that he is cheating when she notices that his desk is tidy and that he is dressed up. Conan tells her that it might be because Yoko is coming there as his client. Kogoro ends up with the stomach problems and head towards the toilet. Meanwhile, Wakita delivers the sushi and overhears the case from outside and shows interest of the case. Yoko also shows them the group photo of the four who were present with her that day. She mentions the past the brothers shared about playing card games in the attic, hiding from their strict parents. And also that Nukiyasu called his brother Fuugo Ace, despite him not being a pitcher in the past while Fuggo called Heijima the real Ace. She shows a photo of Hejima's sister, wearing long sleeves dress and sunglasses, who also went missing two years ago.

title.ja: 沖野ヨーコと屋根裏の密室（後編）
title.zhHans: 冲野洋子与阁楼密室（后篇）
title.zhHant: 沖野洋子與閣樓裡的密室（下集）
title.en: Yoko Okino and the Locked Attic (Part 2)

summary.en: Yoko also mention one odd thing that Hejima said about the number of pine trees being less. In the toilet, Kogoro prepares a coded message to ask for tissue paper and sends it to Conan, who along with Wakita see through the code immediately. From this coded message, Conan and Wakita also solve the case.

title.ja: 警察学校編 Wild Police Story CASE. 諸伏景光
title.zhHans: 警察学校篇 Wild Police Story CASE.诸伏景光
title.zhHant: 警察學校篇 Wild Police Story CASE. 諸伏景光
title.en: Police Academy Arc Wild Police Story CASE. Hiromitsu Morofushi
title.enRaw: Police Academy Arc Wild Police Story CASE. Hiromitsu Morofushi

summary.ja: 降谷、萩原、伊達、松田が止めるのを振り切り、諸伏は炎に包まれた家の階段を駆け上っていく――！話は三時間前にさかのぼる。五人は鬼塚教官に捕まり派手な行動の数々に対して咎めを受け、風呂掃除を命じられていた。その最中、コピー機にある昨夜捜索願が出された女の子の情報を目にする。女の子を町で見かけたことのあった諸伏は、写真を貰っていた。掃除中も当然その話題になったが、諸伏は「子どもの頃に遊んでいた女の子とそっくりだ」というだけで詳しいことははぐらかそうとする。誰かが巻き込まれることに怯える諸伏に、四人は口をそろえて「死なねぇよ！」と声をかける。それに勇気づけられた諸伏は、自身が過去に遭遇した事件について話し始めるのだった。十五年前、諸伏が父、母と夕飯を食べていた時に何度もインターホンを鳴らす音が聞こえた。どうやら訪問してきた男は父親の知り合いのようで、最初は穏やかに会話する声が聞こえたが徐々に不穏な雰囲気に。様子を見に行き、戻ってきた母は諸伏に「押し入れに隠れるように」と伝える。その押し入れから諸伏が感じたのは、鉄の匂いと犯人の奇妙な言葉、肩に入ったゴブレットの様な刺青――。

title.ja: 雨と悪意のスパイラル
title.en: The Spiral of Rain and Malice
title.enRaw: The Spiral of Rain and Malice

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys discover an abandoned car when they arrive at the vacant lot, though they'd ignore it and continue with their plan to play football. Later, Conan and Haibara notice a woman speaking something to her recorder when Genta tries to warn her about the ball that Mitsuhiko fails to block. The woman gets angry, as Genta calls her aunt, but quickly apologizes afterward, with Genta also apologizing to her. Then they have a fun football game together until the lightning strikes, the woman then waves goodbye to the boys while she is waiting for someone. The next day, there is news about a woman who looks exactly as the one Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys met yesterday is found dead, which shocks the kids as they come to the scene. The identity of the woman is revealed to be Tamaki Onda. Location: Shikigawa river, Tokyo Metropolis Time: Between midnight and 2 AM Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Ryuji Koyabu and Yurina Shirosaki Takagi says that Tamaki Onda has many injuries but since there was rain, the time when she died is still not identified yet. Furthermore, the examination shows that she wasn’t robbed and there was a strange jewel in her hand. Conan and Haibara wonder if her recorder was there, and the police confirm that it wasn’t. While at the scene, a man after being noticed by the boys suddenly runs away in his truck, so the boys follow him. When they arrive, Takagi and Chiba also arrive at his place, as the fingerprint in Onda’s glasses matches with the fingerprint of Ryuji Koyabu, who has just finished serving a sentence. Later, Chiba reports about the jewelry Onda was holding, and tells everyone to come to his place to ask the second suspect, Yurina Shirosaki. However, it turns out that at the estimated death time, both of them had their own alibis. Conan suggests investigating the case again and he, along with Haibara and the Detective Boys get to go along with Takagi and Chiba because they spent time with the victim. At Koyabu’s workplace, one Cheetah Delivery employee states that Koyabu got up in the car at 12:35 am and unloaded the package at 1:05 am and never went away to somewhere else, with the latter being 30 minutes later than usual. So the group decides to investigate the place where he was being later than usual. They also receive a report from Chiba about a small accident that happened at 11:30 pm, so they suggest he check the surveillance camera nearby. Later, they notice an old woman with her dog carrying a jewel that looks like the one they got from the scene. And after they ask the woman, Conan deduces that Koyabu and Shirosaki must have hidden something that might be involved in Onda's tragic death. Everyone gathers at the scene, and with the footage from the aforementioned accident, the truth is then revealed.

title.ja: 狙われたひよこ鑑定士

summary.en: Multiple Attempted Murders? Location: Multiple locations, including Kusano Eggs headquarters Victim: Hitoshi Nanba Methods: Flying rubber ball, exploding phone, burning hand with magnifying glass and dropping detergent Location: Kusano Eggs headquarters Victim: Hitoshi Nanba Suspects: Saburo Kusano, Takashi Nakamura, Mamiko Hirasawa, and Kazumasa Kitazawa

title.ja: 夢見る貴婦人、最後の恋
title.zhHant: 癡人說夢的貴婦人 和她最後的戀愛
title.en: The Dreamy-Eyed Woman's Last Shot at Love
title.enRaw: The Dreamy-Eyed Woman's Last Shot at Love

summary.en: (Potential) Scam? Amount: 300 million yen

title.ja: 探偵は眠らない

summary.en: A young office worker named Kae Nishiwaki asked Kogoro to investigate someone who sneaks into her apartment when she goes to work. She tells him that this has happened three times and that they leave gifts each time they sneak in. Kogoro visits her apartment, with Conan tagging along, and she finds that someone has placed a suitcase in her room. Kogoro opens it to see the dead body of Ryuko Kusakabe, Kae's boss, and all of them are shocked. Location: Hidora Park, Hidora Town Victim: Ryuko Kusakabe Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Hisashi Tsukumo The police are called, and they realize that the victim died at 1 am when she was struck on her head with a blunt object. Kae informs them that the culprit snuck into her apartment on Thursdays. The forensic officer then finds a listening device in her room. While questioning the residents of the building, and old lady called Kino Kinoshita tells the police that a resident called Hisashi Tsukumo had once returned Kae's key after she lost it. While asking Tsukumo, the police find that he has his Thursdays off. But Tsukumo informs them that he has an alibi for the previous night. Megure then receive a call informing him that the crime occurred at a park in Hidora. The weapon and a lighter with Tsukumo's fingerprints are found near the crime scene. Tsukumo once told Kinoshita that seeing Kae reminded him of his sister. She tells this to Kogoro and Conan.

title.ja: 死が二人を分かつまで

summary.en: Kogoro, along with Conan, is invited to the wedding of the son of a man who met at a bar he frequents, but suddenly the bride, Sayoko Imamura, says that she doesn't feels well and collapses. She was poisoned. Location: Wedding hall Victim: Sayoko Imamura Cause of death: Mushroom poisoning Suspects: Shinpo Yokoyama, Hiroko Nagashima, Alex Harutoshi Kawasu, Gakuto Yamada, Naho Mizuguchi, and Nobuteru Yokoyama After entering the wedding hall, she suddenly says that she doesn't feels well and collapses, dying at the scene. There are numerous suspects that said supsicious things when the murder happened. But who is the real culprit and what is the motive behind this tragedy on a happy day?

title.ja: 恋する商店街

summary.en: Kogoro and Conan pass by a lonely shopping street. They try to shop at a greengrocer that catches their eyes, but the owner, Yoshinobu Yamazaki, seems to be in a bad mood. Madam Gaga, a producer who revitalizes the exhausted shopping district, and her assistant, Rabbit Suzuki, came there. Madam calls out holding a professional wrestling tournament to liven up the shopping district, using as icon the female wrestler and Gaga's daughter, Cutie Mimi. The shopkeepers of the shopping district train their bodies through various trainings, and Kogoro will also participate as a referee. Ran, with the provocation of Cutie Mimi, also decides to fight her and prepares.

title.ja: 円谷光彦の探偵ノート

summary.en: Pizza seems to be not too expensive to buy in general, so why one divided for Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys, which Genta earned for, is stolen? Victims: Detective Boys Stolen items: Pizza boxes The 5 pizza boxed divided from a pizza that Genta earned for his close friends were stolen, but the pizza slices remained intact when the kid found it again. Later, they notice the police is asking the pizza shop for some reason when they return to the shop Location: Jewelry store Robbed items: Ten small diamonds Culprits: Two people Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys discovered that 10 diamonds of the Jewelry store near the pizza shop were stolen and put in the pizza boxes of the said shop. The boys begin their own investigation, only to find out something interesting... Victim: First robber Injury: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Second robber One of the robbers (the robber had trace of cardboard being pried off) is seen injured. The Detective Boys begin their own investigation and find the whereabout of the final diamonds, but since they can drive themselves into danger again, Conan and Haibara have to look for them with Conan's glasses.

title.ja: 受話器ごしのスウィートボイス
title.zhHant: 電話另一端的甜美聲音
title.en: The Sweet Voice Heard Through the Phone
title.enRaw: The Sweet Voice Heard Through the Phone

summary.en: Kogoro is hired by a beautiful woman named Mayako Nagamine, but after a call, when he meets her, she is found murdered in a park. Location: Kuraun Park Victim: Mayako Nagamine Cause of death: Stab wound on the abdomen Suspects: Haruhiko Nagamine The only suspect is Mayako's husband Haruhiko Nagamine, but it seems that the murder was't done by him. Another suspect named Ippei Aragaki is added and it seems he was in the scene before Haruhiko. Who is the real murderer?

title.ja: サプライズは悲劇のはじまり
title.en: The Surprise That Leads to Tragedy
title.enRaw: The Surprise That Leads to Tragedy

summary.en: Mai Takigawa accidentally kills her boyfriend Yusuke Tsuda in self-defense after misunderstanding him as a burglar, but in reality, he along with Mai's best friend Riko Totsuka planned a surprise party for her birthday. Location: Mai Takigawa's apartment Victim: Yusuke Tsuda Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Culprit: Mai Takigawa Takagi and Sato arrive at the scene to investigate, and also does Conan, who was at the apartment complex at the time and heard the scream along with Agasa and the Detective Boys. Conan and the police discover clues that make them think that there's more behind this case.

title.ja: 工藤優作の推理ショー（前編）
title.zhHans: 工藤优作的推理秀（前篇）
title.zhHant: 工藤優作的推理秀（上集）

summary.en: After exiting the police headquarter and being interviewed by reporters, Yusaku Kudo reveals that he is going to do a live broadcast solving three locked room murders that took place on the last days, but three days later, on the day of the show, Yukiko Kudo tells Conan that Yusaku suddenly got food poisoning and has a stomachache, and that she will disguise as him, and with Conan's help, solve the case. Yukiko reveals details of the murders. The first victim named Atsumi Morita, an apparel company employee, was killed in the bathroom of her apartment after being pushed to the sink and hitting her head with it twenty days ago, the bathroom door was locked and the scene was ransacked, with various bathroom items on the floor. The one who found the body is Saiko Yumekawa, Atsumi's friend, who is known for conducting interviews using a pink mic. She is also the reporter coming for the live broadcast. The second murder took place ten days after the first murder. The victim, Taiji Kiryu, a permanent-part time worker, was stunned with a stun gun and later strangled with a rope in the entrance of his apartment. The scene was also a mess with garbage, bags and used ramen cups. It seems he fought back while being strangled and the culprit's skin got in his fingernails.

title.ja: 工藤優作の推理ショー（後編）
title.zhHans: 工藤优作的推理秀（后篇）
title.zhHant: 工藤優作的推理秀（下集）

summary.en: Conan tells Kid the details of the murders. The time of the show arrives and Yusaku (Kid) will be solving the case with the help of Conan.

title.ja: 探偵団の引ったくり大追跡
title.zhHans: 侦探团的抢劫案大追踪
title.en: The Detective Boys' Pursuit of the Purse-snatcher
title.enRaw: The Detective Boys' Pursuit of the Purse-snatcher

summary.en: Ayumi sees a mysterious man running with a bag. 10 minutes later, an old man named Shousaku Kume says that someone robbed his bag that cointained 300 thousand yen. Location: Beika Town Victim: Shousaku Kume Robbed item: 300.000 yen Later, when the police arrive, a Cheetah Delivery employee asks for help because he found a body in an apartment near the robbery. Location: Koichi Samura's apartment Victim: Koichi Samura Cause of death: Stab wound on the back Suspects: Katsumi Togane The victim, Koichi Samura, was an extorter who blackmailed many people. Later, his friend, Katsumi Togane is found poisoned in an Izakaya at Haido City. Location: Toriko Izakaya, Haido Town Victim: Katsumi Togane Cause of death: Poison It seems that Togane killed himself after robbing Kume and killing Samura. But is this really the case?

title.ja: てっちり対決ミステリーツアー（門司港・小倉編）
title.zhHans: 河豚火锅对决推理之旅（门司港·小仓篇）
title.zhHant: 河豚火鍋對決推理之旅（門司港・小倉篇）
title.en: The Boiled Fugu Mystery Tour Showdown (Mojiko & Kokura Part)
title.enRaw: *The Boiled Fugu Mystery Tour Showdown* (Mojiko & Kokura Part)

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan visit Shimonoseki, Yamaguchi Prefecture, with the introduction of Hiroki Oi, a lawyer they met in a past case. The client is Makoto Izumiya, the fourth generation owner of a long-established puffer fish restaurant Izumiya, and his daughter Kaede. It is said that, when the store was at its busiest and no one was in the house, a burglar broke in and stole the heirloom pot. It's an expensive hot pot, but what's important to them is the soup stock that comes out of the hot pot's skin, which has been steeped in the umami flavor since the restaurant's founding. Conan and the others go to interview four suspect candidates narrowed down by the police. There are four suspects: Yasushi Kobayashi, an employee at a restaurant at Kanmon Wharf who was arrested two years ago for robbing Izumiya restaurant; Shinichi Fujii, the owner of Kan restaurant chain who failed to buy Izumiya; Satoru Daiehara, the owner of King Arthur restaurant who knows about Izumiya's pot; and Keisuke Ban, a former employee at Izumiya who was fired. They start to investigate by going to visit each suspects and ask them questions, while also traveling in different places. At the night, Kogoro, Ran, and Conan visit an izakaya where they start their deductions, but when they exit the Izakaya, the robber is seen and chased by Ran, but before escaping, he attacks Kogoro with a bottle.

title.ja: てっちり対決ミステリーツアー（下関編）
title.zhHans: 河豚火锅对决推理之旅（下关篇）
title.zhHant: 河豚火鍋對決推理之旅（下關篇）
title.en: The Boiled Fugu Mystery Tour Showdown (Shimonoseki Part)
title.enRaw: *The Boiled Fugu Mystery Tour Showdown* (Shimonoseki Part)

summary.en: Doctor says that Kogoro is fine after all, and he will be fully recovered in two weeks. Kogoro claims that he will proceed his investigation, uttered by Conan using his voice-changing bowtie. Oi phones Conan informing that the coworker who verified Kobayashi's alibi lied, which implies that he no longer has an alibi. Due to the fear of accusation plus he had a criminal record formerly, Kobayashi attempts to run away, heading towards Shin-Shimonoseki station. So, is Kobayashi the true culprit? And how did they cross the Kanmon Channel without appearing within the camera footage?

title.ja: カリスマ社長の極秘計画

summary.en: Kogoro and Conan discovered a corpse on the street while taking a stroll. Seemingly, the deceased have been hit in the head with a metal pipe, and remained a dying message that looks like "1-1-2". The estimated time of death is around 9PM last night, Conan visited the deceased's apartment. Location: Beika street Victim: Akira Komoda Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Tosuke Utagawa According to the apartment manager, no one seem to hold grudge with the victim Komoda. Owing to the fact that Komoda doesn't have a job and claimed yesterday afternoon that he will pay off all of his unpaid apartment rent tomorrow, Kogoro deduces that he must be blackmailing people for a living, and Komoda might be anti-killed by his blackmailed target. The manager added that Komoda noticed the photo of Tosuke Utagawa on the magazine, who is the CEO of Utagawa Corporation. And declared that Utagawa would be the perfect target for him to blackmail, due to his wealth. The police talked to the CEO, Utagawa. He seemed rather arrogant, and he doesn't have an alibi when the crime was carried out. Up until now, he looks like the person who would kill Komoda for a plausible reason. Tomoe Izumi, the lady that they encountered in the crime scene, said that yesterday morning Komoda approached her to consult about Juichi Innami, who was a her former resident. Innami had been gone for ten days and had only came back the other night. However, he claimed that he was moving away. Izumi showed a video with the appearance of Innami which shocked everyone, Innami looks exactly identical with the CEO Utagawa. Are they the same person? After a long time of reasoning, another possibility emerged. Innami may be a substitute of Utagawa for fabricating certain alibi, in the premise of their exact same appearances. Kogoro said that it's possible that Komoda blackmailed Utagawa by taking advantage over this matter, and Innami might be killed by Utagawa after the alibi was fabricated. Later, they found out that there was a reward ceremony that was held within Utagawa's company on the evening of 9th. This leads to the assumption that Innami might've substituted Utagawa to attend the ceremony. However, by doing fingerprint analysis, the fingerprints on the winner award tend to matched with Utagawa's. This means that it was the real CEO who attended the ceremony, the investigation went into a stalemate once again. While investigating, Conan and Kogoro deduced Komoda's dying message: 11 refers to the number's pronunciation (Jū-ichi/十一) referring to Juichi Innami, and the 2 means in reality the kanji 乙 (Oto), referring to Otohime Park (乙姫公園), the park where Komoda usually hung out. In conclusion, the dying message means that Juichi Innami is related to the park and that probably something happened there that was witnessed by Komoda, and that's why he was killed. Now that they have those clues, they immediately start to investigate the park, and after digging a hole, they find the dead body of Juichi Innami. Location: Otohime Park Victim: Juichi Innami Cause of death: Strangulation Suspects: Tosuke Utagawa Conan thinks there's more behind this case, and finally discovers a shocking truth.

title.ja: 黒ずくめの謀略（狩り）

summary.en: A person (probably an FBI agent) is waiting for Tony, only to be welcomed by Vodka and Gin, with the latter giving him the choice of surrendering the FBI base location or the choice of being killed. A cold shot is made. Double-Murder (Past) Location: Backstreet in Beika Town Victims: Jack and Tony Time: Last night (October 2nd) Cause of death: Gunshot wounds Culprits: Gin and Vodka Conan, Haibara and the Detective Boys are discussing the recent unidentified foreign murders when they hear a loud noise... Location: Rooftop of Café Guava, Beika Town Cause of death: Gunshot wound to the head Culprits: Gin and Vodka After seeing Vodka, Conan tells the Detective Boys and Haibara not to approach the scene, especially not to show themselves to Haibara, which frightens her immediately. Location: Café Guava, Beika Town Cause of death: Falling from rooftop Conan tries to hide his appearance while trying to check the victim’s belongings that fell with Korn, Chianti and Gin getting ready to eliminate him but fortunately, there are also some other witnesses making the elimination very risky. Therefore, the Black Organization has to retreat. Conan finds the identity and a strange board that might be the code, so he tells others to hide in a convenience store while waiting for Agasa to pick them up, and Conan rushes to the Kudo’s residence. However, on the way, he can’t call either Akai or his parents. When he gets in the residence, he is surprised to see many FBI agents there. Turns out 3 days ago, an FBI agent named Aaron went missing when following the trace of Black Organization and was found dead on the next day, and several FBI agents were ambushed about 1 and 2 days ago, all of them used a specific code to form a meeting. With the concern that Aaron had leaked the way to solve the code for the Black Organization and most importantly, their base in Japan, all agents end up in the Kudo’s residence as a temporary hideout, with Kudo’s family buying supplies for them to avoid being exposed. Location: Somewhere in Tokyo Victims: Aaron and some other agents Time: 3 and 2 days ago Cause of death: Gunshot wounds Culprit: Black Organization Conan then reveals the death of two recent FBI agents to James and explains the way he and most probably, the Black Organization, solved the code so easily. And to make it more intuitive, he asks Camel to print out two copies, with one of them reversed. Conan cracks the code easily, even reproducing the alphabet based on the code language, which impressed many FBI agents. Camel, however, suggests that they should use this loophole to lure the Black Organization out, combined with the fact that the press has not reported on the recent deaths of two FBI agents makes this plan seem almost flawless. Mark also wants to join this plan to avenge his brother’s death, so Camel also volunteers to be along, with Akai reminding him that he must not show up his face to the Organization or else Kir might be killed as well, cutting the precious information. However, before the organization's hunt, Rum steps in and proves why he is second-in-command in the organization when he easily foils the FBI's counter-hunt plot and causes them to suffer heavy losses. Meanwhile, the Kudo couple suddenly returned and after they grasp the situation and Conan finally remembers something, the discovery of the counter-hunt plan was somewhat explained. Location: Kadefu Town, Tokyo Prefecture Victims: Bill, David, Andre Camel, Mark, George, and Daniel Age: 27 years old (Camel) Attack types: Long-range firearm shots Culprits: Gin, Vodka, Chianti, and Korn The Kudo family and Conan explain the mistake Jodie made while working on the code, the other agents console them that they had made a mistake. Fortunately, Camel's situation was fine, it was just that his friend Mark needed medical attention, so Akai gives instructions that Camel almost understands and follows immediately. This helps them temporarily get rid of the car chasing him, but he is later pursued by Gin, Vodka, Vermouth and Kir, and he eventually falls down the river. Although they have witnessed Camel's fall, it seems that Korn had seen him somewhere before, which gives the Black Organization a new target: to track down Camel's whereabouts. This made Kir extremely worried because if Camel is revealed as the agent who had previously escorted her, she would lose her life. Meanwhile, Camel was struggling in his car but luckily Conan's quick thinking helped him escape for the time being. Camel later finds land and based on certain characteristics, Yusaku and Conan deduce that Camel is currently on Umizaru Island, from which a rescue plan is made while Camel waits there to warm himself up to avoid hypothermia. Location: Sea Monkey Island, Yokosuka, Kanagawa Prefecture Culprits: Gin, Vodka, Chianti, Korn, Vermouth, Kir, and Rum Akai (disguised as Subaru) borrows Conan (who is very eager for this mission), but the unfavorable variable comes from the heating when it attracts Gin's attention, and also drags the members along to hunt him down, all because Korn had seen his face somewhere. Kir also calls Akai at this time to inform him that if she is the one to see Camel first, she will have to aim in the face, with Akai agreeing. Camel, who had previously smeared olive oil and dirt on his face, retrieved some sacks, a roll of tape, a box cutter, and some straws as instructed by Akai. Conan asks about his current belongings and realizes that the hat Camel was wearing is of some kind. However, the conversation is cut short when Vodka and Chianti accidentally enter Camel's hiding place, and Camel also overheard Vodka blowing Rum's cover. Suddenly Vodka accidentally sees Camel but he steps on coffee beans from a sack that Camel had picked up earlier, Chianti is no different as she apparently doesn’t have a pistol to shoot him. These two things allow Camel to temporarily use the diaphane technique as instructed by Akai to wait until morning because searching the entire island to find the diaphane would take a lot of time. When this plan is discovered by Gin, Gin intends to search the island, but Rum wants to turn the island into an incinerator. Meanwhile, Akai and Conan arrive at Namikaze Park, which is near the island where Camel and the organization are, but they see that the island is on fire, forcing Camel to wake up immediately, luckily he still has some of his belongings from before. However, the call is soon cut off when Chianti sees him, but she actually doesn’t have a real pistol as she shot Camel with a sniper rifle. Camel is now in a critical situation on the docks, with only a small barrier separating life and death. Will he make it back alive?
summary.zhHans: 朗姆调查线的组织事件群，围绕组织行动、身份判断和长期调查逐步推进，具体单案范围仍待拆分。

Location: Somewhere in Tokyo Victims: Aaron and some other agents Time: 3 and 2 days ago Cause of death: Gunshot wounds Culprit: Black Organization Conan then reveals the death of two recent FBI agents to James and explains the way he and most probably, the Black Organization, solved the code so easily. And to make it more intuitive, he asks Camel to print out two copies, with one of them reversed. Conan cracks the code easily, even reproducing the alphabet based on the code language, which impressed many FBI agents. Camel, however, suggests that they should use this loophole to lure the Black Organization out, combined with the fact that the press has not reported on the recent deaths of two FBI agents makes this plan seem almost flawless. Mark also wants to join this plan to avenge his brother’s death, so Camel also volunteers to be along, with Akai reminding him that he must not show up his face to the Organization or else Kir might be killed as well, cutting the precious information. However, before the organization's hunt, Rum steps in and proves why he is second-in-command in the organization when he easily foils the FBI's counter-hunt plot and causes them to suffer heavy losses. Meanwhile, the Kudo couple suddenly returned and after they grasp the situation and Conan finally remembers something, the discovery of the counter-hunt plan was somewhat explained. Location: Kadefu Town, Tokyo Prefecture Victims: Bill, David, Andre Camel, Mark, George, and Daniel Age: 27 years old (Camel) Attack types: Long-range firearm shots Culprits: Gin, Vodka, Chianti, and Korn The Kudo family and Conan explain the mistake Jodie made while working on the code, the other agents console them that they had made a mistake. Fortunately, Camel's situation was fine, it was just that his friend Mark needed medical attention, so Akai gives instructions that Camel almost understands and follows immediately. This helps them temporarily get rid of the car chasing him, but he is later pursued by Gin, Vodka, Vermouth and Kir, and he eventually falls down the river. Although they have witnessed Camel's fall, it seems that Korn had seen him somewhere before, which gives the Black Organization a new target: to track down Camel's whereabouts. This made Kir extremely worried because if Camel is revealed as the agent who had previously escorted her, she would lose her life. Meanwhile, Camel was struggling in his car but luckily Conan's quick thinking helped him escape for the time being. Camel later finds land and based on certain characteristics, Yusaku and Conan deduce that Camel is currently on Umizaru Island, from which a rescue plan is made while Camel waits there to warm himself up to avoid hypothermia. Location: Sea Monkey Island, Yokosuka, Kanagawa Prefecture Culprits: Gin, Vodka, Chianti, Korn, Vermouth, Kir, and Rum Akai (disguised as Subaru) borrows Conan (who is very eager for this mission), but the unfavorable variable comes from the heating when it attracts Gin's attention, and also drags the members along to hunt him down, all because Korn had seen his face somewhere. Kir also calls Akai at this time to inform him that if she is the one to see Camel first, she will have to aim in the face, with Akai agreeing. Camel, who had previously smeared olive oil and dirt on his face, retrieved some sacks, a roll of tape, a box cutter, and some straws as instructed by Akai. Conan asks about his current belongings and realizes that the hat Camel was wearing is of some kind. However, the conversation is cut short when Vodka and Chianti accidentally enter Camel's hiding place, and Camel also overheard Vodka blowing Rum's cover. Suddenly Vodka accidentally sees Camel but he steps on coffee beans from a sack that Camel had picked up earlier, Chianti is no different as she apparently doesn’t have a pistol to shoot him. These two things allow Camel to temporarily use the diaphane technique as instructed by Akai to wait until morning because searching the entire island to find the diaphane would take a lot of time. When this plan is discovered by Gin, Gin intends to search the island, but Rum wants to turn the island into an incinerator. Meanwhile, Akai and Conan arrive at Namikaze Park, which is near the island where Camel and the organization are, but they see that the island is on fire, forcing Camel to wake up immediately, luckily he still has some of his belongings from before. However, the call is soon cut off when Chianti sees him, but she actually doesn’t have a real pistol as she shot Camel with a sniper rifle. Camel is now in a critical situation on the docks, with only a small barrier separating life and death. Will he make it back alive?

summary.en: Conan and Haibara were invited to Beika Department Store by the Detective Boys. The aim is the first prize of the lottery held at the bargain venue "Hachijo-jima Whale Watching Tour". Haibara is asked by the doctor to withdraw some cash while she's at it, and heads to the bank's ATM branch. However, just before that, Kogoro's cash card was swallowed by the machine and did not return. When he is about to go to another branch, he sees a suspicious man in a black suit. The man who noticed Haibara had a surprised expression on his face.

summary.en: At the Italian Izakaya “RESO” located in Beika Gourmet Restaurant Street, Kogoro and Conan are enjoying the tasty pizza baked by Takashi Yamaura, the owner of the restaurant and Kogoro’s acquaintance. Yamaura tells Conan the time Kogoro caught a person who dined and dashed at the restaurant, the way he threw the person so hard that it left a trace on the wall. As Yamaura is about to show the trace, hidden behind by the restaurant’s menu, an excavator strikes at the restaurant, injuring him in the process. The three go outside to see what is going on. Yamaura, upon seeing the excavator, furiously lashes out at the man driving the vehicle for reckless endangerment, to which the driver can only say he was hired by the owner of the alley, Hiroyuki Kusumi. Because numerous shop owners in the alley rejected the demolition request from Kusumi, he has been attempting to harass them, which has caused one shop owner to die under stress. Under the assistance of Fumio Nakano, owner of Sushi "Sakura-ya" and Yuji Yonezawa, owner of Creative Cuisine "Seventy Seven", Kogoro successfully controls the situation and makes Kusumi walk away. Location: RESO Italian Izakaya Culprit: Hiroyuki Kusumi Not long after, Conan wants to use the toilet. The toilet uses a special coin mechanism to unlock and lock the door. 15 minutes later, when Kogoro wants to use the toilet, he discovers the unconscious Kusumi inside. It was believed that he tripped in the toilet and hit his head. However, Conan realizes it is not an accident. Location: Beika Gourmet Restaurant Street Toilet Victim: Hiroyuki Kusumi Cause of injury: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Fumio Nakano The police then investigate the crime scene. Later, they discover that Fumio is the only one that did not have an alibi, so they search her restaurant to find the weapon used.

summary.en: Conan being lifted by two strikers. The "J League 30th Anniversary Match" is currently hitting the National Stadium with Kawasaki Frontale versus FC Tokyo. The Detective Boys were fairly lucky and got chosen by lottery, to participate a special event, have a good time out there by having a mixed special friendly match with players from both teams. They get along pretty well, Ayumi kicks out firstly, and passes the ball to Genta, following by Mitsuhiko, who kicks the ball in the air as he gets it. Then Conan, who gets lifted by two strikers, which heads the goal. Lastly, Kento Tachibanada, a player from the Kawasaki Frontale team, shoots the ball into the goal. Detective Boys gets extremely satisfied, Mitsuhiko then asks Kento what his secret to success is, he answers steadily: "First, relax and calm down." "And, keep a broad field of view. Look at not the pitch, but the entire stadium." Kuryu Matsuki added. Conan sighs and thinks people who compete internationally are on another level. At the same time, within the Metropolitan Police Department, Megure seems to be well-dressed for something. However, when his colleague asks him, he conceals his intent, and utters that it is only some minor business. The actual match finally begins, all Detective Boys members have retired to the auditorium. Amidst the laughter, there is one person who is in a bad mood, she is Haibara. Originally, she was planning to hold hands with her favorite soccer player from the Big Osaka team, Ryusuke Higo. Unluckily, she got the date of the game wrong. Apparently, the Big Osaka match was yesterday. Genta then proposes that another player from the Big Osaka, Takahiro Sanada, did tons of mistakes for the previous game. Haibara nodded, and said that Sanada missed a huge opportunity, hence Big Osaka lost the game badly. The weird man among the auditorium. As their remarks concerning Sanada proceeds, a voice from the back interrupts everyone. The person is precisely Sanada. While they watch the game together, Haibara perceives something strange in the stands behind the goal of the Kawasaki Frontale, which should have been occupied by fanatical fans, is empty. Haibara then finds the livestream on social media that displays the condition of the outside of the stadium, it is right now exceedingly chaotic. Somehow, the tickets that the fans had worked so hard becomes invalid. On the big display, Conan realises that there is one person that looks odd. He constantly looks at his watch and seems not interested at the game at all. Conan quickly calls Takagi for searching some information about him. After some time, Conan receives the information. Evidently, he is called Yuzo Fukunaga. Was a former terrorist and was the mastermind behind a large-scale terrorist plot. He was then arrested and was just released a few days ago. Takagi and Sato decide to head towards the National Stadium after being informed by Conan that something is not right there. Sanada grabs Conan while heading towards the front gate. Even though the match is fanatically in progress, Sanada and Conan no longer have interest on it anymore. They decide to investigate this case. When they arrive at the front gate, they see millions of insane football fans quarreling with regards to the invalid ticket. Notwithstanding that, the meticulous Conan identifies some people that is not so desperate to get inside, but was somewhat monitoring the scenes, and he deduces they might be Yuzo's accomplices. Just now, Haibara bombards Conan with a shocking news... Yuzo's accomplice handed him a long-shaped case, which looks like a sniper rifle! What is his target? What will him do? Bomb or Assasination Threat? Location: Japan National Stadium, Shinjuku Culprit: Yuzo Fukunaga

title.ja: 冷え切った男達

summary.en: The sun sets, filling the sky with a beautiful array of colors. Everything begins from a refrigerated warehouse. Kenzo Aizawa, the president of the company "Aizawa Foods" is inspecting the products inside the warehouse as usual. Simultaneously, a person, who is wearing a yellow hoodie, and possesses a peculiar hairstyle, surreptitiously enters the warehouse, moving cautiously towards the front door. He opens the door accordingly, a bright light with a rather strong intensity kicks in, illuminating the dim warehouse. Kenzo subconsciously covers his eye, he is absolutely gobsmacked. The mysterious man approaches him closer and closer, Kenzo suddenly collapses, and slumps to the ground. A silhouette of the culprit. After some hours, the managing director of the company Masaru Bando finds the president succumbing to unconsciousness inside the refrigerated warehouse. He seems fairly anxious about it and decides to call the police. However, Kenzo rejects this behavior by constantly shaking his head. Location: "Aizawa Foods" refrigerated warehouse Victim: Kenzo Aizawa Injury: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Reiji Aizawa The Mouri family is walking in the corridor of a hospital, notably with Kogoro's hand bandaged. Ran gets very concerned regarding his father, and says that she can never believe that he make a big fuss over a little cut from a knife. In the mean time, they are abruptly interrupted as they witnesses a dispute right in front of them, they halt their steps and observe what is going on. A young man wearing a yellow hoodie and laced with a peculiar hairstyle is punching another man. Ran gets forward and tries to impede the fight. After confirmation, they find out that the attacker is called Reiji Aizawa, the second son of Kenzo. And the other one will thus be the eldest son of Kenzo, Ryoichi Aizawa. Ryoichi questions if Reiji is the culprit of persecuting their father, but Reiji does not admit it. Kogoro calls himself embarrassing. After knowing that there is a renowned detective Kogoro Mouri present nearby, they start telling Kogoro what is exactly happening. They all work inside a small company called "Aizawa Foods". Reiji also discloses that most of the employees got fired pretty recently by his brother. Masaru says that he had day off and was sleeping the whole day, and when it was 7PM, he went to the company to pick his phone up, due to the fact that he forgot it in the office. When he entered the office, he noticed that president's briefcase was still lying on the floor. Later, he went to check the refrigerated warehouse to see if Kenzo was there, and the opening scenario happened. The doctor disrupts them and informs that Kenzo has just been treated and is awake now, everyone, goes to ask his condition. "I was just taking a nap", Kenzo laughs. Kogoro shows his puzzles, however Kenzo keeps insist that it was just an accident. Even though he says that he was far too tired and dozed off, Conan perceives a sense of incongruity in his words. Conan points to Kenzo's hands and asks if his hands are okay, because obviously there is swelling on the side of his right-hand. Conan questions him if he made it by opening the door, Kogoro adds that it does seem curious, and it looks like that Kenzo was being trapped inside the warehouse by someone. Kenzo equivocates "I know, I must've hit it on the floor when I fell asleep". Conan once again exclaims that it is abnormal to have a person using their hands to resist the fall when they are asleep. Conan deduces that it will be impossible that he was having a nap, moreover, Kogoro adds that the reason behind his falsehood is that he does not want this to be a legal case. "This is non-sense!" Kenzo shouts, at the same time, Ryoichi offers a request to Kogoro for investigating this case. The room is filled with an atmosphere of awkwardness. A shoe print that supposedly belongs to Reiji. Everyone visits the warehouse, where the incident has occurred. Reiji satirises that it is odd to have his stingy brother hiring a detective. Kogoro examines the padlock that is deposited on the warehouse door, and identifies that the padlock can be only locked from the outside. Therefore, to distinguish if this is an accident or not, he only needs to know that if the door was locked when the crime was carried out. Masaru says that it was locked when he went to check for Kenzo, after he utters the word, Ryoichi chuckles. Everyone inside the company can be a possible candidate for the culprit as the key to the padlock is just right inside the office. Conan gives another possibility of having former employees being the culprit since they might hold resent on Kenzo by firing them. Kenzo instantly corrects Conan that it would never happen, Conan then looks at Kenzo with a cocksure face, anti-questioning him that it seems like he already knew who the culprit was. Just now, another valuable clue enters Conan's sight. It is a shoe print on the concrete floor. Surprisingly, the only match to this print is Reiji's shoe. Kenzo also realizes it and quickly destroys the shoe print by pretending to faint on the concrete floor, which erases the print. He smiles as he reaches the floor. Kogoro shivering inside the warehouse. Everyone decides to enter the warehouse, as Kogoro steps in to the warehouse, a bone-chilling cold permeates the air, causing a visible mist to form with every breath. Ran then purposes Kogoro to call the police. Once again, Kenzo's emotion changes immediately, and stops Kogoro with his vexatious words. He explains that he is running a small company, and already in debt. Calling the police will destroy them, Conan again insinuates "You're doing it for the company? Are you sure you're not protecting something more important than the company?" Reiji then laughs coldly saying that his father have never cared about others but only his company, and mentions his mother's death as an example. Ran comes up with another explanation that maybe Kenzo regrets doing that and now decides to protect his family this time. Ryoichi goes on and suspects Reiji for his argument with Kenzo yesterday afternoon, but Reiji says that he will not kill a person for merely that. Conan notices Ryoichi's weird reactions. In addition, Reiji has a solid alibi when the crime was implemented. He was drinking all evening at a place called Club L. And says that he is leaving now owing to his reservation again today. As he opens the door and about to leave, the bright beam of light shines to Conan's eye, he seems to be even closer to the truth. He then gets the information from Ryoichi that Kenzo kept the door closed while inspecting the products inside the warehouse to not let the cold air escape. Kenzo is as though fed up with Conan's dedicated investigation and invites Kogoro and Conan to leave the warehouse. Outside the warehouse, Kogoro, Ran, Ryoichi, and Conan stands together and discuss the case. Kogoro says that Reiji looks suspicious after all, and although he has an alibi, but it might be rather easy to fake one due to how familiar he is with regards to the club. Conan starts to ask Ryoichi's alibi that time, nevertheless, he claims that he was working at home after he leaves his company at 5PM, and nobody can verify that. But Ryoichi says that if he were the culprit, then it does not make sense to hire Kogoro for investigating the case, and Kogoro echoes and tells Conan to stop interfering the case. In front of the club, a girl is talking to Reiji, and Reiji says that tonight is a prominent day for him, and he is prepared to do everything. At the other side, Conan asks Masaru about Ryoichi, and his behavior throughout the case. Masaru asks Conan if Kogoro is also suspecting Ryoichi, and informs Conan that Ryoichi actually has a motive for killing the president, by the reason of his eagerness of taking over the company. Conan contemplates, meticulously piecing together fragments of evidence, analyzing clues, and pondering various possibilities until finally, a definitive conclusion emerges in his mind.

title.ja: 不吉な縁結び（前編）

summary.en: Conan, Ran, and Kazuha, who came to Tokyo, visited the Haido Shrine, which was best known for matchmaking. Owing to the encounter of the "115 fate" day, the shrine was rather crowded. Ran previously did not know about this popular attraction and inquired of Kazuha how she became aware of it.
