At that time, the Detective Boys have decided to watch the love scenes of each person they met earlier, however when they returned, it was very strange: Kobayashi was eating with Chiba, while Taiko Meijin was eating with Naeko, and Shiratori was eating with Yumi; this shocks Conan while Haibara prepares to investigate and clarify and criticize this Triple Collab. However, before that happened, they notices Tokumi Nagasu suddenly falls off in her chair and seems to have died after eating the cake, this makes the whole group scream, attracting an even greater sky of anger than when the one that the Detective Boys just followed notice the scream. They are very surprised when they meet each other at first and begin to question their respective match:

title.ja: トリプルコラボの浮気疑惑（後編）
title.zhHans: 三重联动的出轨疑云（后篇）
title.zhHant: 疑似出軌的三重協作（下集）
title.en: The Suspected Infidelity of the Triple Collab (Part 2)
title.enRaw: *The Suspected Infidelity of the Triple Collab* (Part 2)

summary.en: What has to happen, happens, Conan receives a call from Yumi and is informed about the crime scene, the suspect's testimony, Conan also asks her some small questions about the victim and is immediately answered with the crime scene recording at that time. And with the selfie of the group of 4 people, Conan also realizes the truth of the case. However, suddenly before that, Yumi suddenly saw the heart symbol on the 7th of this month in Kobayashi's notebook when they were looking for Agasa's number to send the security tape, from there they decided to solve this case without Conan. But are the two people's deductions similar?

title.ja: 円谷光彦の探偵ノート 3

summary.en: Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Genta happen to witness a quarrel taking place in front of an elderly actor selection venue, where two retired brothers, named Makio Yuida and Kozo Yuida respectively, were involved. To ascertain further details, the three Detective Boys visit Kozo and learn that Kozo was chosen to be the elderly actor immediately, which aroused Mitsuhiko to share some Sherlock Holmes "canon". He tells Kozo about the short story titled The Red-Headed League. Accordingly, he suspects Kozo might be drawn into a gigantic fraud, which is similar to the Sherlock Holmes story. However, as they arrived at Kozo's home, nothing out of the ordinary was noticed. Kozo mentioned that he and his brother each had a teapot inherited from their father. Recently he received a letter expressing his desire to purchase both their teapots. Soon, Mitsuhiko noticed something odd in the letter: even though the return address was written to be in Kyoto, the post stamp was clearly from Tokyo. Conan and Haibara perceive Detective Nakamura at their back. At the same time, Conan and Haibara were searching for the rest of the people, but encountered Detective Nakamura following Makio. When the Detective Boys liaised with each other, they inquired Makio about the teapot, yet were blasted away by him promptly. While leaving Makio's home, the Detective Boys met Ami Kimura, who was Makio's neighbour. She disclosed that Makio often talked about his journeys at the veranda, despite their unfamiliarity. Ayumi then noticed the cocoon on Kimura's hand, and the gloves in her pocket; as such, she surmised that Kimura is a mangaka. Successfully, a serial robbery case happening persistently in second-hand stores caught their attention - importantly, the head of the robbery gang was still yet to be captured. Conan then notices Detective Takagi and Detective Chiba, who are again on a stakeout. According to their observations, Makio is most likely the head of robbers. Mitsuhiko continued this deduction and speculated that his proceeding target is Kozo. The Detective Boys hurry to Kozo's house, but Kozo declares that he has just received another letter, and it also comes with a ticket to Kyoto. Mitsuhiko following Kozo. That night, Mitsuhiko discoveres Kozo was sneakily following Makio. They all saw Makio had opened the door of his apartment, but he then hesitated, and returned to his house immediately. Kozo was then instigated to contact his brother Makio. On the phone Makio discloses that "he needed money since he now depends 'on credit' to make a living (ツケで暮らしていて), and would approach Kozo in turn". Mitsuhiko notices something strange. Normally Makio calls Kozo by his name, but in the phone call, the appellation was changed to "younger brother" (弟); as such, Makio was trying to explain his relationship with Kozo. In addition to that, "Tsuke" (ツケ) is a terminology in the game of go, meaning adjacent to the enemy. This suggests that Makio is in danger, so Detective Chiba goes to rescue him by heading upstairs. Location: Makio's Residence Injury: Blunt force trauma Despite this, Makio was found beaten by the teapot in his home. He's left in a non-life-threatening condition. Meanwhile, Mitsuhiko runs towards the corridor of the buckwheat noodle restaurant and confronts the culprit.

title.ja: ベストハズバンド

summary.en: Kogoro was invited by Reiko Mutsu to come to her residence, with Ran and Conan tagging along. They are welcomed by Reiko’s secretary Shinji Inui upon arriving. Suddenly, the four are alerted by a scream, and go to the source to check it out. There, they find a mysterious man threatening Reiko with a knife, but he starts to run away as soon as he sees the four. Location: Mutsu Residence - Main Entrance Attack Types: Stabbing Culprit: Takeshi Akamatsu Kogoro and Conan chase the man, but he manages to get into the Annex–where Reiko’s husband Taro resides. It is at this point that everyone becomes concerned, as Reiko reveals how weak her husband is, only for everyone to learn that Taro somehow retaliates against the man and kills him. Location: Mutsu Residence - Annex Victim: Takeshi Akamatsu Cause of death: Stab wound to the chest Suspects: Taro Mutsu The man is Takeshi Akamatsu, a rough who will do anything for money. The police initially think that Akamatsu climbed through the wall to sneak attack Reiko following someone's request, but was discovered by the Mouris and the secretary, so he ran away. Unfortunately, he went into Taro’s room and was killed as an act of self-defense. Nonetheless, he is still taken away for further investigation. Conan suddenly smiles and admits Reiko’s bravery when she was worrying about Taro's well-being. Later, at Taro's room, Kogoro finds pictures in the trash bin, convincing himself that the case has a different culprit upon finding Akamatsu's fingerprints in the pictures.

title.ja: ポジティブ男の災難

summary.en: An aspiring novelist named Shokichi Hazama is talking to Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys while he is carrying the items bought from the shop. At the residence Hazama is living in, he sees the conversation between the apartment landlady Teruyo Imaizumi and one of his neighbors Nenji Kodakara. It turns out that Kodokara’s apartment has been stolen but Imaizumi does not let him call the police because it would affect the reputation of the apartment. They decide to call them, nonetheless. Location: Kodakara's apartment, Beika Town Victim: Nenji Kodakara The police unit responsible for robbery arrive and suspect Hazama for stealing Kodakara’s property. Shokichi willingly let the police collect the fingerprint to prove his innocence. Ironically, the fingerprint matches with the one that was collected from a nylon string near the scene of a murder that happened one week ago; this is why when Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys return on the next day to see if the robber is caught or not, they see Takagi and Megure instead. In addition, Takagi mentions some possibilities that drove the police into believe Hazama is the murderer, with Shokichi trying to prove his innocence: About the nylon string, he states that the nylon string might be his, but it was when he opened the food package he received from his grandma 10 days ago. Shokichi might have been one of Tarao's victims ever since the latter graduated. However, the two have never met each other once. There was camera footage at Dorubako Tengoku that recorded Shokichi's presence, but the person could be his twin brother helping him to cover the crime. Shokichi says this was outrageous because the two haven't met for a few years. He is taken to the police for interrogation, which upsets Imaizumi and the boys since for them, he is too friendly to be the murderer. Location: Tarao's apartment, Kuroganedai Victim: Yasushi Tarao Cause of death: Strangulation Suspects: Shokichi Hazama and Nenji Kodakara The nylon string found near the scene that could be the weapon had a fingerprint but couldn’t be identified, until yesterday’s report from Beika’s headquarter showed that it coincides with the fingerprint they collected from Hazama. Conan and the Detective Boys suspect these unfavourable coincidences are man-made, and begin to investigate Kodakara first, but find nothing when the four hear the call from him made by the police to inform him that the thief was caught. Conan then goes to the MPD alone to ask Takagi; and finds that no one in the Beika street was Tarao’s victim, and that there is no one with the intention to frame Shokichi at all. This implies that Shokichi’s ordeals were just accidents.

title.ja: 大岡紅葉の甘い罠（前編）
title.zhHans: 大冈红叶的甜蜜圈套（前篇）
title.zhHant: 大岡紅葉的甜蜜圈套（上集）

summary.en: A play about Kogoro and Heiji is set to be produced in Kyoto, and the production staff have invited the detectives to Kabumoto’s house for script advice – with Conan simply tagging along. There is one alteration that catches Heiji’s attention – his counterpart is engaged, and Momiji comes in to confirm the fiancée is based on her. The change is confirmed by the director Kyosuke Kabumoto as the condition for her grandfather to invest in the play. He then introduces the second special guest – who surprisingly turns out to be Kuroda. Kuroda explains he just happened to have business in Kyoto, and decided to stop by at the Ooka home to offer congratulations to a retiring acquaintance, where Momiji then invited him to the event. Meanwhile, Ran and Kazuha have been trying to eat as fast as possible in a Kyoto dessert tour they must finish, which was part of Momiji’s plan to get close to Heiji.

title.ja: 大岡紅葉の甘い罠（後編）
title.zhHans: 大冈红叶的甜蜜圈套（后篇）
title.zhHant: 大岡紅葉的甜蜜圈套（下集）

summary.en: With the case being concluded as a murder in mind, Ayanokoji raises several questions: Was Kabumoto napping part of the culprit’s plan? If so, could they count on the medication he took? Moreover, what if he completely forgot to take the medicine or its effect did not take on at the right moment? In other words, Kabumoto was given another sleeping medication without knowing so. There are some consumables that were consumed throughout the day: Pizza or cups of coffee – Kabumoto did not consume pizza during the party, and everyone chose one cup randomly from a tray, so the case of him consuming the sleeping pills was not guaranteed, even if he joined in the pizza party. Lollipops – we have only seen him consuming these so far. However, both Karuo, Inaba, and Kimata confirm he only does so with one specific type of lollipop, and he would have noticed the sleeping pills if they were coated in one. This is because the three were scolded once when they switched one lollipop of his with another type as a prank.

title.ja: 行列店、味変の秘密
title.zhHans: 排队名店，味道改变的秘密
title.zhHant: 大排長龍的店，味道變化的秘密
title.en: The Secret of the Popular Restaurant's Changing Flavor
title.enRaw: The Secret of the Popular Restaurant's Changing Flavor

summary.en: The Detective Boys inform that there have been rumours about flavour change in Ramen restaurant “Ogataken”, so they, Conan and Haibara come to the restaurant to verify this. Ogataken has been opened for 32 years by Masashi Ogata and now it is run by him and Kosaku Ogata, his son. In addition, this restaurant also has signatures from famous people who came here to eat and commented that it was delicious. The Detective Boys give a taste of the Ramen and comment that the flavour is different while Conan notices that the shop owner never turns his face around, with the Detective Boys confirming that the owner and his son alway quarrel at each other, leading to the suspicion that the son did something to him and replace with another. Later, the suspicion is confirmed to be true as the one who looks like the shop owner is Kenji Ogata, Kosaku’s uncle, and Masashi has been missing for 4 days. Even though Masashi leaves the restaurant quite often, this is the first time he has left without a clear reason while leaving only a note with the handwriting was indeed his but rather shaky. Later, the boys figure out that something must have happened with the owner, so they first ask Kosaku if someone had a grudge with his father but he couldn’t give an answer. They change the question to: Ever since Masashi has gone missing, has anyone been acting strangely when his brother temporarily replaced him, to which Kosaku recalls the Ramen Shop “Ichiban” Owner named Eiichi Banba, who also has been spreading ills about his shop. Banba later comes for Ramen as usual, but this time is a bit different as the shop suddenly closes and the lights are out, then a bunch of rat sounds and a bloody Masashi lookalike appears to ask what has happened to the real one. He then admits to having seen Masashi being taken away by a group of people, with one of them being Tatsuya Kurosaki, Banba simply slipped and fell while being scared and tried to run away. Kenji mentions that Kurosaki was Masashi’s former student but was fired by the latter and had never come once again, probably he was misguided after that and now wants to get revenge on his former teacher, but is this true? Location: Ramen restaurant "Ogataken", Beika Town Victim: Masashi Ogata Suspects: Tatsuya Kurosaki and his henchmen Everyone notices that they are being eavesdropped while they are discussing, so they open the door to check it out and see two people trying to run away in a car that looks identical to the one used to kidnap Masashi, according to Banba, so the pursuit of the kidnappers to save Masashi begins. While on the way, Kosaku regrets that it might have been because of him that his father will die, as his retirement from the musical has caused Kurosaki to be fired, to which Conan replies that if they have caught him away, he might be still alive whatsoever. When they arrive at where the car stops, Conan begins looking around the house while the two are walking to Kurosaki’s room and before he reveals the truth about Masashi’s disappearance.

title.ja: 動く交番

summary.en: Today is the opening day of the Moving Police box project. The Detective Boys, Haibara, Conan, and Kogoro are all there to celebrate in different ways, the Detective Boys as guests of honor, and Kogoro mainly because of the MC, Kanon Aoshima. Meanwhile, Conan and Kogoro have to pick up Ran, so Conan asks Haibara to help look after the Detective Boys. Location: Vintage and Luxury Watches Timeless Time, Beika Town 5th block Stolen items: 200 million yen worth of luxury watches Culprits: Hiroki Ishida and Tetsuya Kuroki However, while the Moving Police Box is moving, a watch robber stops them and hijacks it immediately in front of Haibara and the Detective Boys. Although the robber tries to throw away everyone's means of communication to prevent them from calling for help, Haibara still keeps her Detective Boys badge so she can signal for help to Conan. Location: Mobile Police Box, Beika Town 5th block Victims: Kanon Aoshima, Ai Haibara, Ayumi Yoshida, Genta Kojima, Mitsuhiko Tsuburaya and two police officers Age: 21 years old (Kanon) and 6-7 years old (Ai, Ayumi, Genta and Mitsuhiko) Culprits: Hiroki Ishida and Tetsuya Kuroki However, Ayumi's panic when she sees the badge accidentally fall while waiting for Conan to rescue them causes them to change the way they treat the hostage. Later, by following the oranges that Haibara left behind, Conan is able to find their whereabouts. Location: Mobile Police Box, Beika Town Victim: Kanon Aoshima Injury: Gunshot wound to the right arm Culprit: Hiroki Ishida The two injured are then taken by the ambulance, and the police come to the place where the hostages were left to investigate the two robbers. Conan also points out that the robbers seem to have disguised the mobile police station so that they could easily pass through the checkpoints. Later, an investigation into the home of one of the robbers, Hiroki Ishida, revealed that there were also accomplices, "Rindo" and Kensuke Honma. However, while questioning Honma, who admits to have not joined the said robbery, Takagi receives a call informing him that the bodies of the two watch robbers have been found in another car, meaning that someone has taken the watches? Victims: Hiroki Ishida and Tetsuya Kuroki Age: 33 years old (Ishida) Cause of death: Explosion

title.ja: 意地悪な弟に困る姉
title.zhHans: 坏心眼的弟弟与头疼的姐姐
title.zhHant: 被壞心眼的弟弟困擾的姐姐
title.en: The Sister Troubled By Her Naughty Brother
title.enRaw: The Sister Troubled By Her Naughty Brother

summary.en: Kogoro Mouri had previously received a request from a woman named Satsuki Makabe about an ill speaking note, so he is now observing the man who could have done it. After he gets out of the elevator, Kogoro enters the elevator and sees a similar one, so he assumes that man was the culprit, but Kogoro has to take him back to the Detective Agency when he doesn’t admit his wrongdoing. There, Satsuki reveals that he is her younger brother named Yuto Makabe. Yuto blames his sister for not lending him money when he was in financial trouble, which angers Satsuki and she slaps him. Kogoro initially plans to take him to the police station, but Satsuki decides to make Yuto sign a contract not to bother her again, although after he leaves, she tears up the contract, thinking that it might continue. A few days later, the police receive a case where a notorious and debauched man who lived off his family's vast fortune named Ryoichi Doba is found dead in his apartment. Soon after, Megure finishes a call from an anonymous person saying that a woman had talked to the victim about her grudge against him, Takagi and Chiba inform Megure that they have found 10 people who have grudges against the victim, with one of them being Satsuki Makabe. Location: Doba's apartment, Rinkai Town, Tokyo Victim: Ryoichi Doba Cause of death: Stab wound to the back Suspects: Satsuki Makabe and Yuto Makabe The next day, while interrogating Satsuki, Megure mentions the accident caused by Doba led to the death of Satsuki's fiancé Kensuke Tateishi as the reason why she is one of the suspects. She claims that she was in Ochibadai at the time of the murder and Yuto can confirm this because they met at Ochibadai Station, however, her younger brother confirms that he never went to Ochibadai and that he was home that day. So she turns to Kogoro again, this time it seems to the two, and Conan (and some of us) that Yuto is lying and they need to find a way to get him to tell the truth. Victim: Kensuke Tateishi Cause of death: Car accident Culprit: Ryoichi Doba However, the investigation goes nowhere because just considering Yuto and Satsuki, there are so many possible situations revolving around alibis, contradictions and the possible culprit that even Conan has difficulty in deducing. Suddenly an idea flashes, the boy asks Yuto for the phone number of the people who had asked him for debt to confirm something. Then the boy calls everyone and starts his deduction performance through the Sleeping Kogoro.

title.ja: 女子会ミステリー 3

summary.en: Prior to the current scene, Sonoko sends messages proposing an emergency meeting with other girls including Ayumi, Haibara, Sato, and Ran as she was informed about a ninja-themed event that might smell like an upcoming crime by her acquaintance. Before the five can get there, they must first dress in like a kunoichi and take the walkie talkie. The five are currently tracking a woman wearing a similar costume to them but Sato suddenly changes the target to a man wearing it for some reason. The pursuit continues on that man until they realize that many people are actually wearing the costume for the said event, making the stakeout meaningless, so Sonoko suggests having tea somewhere. There, they group is discussing about the event, with some notable details here: This event attracts a lot of people to engage just for the big gift, however, some of its missions do have legal problems. The page dedicated to show other ninja current positions shows the strange trend of why they are focusing on the East of Beika city while the staff are doing something in the West. Coincidentally, the precious Kingscote crown made by a famous goldsmith is being displayed at Kaneko Jewelry store (you again?) under the protection of the reinforced frame, anti-theft glasses, two guard robots and drones, and four security cameras. So Sonoko suggests going to that store, only to see the owner Keita Kaneko bound and gagged when they arrive. In addition, the crown is taken away by someone like usual, well at least it wasn't due to the flaw of the new security systems bought by Kaneko himself. Location: Kaneko Jewelry Store, Beika Town Victim: Keita Kaneko Stolen items: Kingscote Crown The robber also bind and gag Kaneko. He fells unconscious after being found by the five. While they leave the case for the police to solve, they’d still spread smoke by posting fake news to create invisible blockades for the robber(s). Later, Haibara receives a direct message from the culprit asking the reason why she knows so much about those proclaimed blockades, to which she explains it was from police communication channels and suggests going by train from Beika station. Next, Sato will calls for Takagi and the others for the ambush while the group will keep track of the unknown thief(s).

title.ja: お留守番毛利一家

summary.en: Takahiko Kamiyu, a literary critic, entrusted Kogoro with the responsibility of looking after the house and taking care of his anxious cat for three days while he visited the countryside. Even though he previously thought the request did not benefit formal detective work, Kogoro still accepted it due to the high payment. On the first day of the sitting: Genseki Ishiba comes to the residence to find Kamiyu. He wants to settle the critics' fight that was interrupted a few days ago. One hour later, a magazine editor Sachiyo Kafuka comes to apologize to Kamiyu for complaining about the literary review he gave yesterday. Kamiyu praised So Fujieda’s work in yesterday's review, which is the opposite of what he usually does and what the readers expect. At the end of the day, Conan is certain that the cat, named Tama, is not an anxious one. On the second day of the house-sitting, a Haido police officer comes to the house, as he had received an anonymous tip that states: “Kamiya buried something in the yard of his Haido home two days ago”. The four people go to the yard and see traces of digging, so they ask the worker hired by Kamiya to build the library, who just happens to arrive, to dig the suspected area. The five discover a body with a knife stuck on the left chest. The police arrive at the residence, and Kogoro calls Kamiya to return from his visit. Location: Kamiyu Residence, Haido Town Cause of death: Stab wound to the chest Suspects: Takahiko Kamiyu Based on some events that the Mouri family encountered the day before, they consider the possibility that Kamiya was being accused by Ishiba, who used the excuse of resolving a dispute among critics as an excuse to check if his plot was discovered or not. Meanwhile, after taking Kamiya's statement, the police questioned whether he had been falsely accused. At that moment, he thought of Ishiba as the person who could have done it. With the investigation focused on hatred toward Kamiya, the Mouri family arrive at Ishiba's apartment to ask a few questions, but it seems he is hiding something, so Takagi and Chiba decide to take him to the station for questioning when the duo just arrive and hear the conversation. The Mouri family then decides to ask Kafuka about her intention to apologize the day before, and just as they are about to hear the relationship between the victim and the literary critic, the police also arrive to listen after verifying Ishiba's alibi evidence. With the investigation of the two suspects yielding no results, both the police and the Mouri family consider another line of inquiry: who benefited from the novelist's death? Based on independent investigations by both sides, they all believed that Kumi had killed her husband and fabricated evidence to frame Kamiya. But is that hypothesis really correct?

title.ja: 乱歩邸殺人事件（前編）
title.zhHant: 亂步宅邸殺人事件（上集）

summary.en: The Detective Boys, including Conan and Haibara, accompanied by their teacher Miss Kobayashi, visit the Rampo residence managed by Professor Goto. The storehouse which Rampo used as a library entailed a great deal of valuable books, stimulating the excitement of Conan and the rest. In the meantime, Detective Sato and Detective Takagi arrive, whereupon they are informed that a murder case has taken place in a nearby park. And - what is more - the victim's belongings seem to be related to the storehouse that was often closed to the public... Camera footage from a convenience store near the scene of the murder caught the appearance of Goto, who went there following a call offering to show him Ranpo's unpublished manuscript, so he became a suspect of the murder. Suddenly, Genta’s stomach growls, so Professor Goto’s assistant Ryosuke Okumoto suggests they have lunch at the cafeteria as it is almost time to close the storehouse. At the cafeteria, we can see Okumoto is having a conversation with the other members of the Ranpo Association, with Kobayashi’s group soon joining as they are curious about the Association, but the conversation goes awkward when Oguruma mentions about what happened to Katsumine. Later, one by one, Okumoto's group begins to split up to do their own thing, with Rikkyo University guide Mizumori offering to take Kobayashi's group on a tour that afternoon.

title.ja: 乱歩邸殺人事件（後編）
title.zhHant: 亂步宅邸殺人事件（下集）

summary.en: Takagi and Sato begin questioning the suspects, all of which wandered around the area separately so they did not have clear alibis. Meanwhile, Kobayashi’s group decides to have a rest at a room that is under maintenance since it is quite late now and they came here by walking. There, Conan has to share to everyone else about his unusual feelings toward the suspects as they appeared awkward when the name Katsumine was mentioned, he also suggests that the murder could continue and it’s up to them to stop it at all cost. So Kobayashi decides to inform the police about the person named Katsumine. Fortunately, the police are ahead of the curve this time as they have gathered information about the person named Katsumine since the beginning of the investigation into this case. And it is known that he died due to drowning 2 years ago, but then there were many anonymous letters sent to the local police claiming that Katsumine had been murdered and asking for the incident to be reinvestigated. In addition, on the day of his death, he had been drinking with the two recent strangulation victims, but they had an alibi for the time of Katsumine's death. At the same time, Takagi enters and offers to take them home before tomorrow’s interrogation, but Conan asks Takagi about the blood on Okumoto's right finger, to which he replies that it was the victim's own and questions why the boy asked. It seems that he will be caught up in a new task to catch the culprit led by Conan tonight.

title.ja: ホテル連続爆破事件（前編）
title.zhHans: 酒店连续爆炸事件（前篇）
title.zhHant: 酒店連續爆炸事件（上集）

summary.en: Conan is delighted with his newly bought three detective novels from Haido bookstore, where Masumi recommended him to go for a good price, when he meets Masumi again. As she just finished repairing her motorbike and couldn’t open the bottle without filthying it, Conan has to do it for her. However, he does not know that the bottle was carbonated, and he ends up getting splashed over by the liquid inside. Luckily, since Masumi is currently living near the area, she can offer him a place to change his clothes, but he refuses as there have been two hotel bombing cases reported. Masumi then offers him to see the bombing code left at the bombing scene, sparking his interest. Fortunately, no death is reported. There were strange codes sent to the scene of the bombings. It turns out that the bottle Masumi asked him to open was an arrangement between her and her mother so that they can try to steal the antidote when he is taking a bath. However, he brought no antidotes today, so better luck next time!

title.ja: ホテル連続爆破事件（後編）
title.zhHans: 酒店连续爆炸事件（后篇）
title.zhHant: 酒店連續爆炸事件（下集）

summary.en: The first person to be questioned is the cleaner, she confirms that she had cleaned Danji Rinzaki's room but did not find any code at that time, not to mention she also expresses her discomfort at having to clean the room because he always violated the smoking policy and was kicked out of several hotels that coincidentally had bombings, luckily this hotel owner is a fan of his so he is allowed to stay. In addition, she was also asked to bring humidifiers to both rooms because she heard that someone was coughing, this accidentally alerted Sera because Mary often coughed for some reason. The second person to be questioned is Kureishi, who says that he had left immediately after delivering Rinzaki's luggage and had not entered his room. Finally, Rinzaki, although somewhat uncomfortable, accepts the questioning. He says that he had seen the code on the table near the humidifier after checking in and wondered if it belonged to the bomber. Kisaki lies that it was not and asks to search the room, he initially refuses but after hearing that he will be responsible if the bomb explodes, he complies.

title.ja: 汽笛の聞こえる古書店 4
title.zhHant: 能聽見汽笛聲的舊書店 4

summary.en: Detective Boys and Ami Komachi. Conan and the Detective Boys are having a leisure time at Yujiro Tamaki's bookstore café when a woman named Ami Komachi enters the bookstore. As part of a recent purchase of used books by the bookstore, a novel called "The Lonely Sea," one of Ami Komachi's father's keepsakes, was accidentally sold to the bookstore. Ami asks if she could buy the book back, but unfortunately, the book was already sold to another customer. Shortly after, that customer, a regular customer named Kenichi Kirishima, enters the bookstore. When the Detective Boys ask whether he has a book called "The Lonely Sea," Kenichi says he remembers buying it from the bargain items rack in the bookstore and that he had already sold it to another customer. He quickly pulls up an online listing showing the sold-out item on his phone. After Ami, who gives up on finding the novel, and Kenichi leave the bookstore, Haibara tells the Detective Boys that she noticed that the novel's listing was 200,000 yen, even though the books from the bargain items rack should not be more than 500 yen. Yujiro Tamaki confirms the low value of the book by saying that the novel was only recently published and is not that rare. A few hours pass, and the Detective Boys decide to go home, but Yujiro says he will join them on the way home to drop off Kenichi's lost key. When Yujiro opens the apartment door, he and the Detective Boys find Kenichi lying dead. Location: Kirishima's apartment, Beika Town Victim: Kenichi Kirishima Time: Between 16:30 and 17:30 Cause of death: Cerebral contusion Suspects: Ami Komachi The police arrive, and Conan points out that the blood marks on the table are in an L-shape, indicating that an object of that shape was placed there before the murder and taken away afterward. The police also find a safe in Kenichi's apartment. The key that Yujiro was going to drop off was the key to the safe, and after unlocking the safe, lots of jewelry was found. Takagi mentions that the jewelry is similar to that which was recently robbed from a jewelry store. It is confirmed that Kenichi was a part of that robbery. Location: Unknown Jewelry Store Culprit: Kenichi Kirishima Conan deduces that the price of "The Lonely Sea" novel was so high because Kenichi was involved in black market deals, specifically in the exchange of robbed goods. The book is used as a camouflage for the exchange. Meanwhile, the police use the apartment's security camera footage to narrow down the suspects who murdered Kenichi to two people: Ami Komachi and a delivery man. Conan wonders why the murderer had to take a book from Kenichi's apartment and then finds a notebook with a ripped page and some blood. After shining his Wristwatch Flashlight onto the page underneath at an angle, a page filled with numbers is revealed. Conan notes that each row of numbers has three numbers. The left column of numbers keeps going up with each consecutive row, and the other two columns have seemingly random fluctuations in numbers. Conan realizes what the numbers mean but tells Yujiro to explain the cipher. Yujiro says that it is a book cipher, where each row of numbers contains the page number, line number, and character number. However, the numbers cannot be deciphered without the book. Using the set of receipts that Kenichi stored away, the Detective Boys narrowed the list of books down to those on the receipts but not in Kenichi's apartment. This leaves 20, and Yujiro narrows it further by using each book's average page length. With three books left and the bookstore having a copy for each of them, the Detective Boys, Yujiro, and the police head to the bookstore to decode the cipher.

title.ja: 張り込み 4

summary.en: On Beika Amusement Park's final day before indefinite closure, the Detective Boys visit it for one last time. One hour before the closure, the Detective Boys get on the Ferris Wheel and spot Takagi and Chiba in the park's security control room. After entering the room, they find Takagi and Chiba dressed as security guards and conducting a stakeout. Without any other choice, Takagi explains the case behind the reason for the stakeout. Six years ago, two thieves conducted a robbery on a nearby jewelry store. Location: Jewelry store Stolen items: 500 million yen worth of jewels Culprits: Ippei Kanieda and his accomplice The main culprit of the robbery was identified as a man named Ippei Kanieda, but he died in a traffic accident the next day. Victim: Ippei Kanieda Cause of death: Traffic accident Strangely, no jewels were found in Ippei's home. The amusement park was where Ippei was working part-time as a student and is near the site of the traffic accident where he died. So, the jewels are thought to be hidden somewhere in the amusement park. The police also identified Ippei's accomplice as "Ebishima" (an alias), whom Ippei met over a criminal website. "Ebishima" was likely waiting for the statute of limitations to expire before they would come retrieve the jewels. However, since the park had announced its closure, they would have to collect the jewels before the amusement park was demolished. Up until the final day before closure, the police have found no movement in the stolen goods market, so it is almost certain that "Ebishima" would have to show up on this final day. Conan deduces that the jewels would have to be hidden in concealed places, which eliminates all places in the park except for the employee-only areas. Not long afterward, a retired, now volunteer security guard named Hisao Yamagata enters one of the areas. Because he is a security guard, he is not suspected by Takagi, who is monitoring from the security room. However, in a panoramic video that Haibara takes of the employee-only area, Conan notices a suspicious-looking vent where the vent itself is rusted, but the bolts holding the vent are not. At the same time, a woman named Kanako Sakuramachi lost her 5-year-old daughter, Hiroko, and a mysterious Baker Eats delivery man named Daiki Nagasaki appears. A single shoe of Kanako's daughter is found in front of one of the employee-only areas. Meanwhile, since Daiki was instructed to deliver some hamburgers to the employee-only area next to the spinning cups, he enters the second employee-only area. Kanako, wanting to find her child as soon as possible, enters a third employee-only area, and so, three different people have entered each of the employee-only areas, making all of them suspects. To add to the chaos, "Ebishima" suddenly calls the security room to announce that they have planted bombs in the amusement park. Right after, multiple smoke bombs were detonated, though they did not cause any casualties. Location: Beika Amusement Park Time: Around 10-15 minutes before park closure The bombs were only smoke bombs, and thankfully, there were no casualties. After the string of smoke bomb explosions, Daiki is suddenly instructed to deliver the hamburgers to Beika Station instead, and the second shoe of the lost girl is found near the Ferris wheel, next to a drinking fountain. At the drinking fountain, Mitsuhiko finds that the back panel of the fountain was removed, while Conan discovers some small prints in the flowerbed behind the fountain. Also, Genta finds Hisao collapsed in one of the employee-only areas. Hisao is seen trying to open the suspicious-looking vent that Conan spotted earlier. But Conan has already solved the case.

title.ja: 探偵団と二人の引率者（前編）
title.zhHans: 侦探团与两名带领者（前篇）
title.zhHant: 偵探團與兩名帶領者（上集）
title.en: The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders (Part 1)
title.enRaw: *The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders* (Part 1)

summary.en: When everyone is cleaning the classroom, Conan is watching a news about yesterday incident and the Detective Boys are watching news of Kamen Yaiba-themed beach events before suggesting Conan and Haibara to come along as well. While Agasa can’t join due to his back injury, Rumi volunteers to chaperone them but not with Kobayashi as she is going to have a date with Shiratori. Later, Conan decides to call Subaru to come along and keep an eye on Rumi. There, everyone is enjoying their drinks and the long-awaited curled sausages but Genta suddenly drops his onto the carpet nearby, creating a stain that cannot be wiped off easily. Rumi then asks a beach hut employee named Sakura Menda for another sausage, in which she agrees and tells Maika Kayaki to do it, but Kayaki’s swimsuit suddenly loosens, so another employee named Takaki Kooriyama has to help her tighten it. Then Menda asks him to open the jam jar but he couldn’t do it, and while reminding of the time when she broke up with him for Kayaki’s brother, the owner of the hut named Katsunori Usui steps in and explains why they have to work here. Before he leaves for lunch break, he asks them to buy extra pineapple juices.

title.ja: 探偵団と二人の引率者（後編）
title.zhHans: 侦探团与两名带领者（后篇）
title.zhHant: 偵探團與兩名帶領者（下集）
title.en: The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders (Part 2)
title.enRaw: *The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders* (Part 2)

summary.en: Sango concludes that since no one can verify their alibis, any of the suspects could be the murder, with Menda countering that if either her or Kayaki is the one to strangle Usui, this would have woken up Kooriyama. Conan then asks Menda about the medicine her grandma is currently using, she answers high blood pressure medication named Nifedipine, then he asks about Kooriyama juice he drank before falling asleep, in which he replies grapefruit juice. Then Conan and Haibara state that the reason he fell asleep was because he consumed the juice along with Nifedipine put in the straw of each grapefruit juice by someone, but normal customers were fine because the juice was put in an iced plastic cup which gave them the bigger straw. Kooriyama also mentions that Usui felt a strange taste from the juice he consumed as well and accuses Menda for murdering Usui, with her countering that she had lost her medicine, implying that the murderer is either him or Kayaki. Meanwhile, Rumi expresses her surprise toward Haibara’s knowledge about medicine, with Conan mentioning that Professor Agasa taught her that. Tsukumo reports to Sango that the towel used to wrap around the victim was the one used in the hut seats where the Detective Boys confirm to have sat in, but suddenly, Genta’s swimsuit rips at one of the shoulders, making Ayumi associate this with ancient Roman. And speaking of ancient Roman, Conan recalls something he had watched before.

title.ja: 怪盗キッドと王冠マジック（前編）
title.zhHans: 怪盗基德与王冠魔术（前篇）
title.zhHant: 怪盜基德與王冠魔術（上集）
title.en: Kaitou Kid and the Crown Trick (Part 1)

summary.en: The crowd is waiting for Kid's appearance as he is assumed to appear at the tonight’s exhibition of Siren’s Splash, the crown that pirates had been searching the seas for because of its power that was said to protect sailors from disasters according to some sources, at the Suzuki building in Kinza, where Sonoko, Ran, and Conan were invited in to see the said crown in person. There they meet Azusa having delivered sandwiches to the Riot Policemen with Amuro, who had left earlier without her, and Conan asks Azusa about the red stain on her shirt when he notices it, to which she says it must have been the ketchup they brought along with. Azusa then also wants everyone to tell them how Kid is able to escape the hallway, which refers to Jirokichi Suzuki's newest security system. Advanced Notice:At 21:00 tonight, I'll break the curse of the sea witch, erase all it's splashes, and let you witness that.
summary.zhHans: 怪盗基德相关作品以预告、变装、宝石目标和柯南的追踪对决为核心，属于独立角色专题线。

title.ja: 怪盗キッドと王冠マジック（後編）
title.zhHans: 怪盗基德与王冠魔术（后篇）
title.zhHant: 怪盜基德與王冠魔術（下集）
title.en: Kaitou Kid and the Crown Trick (Part 2)

summary.en: Conan instantly realizes that the incident makes the appraisal session later than usual is actually a set up made by Kid, and Kid is now disguised as one of the three person, but who could he disguise as? After Karino's suspicion is resolved, Andou discloses about Karino’s wider leg size (to which the other two denies) and Chuujou’s hat being different as it has been turned upside down to hide the ketchup. Conan then figures out the missing crown mystery, but he couldn’t figure out how Kid is gonna escape with the crown.
summary.zhHans: 怪盗基德相关作品以预告、变装、宝石目标和柯南的追踪对决为核心，属于独立角色专题线。

title.ja: ラストダンス

summary.en: Sonoko invites Ran to a party held by real estate company manager Kensaku Takada, and Conan inevitably has to follow them since Kogoro is off to drink with the neighborhood association. At the party, they get to meet Kensaku and his wife, Konomi. Kensaku, who heard from Sonoko that Ran is a karate champion, says that he also once practiced karate in college, and out of his passionate talking, starts striking poses. While not mentioned by anyone, Kensaku’s sleeves pull up slightly during this talk, revealing an expensive-looking watch. Upon seeing Rika, Kensaku’s maid, walk past him, he calls her over to bring some drinks. Unfortunately, Rika bumps into one of the guests and accidentally spills the drinks onto Kensaku, which makes him furious and he nearly strikes her before Konomi intervenes. Konomi suggests him to go change his clothes, and Kensaku leaves the room, before Konomi also leaves to head to the powder room. Conan then spots a worried-looking man holding his phone intently before the man also exits the room. After some time, Konomi returns, but Kensaku is still missing. Rika, now with a red mark on her cheek, tells Konomi that Kensaku went out to smoke. Konomi then instructs Rika to go get Kensaku. Meanwhile, Sonoko notices that Konomi had changed her shoes, and also invites Ran to change into a different pair of shoes. When questioned by Conan, Sonoko reveals the party to be a dance party, where participants wear special dancing shoes. She reminds Ran that wearing accessories are not allowed. But not long before the dancing is about to begin, a scream from Rika interrupts the excitement—she has found Kensaku, who had fallen to his death. Location: Next to Kensaku's mansion Victim: Kensaku Takada Cause of death: Blunt head trauma from falling Suspects: Konomi Takada, Rika Yamazato & Satoru Yoshioka Kensaku was drinking before the accident, but would this really mean he was in a drunken state and accidentally fell off the elevated property? The police arrive, with Takagi noting that Kensaku had been drinking before his death, suggesting that his drunken state led him to accidentally fall over the mansion’s fencing and, due to the property’s elevation, injure his head on the pavement below. However, Conan denies this as an accident, having noticed many footprints in the yard above, indicating a fight between Kensaku and a possible killer. The police, Ran, and Sonoko head back up to the mansion’s yard to see the footprints, but Conan stays back, and finds that Kensaku’s watch is missing. Apparently, the forensics officer had found the watch in Kensaku’s jacket pocket, not on his wrist. Back at the mansion, the police take a look at the footprints. Considering their wide extent across the yard, they assume Kensaku had an intense fight with whoever killed him. There are also four sets of footprints, which are from Kensaku, Rika, Conan and the murderer. Strangely, some footprints are whole while others are halved, as if the halved footprints were created from a person standing on their tiptoes. Conan helps the police narrow down the suspects to those who left the party venue before Kensaku’s death. They are Konomi, Rika, and the worried-looking man from before, who is introduced as Satoru. Of the three, Satoru is the only one with a motive, being financially indebted to Kensaku. The police later find a pair of dancing shoes in the yard that match with the fourth set of footprints. It bears a small mud print. Satoru confesses that the shoes belong to him, and the police decide that he is the culprit. Conan, though, notices something between Satoru’s dancing shoes and the shoes Satoru was currently wearing. Conan decides to investigate some more, and heads into the mansion’s kitchen, where he sees Rika searching for something on the floor. That “something” is her earring, which for some reason had been dropped. Heading back out to the yard, Conan finds that forensics had finished recording the footprints. Conan then has Takagi and Chiba reenact the murder by stepping onto the footprints. But when Takagi is forced to stand on his tiptoes, he loses balance. The experiment is seemingly useless, and Satoru is being taken away by the police for questioning. Conan, holding the forensic officer’s record of the footprints, passes by Ran. Ran notices that the footprints look similar to a step diagram, which Sonoko used when teaching Ran how to dance. It is not long before Sonoko is seen kneeling on the ground…and “Sonoko’s” deduction show begins.

title.ja: 屋久島の山姫（前編）

summary.en: A tour group is walking in the wooden stair covering around the ancient Jomon Cedar tree when they see a body lying down there, freaking them out. The victim is the representative of the Yakushima forestry department, a non-profit organization managing the island, named Yoshimi Hidaka. Two weeks later, the Mouri’s family is called by her father Taisei Hidaka to find the murder as the local police investigation has fallen to dead end whereas they couldn’t find the murder out of 4 suspects: Ryoya Kitabeppu, who had quarreled with the victim frequently, happened to lead the tour group that found the victim; Taro Tsukada, whom the victim cancelled the engagement upon knowing that he cheated on her; Kasumi Kokusho, Yoshimi’s best friend; and Yuji Yamamoto, who had been caught stalking on the victim. Kitabeppu confirms that he led the group that found her corpse, as they had stayed at the mountain lodge before fulfilling their wish to see the ancient Jomon Cedar tree the next morning. He also confirms to know her and her intention of cutting the number of tourists by half, but stating that is not enough to be the motive for him to kill her. Conan asks him who he suspects to be the culprit the most, but we couldn’t know his answer for now.

title.ja: 屋久島の山姫（後編）

summary.en: Because the mosses and leaves below absorbed most of the impact from the 10 meters fall, Kokusho is actually fine with only some minor bruises. Conan raises doubts that the culprit must have used the Yahamine legend to distract the investigation, and if this case and the previous murder have something to do then the culprit will not stop there. However, he also notices Yamamoto is watching them, Yamamoto states that Tsukada must have been the murder as he heard from Tsukada that he will receive lots of money. Following what has happened recently, Kogoro believes that statement as well, but Conan and Ran suggest that they should talk directly to him before concluding that he is the culprit. However, no one is in Tsukada's house when they arrive along with Taisei, so Kogoro calls the police to help look out the harbor and the airports. Later, The two begin to go to the harbor as soon as Taisei recalls that Tsukada could own a boat while Ran and Conan want to investigate the house a bit for some reason. There, Conan and Ran notice the fresh sawdusts, and a secret passage leading to a railroad, so before they follow the railroad, Conan asks Ran to call Kogoro as there will be no phone service when they go along the way.

title.ja: 追跡！探偵タクシー 2

summary.en: Every ten years, a so-called "Jewelry Washing Festival" is held at Tsubaki Shrine. Jewels that are washed by the water in the shrine's well will supposedly shine brighter and their value will increase. With such great outcomes, only wealthy people, jewelry store owners, and luxury car owners come to the festival as participants. One participant, named Yoko Matsuda, comes to the shrine for this festival, and her driver is none other than "Detective Taxi" Genki Ishikawa. As Ishikawa looks at the various luxury cars of other participants, he notices a suspicious-looking duo taking pictures of those cars, and decides that a case is abound. Location: Tsubaki Shrine parking lot Suspects: Suspicious-looking duo Ishikawa noticed this duo are secretly taking pictures of the "Jewelry Washing Festival" participant's cars for unknown purpose. After dropping off Matsuda at the festival, Ishikawa heads straight to Mouri's Detective Agency to inform him of the situation. He invites Kogoro to investigate with him, but Kogoro turns down Ishikawa's request, citing that Ran's request of making sandwiches for Conan is more important. Ishikawa decides to investigate the situation by himself, but before he leaves, Kogoro gives him half of a sandwich that Kogoro messed up. Ishikawa eats Kogoro's sandwich on the way back to the shrine. As soon as Ishikawa comes back to Tsubaki Shrine to investigate the suspicious duo, he hears a scream and rushes into the shrine grounds, leading him to find Matsuda having passed out on the ground. When Matsuda wakes up, however, she screams again, and Ishikawa is then knocked out by an unknown person from behind. Back at the detective agency, Kogoro and Conan are eating their sandwiches (with Conan noting that Kogoro has used too much ketchup) when they hear a TV news report of a robbery that had taken place at Tsubaki Shrine. This prompts Kogoro and Conan to rush to the shrine and investigate what happened. Upon entering the shrine though, they find the police leaving. After Kogoro asks the shrine maid of what had happened, the shrine maid confirms that it was only an attempted robbery. Location: Tsubaki Shrine's jewelry-washing well Victim: Yoko Matsuda Suspects: Suspicious-looking duo According to Yoko Matsuda. Her diamond was supposedly stolen from her, as she was the last person to came and wash the jewelry. But, in the end, they find out it was in a bucket around the well that was used for washing jewelry. She seems embarrassed when she left after she was question by the police. But no one has seen a taxi driver named Genki Ishikawa, even though his taxi is still parked by the shrine. Approaching the taxi, Conan hears a noise from the trunk, and Kogoro opens it to find Ishikawa tied up inside. Location: Tsubaki Shrine parking lot Victim: Genki Ishikawa After Ishikawa finds Matsuda passed out on the ground and comes over to wake her up, she screamed again. Ishikawa was then hit on the head by an unknown person, tied up, and put inside his taxi's trunk. His mouth has a red-colored mark that looks like blood.

title.ja: 石川よるまっしミステリー（前編）

summary.en: Kogoro Mouri is hired by an anonymous customer later revealed to be Yumeno Arihara, whom he escorted along with the other member from the stage to dressing room 3 years ago but forgot about it anyway, to investigate an anonymous letter she received a week ago stating that they knew what she had done at that faithful day 3 years ago. Of course, the situation he is asked to investigate is also under the eavesdropping of Conan since he did not reveal anything to Ran and Conan before splitting. But here’s the catch: Both Conan and Arihara have already sensed that someone was actually following them. Arihara recalls the time when she was playing for the band called Albarosa consisting of Kensuke Domon as their drummer and band leader; Jotaro Tanemura as their guitarist; Yoji Kinomoto as their bass; while she was their main vocalist, which was the time when their donated money intended for charity were gone by unknown person, causing massive criticism, and the band to break up. Kogoro at first gives the statement that the two would soon deny: The anonymous must have thought her to be the one to steal it. Then the suspicion rises toward the other three members, that is also when Kogoro finally realizes that they have met each other 3 years ago in the aforementioned event.

title.ja: 石川よるまっしミステリー（後編）

summary.en: Luckily, the two are able to survive thanks to Conan’s elasticity suspenders, however, they are soon confronted by a mysterious person that freaks Inami out. At the next morning, Kogoro, Arihara, Domon, Tanemura, and Ran are discussing why is the guitar box stolen 3 years ago now in Tanemura’s car when Ran reports to her father that Arihara had met with someone who appears to be the last member of Albarosa band but still expresses her worry toward Conan’s safety just as when she receives the call from Conan himself. He apologizes to her and Kogoro for not calling them earlier to tell that he were safe all the time, and tells everyone to stay there waiting for him and the others to arrive, with the footage of the thief 3 years ago sent to him.

title.ja: 探偵団と憧れの古民家
title.zhHans: 侦探团与令人憧憬的古民居
title.zhHant: 偵探團與嚮往的古民居
title.en: The Detective Boys and the Traditional Dream House
title.enRaw: The Detective Boys and the Traditional Dream House

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, the Detective Boys and the married couple Akari Haga and Akito Haga are fixing the traditional house when Akari notices the strange stains at the wall near her husband, so he decides to touch it with his trowel, breaking it easily for some reason. This catches the attention of the kids as the Detective Boys assume there must be a treasure inside the wall. However, to everyone’s horror, the content inside the wall is the corpse of a woman. While the police are investigating, Conan notices that the corpse was wearing pajamas before she died, so he and his friends begin asking the couple about the house but it yields no result since nothing much about the former owner is revealed. Location: Kominka in Beika City Victim: Unknown woman Time: Between eight years ago and some months ago Cause of death: Unknown The investigation on the current owners of the house yields no result, so the kids switch the target to the former owner(s). The police are one step ahead, as they are able to find the person and confirm he is the culprit. The boys begin asking others about the former owner, and it seems that the police are one step ahead when they are able to confirm he is the one who killed the woman. After that, the Detective Boys visit the family again and enjoy the cake Akari treats them before waving goodbye to her and Akito, who happens to go back after buying material. On their way home, they meet Conan and Haibara again, who have been suspecting something is off about the husband, and decide to go back to the traditional house as Conan says that he will reveal everything once they arrive.

title.ja: サヨナラの行方

summary.en: On a Sunday morning, without a clear start of why, Yusuke Sakon has been calling his girlfriend Aki Kano while running to her apartment. Her apartment was closed, so he asks the building manager Hayashi for a spare key to her room. When they open the room, however, she is found dead inside. The police find a cup of coffee containing cyanide, suggesting the cause of death. They also find an investigation report made by Kogoro, so he is summoned to the scene. Time: Sunday morning Cause of death: Cyanide poisoning Suspects: None known The police rule her death as a suicide, even though no suicide note was left behind. Yet all other evidence points to a suicide, but is this really the truth? Kogoro confirms that ten days ago, he was hired by a man claiming himself to be Yamada on behalf of Aki Kano to investigate Sakon if he had been cheating on her or not. The investigation shows Sakon is having an affair with Michiru Kuga. There are evidence supporting the theory that Kano was desperate upon reading the report, and committed suicide: The security of Sobota Chemicals, where she worked, noticed her coming into the workplace during non-working hours. Tadashi Otsubo, the head researcher of the Sobota Chemicals, reported that the missing amount of cyanide was more than enough to send a person to the afterlife. The previous night, Kano went out to meet her best friend Hiroko Nishida for, apparently, her final goodbye. At the same time, in her recent search history, there are notable words such as “stalker” and “accidental homicide”. Conan and Kogoro find this detail confusing, so they ask some of her acquaintances for extra information: Otsubo mentions Kano was followed a few times by a man wearing sunglasses and a mask. He also believes there are no reason for her to commit suicide because of the publication of a research she and Otsubo have been doing for six year, which is going to happen on the next day. Nishida does not answer Kogoro’s question about Kano’s stalker, as in her perspectives, the more important question is that her friend committed suicide because of Sakon’s infidelity. This is because Nishida knew her friend would try to break any of Sakon’s affairs instead of just saying farewell. Suddenly, Conan reminds Kogoro to inform Kano’s death to the one named Yamada, only for the two to discover through a camera footage nearby that he was in fact, Sakon. So the two arrange a meet up with Megure, Chiba, Takagi, and Sakon to reveal the truth behind.

title.ja: 鹿威しが響く刻

summary.en: Kogoro and Conan happen to pass by two police officers, Takagi and Chiba, investigating the scene of a murder. The reason Takagi and Chiba know the exact time of the crime is because the photographer, Takeru Motomiya, happened to capture the moment when the victim was struck, and took a picture from it. There are four suspects: The photographer. He hid somewhere after taking the precious picture. Toshiki Morita, a Beika University associate professor. He argued with the victim when the person refused to let Morita collect samples of the moss species that happened to grow in the tea room’s garden. Hideaki Okawa, Jun Komada’s apprentice. The police and Kogoro perceive that Komada not promoting Okawa to master is a reason to kill Komada. Masato Kijima, the forest caretaker. He noticed that the woods were quieter than usual the time when Komada was killed. Location: Tea room of Hotel O'Brien's garden Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Toshiki Morita, Masato Kijima, Takeru Motomiya and Hideaki Okawa While the forensic officers are analyzing the photo, Conan suggests Kogoro, Takagi, and Chiba to investigate some other information from the photo, based on the fact that Motomiya's camera is a digital camera. At the same time, Okawa appears, and Takagi questions him about the victim's past conflicts. He seems to be hiding something, even though he says it was a conflict with Morita. When the four return to the hotel to continue questioning Professor Morita, they have to chase him again. It turns out that he has taken a few moss samples from the garden of the teahouse, and he is afraid he would be suspected because of that action. Takagi and Kogoro are thinking that Morita’s action further improves that he is the murderer while the four are walking in the forest. Suddenly, Kijima counters that Morita might steal moss, but he is not a bad person. He shows them a video footage showing the argument between Okawa and Komada. The four continue walking down the street until Motomiya takes a perfectly clear photo of them at the end of the road, in contrast to the one he had taken at 6:29 in the morning. Explaining this, Motomiya recounted the process by which he retrieved the photo: He cropped the image, then he used exposure compensation to make it brighter, and increased the contrast. After looking back at the photo, Motomiya notices something in the culprit's hand. This object’s color is quite similar to jade, causing the group to suspect that Okawa murdered his master. However, Conan feels that something is off, and decides to investigate the scene once again. There, he meets Kijima again, who wonders why the kid is wandering around the crime scene. Then the two have a conversation about Kijima's forest caretaker job. While Kijima is saying that some things appear natural but are not, and vice versa, Conan suddenly realizes something about the scene, but what exactly is it?

title.ja: 秘密の残像

summary.en: Juzo Megure is standing in front of Mouri Detective Agency with a worried look on his face when he is spotted by Conan Edogawa. Up in the agency Ran Mouri has just returned home when she finds Kogoro Mouri enthusiastically cheering for a horse race, which Kogoro is following over his radio. Kogoro says that he can't help but to listen to horse races because he doesn't have work. Although he ensures Ran that he didn't bet any money on horse races, he says it's because they're completely broke, a detail which is overheard by Conan. Conan has taken Megure up the stairs to the agency, but while Kogoro tries to cover up the situation, Megure doesn't mind it and instead has a much more important matter. He suspects that one of his subordinates is having an affair, and he would like Kogoro to help investigate. People involved: Detective Sawatari, Sawatari's wife and Mysterious woman with sunglasses Main suspect: Detective Sawatari Previously, Megure spotted Sawatari, a detective from Unit 3, alone at a park. With a look of intense emotion on his face, Sawatari threw a café receipt into a trash can, which Megure retrieved. The receipt is dated two days ago, and the order is a pasta set and a lady's meal set. Megure, having known Sawatari and his wife well, decided to investigate the receipt and its contents. The lady's meal set can only be ordered by women, but Megure knew that Sawatari's wife had already left to visit her parents, and thus could not have been with Sawatari at the café. Sawatari is also not assigned any cases at the moment, which means he was also not at the café to investigate. Megure confirmed Sawatari's presence at the café through one of employees working there, and he was seen with a beautiful woman. This, of course, is not enough to suspect Sawatari of having an affair. However, dash cam footage recorded three days ago by one of Unit 3's unmarked patrol cars showed Sawatari visiting a high-end jewelry store and buying a bouquet at a flower shop. There is no relevant occasion between Sawatari and his wife to give gifts for, and Megure knows that Sawatari would not give gifts to his wife without a special reason. Since Sawatari is one of Megure's close subordinates, Megure had already approached Sawatari regarding this matter, but Sawatari did not reveal anything. This leaves Megure to trust his police instincts that Sawatari is hiding, and requests Kogoro's help in finding concrete evidence. After all, a police officer engaging in infidelity is subject to disciplinary action, and Megure would like Sawatari to stop before it gets worse. Kogoro explains that the established method of investigation for these cases involves searching through the suspect's notebooks, phone, bank statements, and credit card records, as well as installing voice recorders and bugs in they're home. All of these methods requires Sawatari's wife's cooperation, but Megure would not like Sawatari's wife to know about this as it could hurt her feelings. Conan suggests examining Sawatari's P-III, a smartphone-like police radio, and its GPS records, but Megure says that doing so would attract the attention of the higher-ranked officers. This leaves the option to conduct stakeouts and tail Sawatari, and Megure agrees to assist, being that he is currently off-duty. With that decided, Ran is prompted to turn into the detective agency's receptionist and offers Megure a list of charges in an attempt to earn money for the family. Conan asks Megure if Division 1 has computers or not, to which Megure confirms yes. Then Conan wonders if the search history contains words like “hotel”, “cheating”, “divorce”, or “damage”, then they are investigating in the way that Sawatari is guilty while he could actually be innocent. This surprises him as to why Conan knows these, with him covering that it was Shinichi who taught him, but Megure still proceeds to check the search history. Meanwhile, Ran is seen worried if her father knows how to use a digital camera or not, with him stating yes before going for a stakeout alone. Then Conan decides to look at the footage from the said car with Ran. There, he points out that Sawatari went in and out of the jewelry store in just 5 minutes, which is unusually fast, so they hire a taxi to probably go to that jewelry store. When the two arrive at the said jewelry store, they happen to see Detective Sawatari actually going out with a woman, but Conan soon has to improvise as Kogoro’s method of stakeout almost causes him to be revealed. There is nothing too intense for now, but Kogoro and Conan can’t be seen by Sawatari again while they are in the store, so Ran has to be the one to get in and gather information. Soon after, she informs them that the woman is having her finger measured for the ring. Kogoro receives a call from Megure confirming that the search history does not have any words that Conan mentioned before, but Sawatari did view disciplinary actions, which are the MPD internal regulations including infidelity. Considering the circumstances, there is a chance that Sawatari is guilty, but there isn't any decisive evidence yet. At that time, Sawatari and the mysterious woman are seen coming out from the store by Conan, so Conan pretends to fall near Sawatari so the boy can put a transmitter on him. Before Kogoro and Conan continue to follow the two, Conan asks Ran to visit the flower shop where Sawatari had visited to see which flower bouquet he bought. As soon as Conan receives the information, he goes somewhere after telling Kogoro not to get too close to them. Later, when Sawatari is giving the ring to the woman, he is caught red-handed by Megure and Kogoro, with the latter having taken pictures of him. Surprisingly, Sawatari apologizes for doing things unworthy of the title of the police, but before Megure and Kogoro can get the answer about the relationship between Sawatari and the woman, Ran and Conan step in and reveal the sad truth behind it.

title.ja: 歩美の絵日記事件簿 5
title.zhHans: 步美的绘画日记事件簿5
title.zhHant: 步美的圖繪日記事件簿 5
title.en: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 5
title.enRaw: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 5

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are filming a movie in which Ayumi will write its process into her illustrated diary with the help of Kogoro, the topic of the movie is the case in which Kogoro had captured the graffiti vandaliser. It’s kinda hard to believe that a group of 7-year-old kids can actually make use of editing tools and CG-tech to make the product more convincing, to the point in which it can help win a prize for them and give ideas for Ayumi besides being just a class report. Location: Sakuma Liquor Store and Imakiya Japanese Candy Shop (in Beika Town) Weapons: Spray paint, metal bat Suspects: Kohei Miki The next day, the boys go out to ask some people about the said vandalism: The first one is Takagi, who actually received the information of the case from Kogoro as the vandalism is not assigned for Division 1, he recalls that the items left at the scene were two used paint sprayers while the vending machine and many plant pots were smashed with a baseball bat. He also notes that the camera footage were not available due to the paint, the surrounding neighbors couldn’t give effective clues, and the owner of the sabotaged store didn’t know who could’ve done that as well. The second one is Chiba, he recalls that the second vandalism is almost identical to the first one as the wall is painted with graffiti while the surroundings were damaged by a baseball bat, and there was no effective clue to help them, even the bicycle tire tracks wouldn't help, as well. Location: Sakata Residence and Restaurant Gulf Stream (in Beika Town) Time: 3 days after the first vandalism incident Weapons: Spray paint, metal bat Suspects: Kohei Miki On the third day, however, it is revealed that Kogoro simply caught the vandaliser red-handed when the person was about to perform another vandalism. Mitsuhiko gives the culprit summary to Conan when Ayumi is wondering if they could keep the movie or not, but with Kogoro’s exclamation that he couldn’t do it without others’ help, both would make Conan look at Ayumi’s illustrated diary again and help him know something. Location: Beika Town There are still some anomalies prove that the vandalism was just a front for a bigger case. So the investigation continued and found some interesting details. Later, the boys ask Takagi and Chiba to see the Interrogation Tape and notice some other anomalies that prove Miki was used: Kohei Miki’s appearance has changed drastically in just 6 months. The vandalism may have been a cover for disabling the cameras, which would have prevented an impending crime at the Kaneko Jewelry Store where Kaneko had recently abandoned its high-end security system because it did not reduce the risk of robbery (and it was not their fault anyway). So they go to check Miki’s apartment and find more evidence for the earlier statements and at night, they are seen waiting in the Kaneko Jewelry Store for something, or someone.

title.ja: 闇に聞こえる数え歌
title.en: The Counting Song Heard in the Dark
title.enRaw: The Counting Song Heard in the Dark

summary.en: During the reconstruction of the traditional house inn, the inn hostess found a strange safe, so she called in two experts to check it out: The antique appraiser Seiji Kawabata and the secondhand dealer Shinya Kadokuya, who brought in their friend Ippei Zaizen. The reason Kogoro is here is because the owner received a message threatening to take the treasure. This time, we get to witness another internal conflict between the three antique experts, which would essentially mean there is likely going to be a murder… At 7:38 p.m, the Mouri family, the inn hostess, Kadokura and Kawabata are eating their dinner, when suddenly, Kogoro has to go to the restroom. After finishing his needs in the restroom, he hears a sound of a coin falling from the room nearby, he tries to ask Zaizen if it is him, but gets no answer. At 8 p.m, Kogoro has already fallen asleep and Zaizen has not shown up yet. However, when the hostess turns off the light to have the rest to have a look at the moon, everyone starts noticing the weird light that looks like a fire in Zaizen’s room. Location: Tominaga's guest house: annex Victim: Ippei Zaizen Time: Murder: Between 6:00 and 8:00 pm Arson: Around 8:00 pm Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Seiji Kawabata, Shinya Kadokura, Kyoko Tominaga, and possible outsider Everyone rushes to the annex with two fire extinguishers brought by Kogoro, but Zaizen is already dead in the room. Conan observes the crime scene to look for suspicious traces and finds a cut on the glass door. There are also footprints found outside of the said door. The police arrive at the scene and begin their usual preliminary inspection. Conan then eavesdrops the interrogation between the police and the suspects: Kyoko Tominaga, the inn hostess. She was in the kitchen preparing for dinner between 6 p.m and 6.30 p.m. After that, she visited Zaizen’s room in the annex to give him some yakitori, and lit the lamp when Zaizen told it was dark. It is also revealed that she has financial problems with him. Shinya Kadokura. He went to the annex to check on Zaizen at 7:08 p.m. There, he saw that Zaizen is still striking 2 coins on each other to check their authenticity. It is revealed that Kadokura suffered a huge loss from an investment made with Zaizen’s recommendation. Seiji Kawabata. He went to the annex to call Zaizen at 7:30 p.m, but got ignored completely. Kawabata recalls that Zaizen was striking coins consistently. It is revealed that Kawabata’s reputation was ruined when Zaizen wrote an article about his mistake online.

title.ja: 17 年前の真相 血染めの騎士
title.zhHans: 17年前的真相 染血的骑士
title.zhHant: 17 年前的真相 染血的騎士

summary.en: The Perceptive Devil After the case is over, it is revealed that Kuroda was the one to let Agasa in, as he entrusted Conan to have Agasa in after hearing Conan say that he and Agasa would demonstrate an experiment that would help solve the case. Ayumi suggests that she, other friends, the teachers, and Agasa go to a family restaurant, Kobayashi agrees as the tournament is now cancelled. Kuroda asks the group if he could borrow Conan to have him questioned for a while. Everyone else then decides to go for the second floor for the capsule toy machines, but no one, except Rumi, knows that the security camera has been hacked and controlled to aim at Rumi by Rum and his subordinate, who then send the image of the target to Korn and Chianti. In a room where Conan and Kuroda can talk privately, Kuroda gives the boy the picture showing the dying message left by an American VIP who was assassinated 17 years ago, which means that the case Kuroda is going to ask Conan coincides with one he has been following with Subaru Okiya. Kuroda begins telling him in detail what happened and why he was there… Seventeen years ago, Kuroda was having drinks with a friend of his that was living in the U.S and they were discussing the upcoming chess tournament that Kuroda invited the friend to. During the drinking, they happened to see Haneda Kohji, and after the drinking, they saw Amanda Hughes with her bodyguard walk pass by. Amanda then was seen having a friendly chess match with Haneda while the bodyguard, revealed to be Rachel Asaka, was staring at Haneda when he revealed that she is a type of the woman he loves. He also revealed the temporary condition she has based on just her action. The scene changes just as Rumi is having the same condition Rachel was having, which makes the kids worry about her wellbeing, she reassures that probably she should have rest, and proceeds to go home. But she accidentally breaks Kobayashi’s parachute, which would force her to suggest to Kobayashi to use Rumi’s one while she has to go home via a taxi. Meanwhile, Korn and Chianti are in another building to ambush the target Rum ordered them to, though the condition to perform the sniping sucks. The Far-Sighted Bishop Continuing the story 17 years ago… Possessing excellent memory, Rum accurately identifies all bodyguards seen with Amanda and orders his people to capture and incapacitate them. Assault and kidnapping Location: Juke Hotel, USA Victims: Amanda's bodyguards Culprits: Rum's agents Rum also notes that a Japanese man he saw is also a person of interest and orders his agents to also take care of him. However, when attacked, Kuroda is able to take them both down. Location: Juke Hotel, USA Victim: Hyoue Kuroda Attack Types: Shocking Culprits: Rum's agents Kuroda begins worrying about Amanda's well-being, so he tries to have her room's number via a receptionist, but fails. Meanwhile, having noticed that Rum and his agents are outside the door, Amanda sends Rachel to Haneda's room to retrieve a knight from her chess set to keep her away from the encounter. When Rum comes into the room, he explains that now that they know Rachel is like a daughter to Amanda, the organisation can use that information and now recruit and force her to help them. Rum presents the APTX 4869 pill to Amanda, showing the alternative, but in an unexpected moment, Amanda voluntarily jumps forward and ingests the pill. Location: Juke Hotel, USA Victim: Amanda Hughes Cause of death: APTX 4869 poisoning After Rachel reaches Haneda's room, Haneda reveals that Amanda likely sent her away on a wild goose chase on purpose, as there is no way that someone would miss the fact that a knight was missing from the chess case because of the specially designed crevices for each piece. Haneda tells Rachel to hide when Rum and his agents knock on Haneda's door, asking if they have seen a Japanese woman. Haneda says no and swiftly shuts the door. He then goes on to taser Rachel and hide her in the bookcase in his room. Rum then comes back again and notices that the order of the books has slightly changed from before and, knowing that Rachel is hidden in there, reaches out to remove the books. At the same time, when Kuroda accidentally knows the room Amanda is staying following a bellhop, Amanda's body is discovered. Kuroda orders the bellhop to call the police while Kuroda examines the scene. He realises that the special guest Haneda said he was going to play chess with was in fact Amanda, so, sensing something is off, he requests the bellhop for the room of Haneda, but will it be in time? Before Rum gets the chance to remove the books, Haneda drops his act and tells Rum he remembers seeing him in the news. Haneda is then repeatedly beaten and eventually fed the APTX 4869 pill as the police are arriving due to. Before he dies, he leaves a final message by cutting up a mirror with the text "Put on mascara".
