At this time, Rachel wakes up and, under the assumption Kuroda killed Haneda, begins attacking him. Having no choice after she breaks some of his ribs, he takes Rachel down In a moment of shock when she sees a photo of Amanda's corpse on a phone. Rum and his agents outside the hotel see chess notes flying out of the hotel, and Rum deduces that Rachel will be snuck out of the hotel using the bookcase again. However, as they reach Haneda's floor, Kuroda, wheeling a suitcase with Rachel in it, manages to sneak by. After Rum realises that Rachel was in the suitcase, he and his agents get in his car and begin chasing Kuroda's vehicle. However, Kuroda's car ends up being ran into by a truck and his car catches on fire. Seeing the commotion, Rum decides to step away. Location: Unknown street in USA Victim: Hyoue Kuroda In his last moments of consciousness, Kuroda asks an EMT about how the female in his car was, and the EMT says that only he was found, suggesting Rachel escaped before the ambulance got there. title.ja: 元太のうなぎ捕物帳

summary.en: A chef named Shigeru Unagizuka, who is also the owner of Ginpachi Unagi Shop, was injured in the leg and could not make a delivery, so Genta decided to help him. He coincidentally meets Conan, Haibara, Mitsuhiko, and Ayumi on the way. Unfortunately, the chef is discovered to be seriously injured by a stab wound to the left side of the chest and is currently being treated in the hospital in critical condition. This makes Genta extremely angry and determined to make the culprit pay for what he has done. Location: Ginpachi Unagi Shop Victim: Shigeru Unagizuka Time: Between 3:30 and 4:30 pm Injury: Stab wound to left side of chest Suspects: Yuya Kurashima, Hiroyuki Okamoto and Rio Matsui Before that, Takagi has to ask Genta about the time he last saw Unagizuka, the boy answered he arrived here at 3pm and left to help the victim deliver goods at 3:30pm. Later, the boys also learn that Yuya Kurashima found the victim stabbed at 4:30pm when he delivered soy sauce. In addition, Genta remembers that he met a man who was immediately chased out by Unagizuka when he just left the shop holding an envelope with the word Aoiya written on it, so the police, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys go together to confirm the identity of that person. The man, Hiroyuki Okamoto, had an argument over eel sales outside the victim’s shop. The police also plan to question the last customer before Unagizuka is found (and luckily they paid by card, so it would be easier to find them). The last customer, Rio Matsui, recalls that she was at the shop from 3:45 pm to 4:15 pm, and she did not see anyone else suspicious. At the same time, Genta is hungry because he couldn’t eat the eels he would had after delivering the goods if Unagizuka hadn't been stabbed by someone. Luckily, Rio’s husband would be home late tonight and would be having dinner out, so Genta and his friends are treated to the eels that are probably meant for tomorrow by her. However, when leaving Rio's house, Genta points out something unusual about the eels he and the others had just eaten, so after Takagi leaves, they return to the Ginpachi Unagi Shop to check. There, Genta discovers that the soy sauce used on the eels is different from usual, so everyone decides to ask Kurashima to confirm, and he denies the crime because: Ginpachi Unagi Shop stopped using Kurashima's soy sauce since he took over his soy sauce company and if he wanted revenge he would have done it years ago because making soy sauce takes many years. Today he went to that shop to let Unagizuka try his newly made soy sauce and saw him stabbed. Then Genta gets the idea to ask Rio about the eels and who prepared it for her and she says that a very young person wearing a mask made it, and from there, with Genta’s rich knowledge of eels and Conan’s deduction will together reveal the abnormality to point out the culprit.

title.ja: 人喰い教室の怪（前編）
title.en: The Mystery of the Man-Eating Classroom (Part 1)

summary.en: Agasa and Haibara are watching the news reporting the firearm store robbery that happened yesterday when Haibara suddenly asks Agasa if he is free on Wednesday the 16th, to which he explains that he will be teaching one of his acquaintances how to use the remote meeting control from the afternoon to evening, much to her dismay as that could mean that no one will be there for her in Parents’ Day visit at school. On the Parents’ Day visit at school, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are walking to the school, with each of them having different feelings for the day: Ayumi is very excited because her dad is anticipating comparing her height increase, which had been noticed yesterday, with her fellow classmates. Mitsuhiko is excited as well because he wants to perform well in front of his parents. Genta is not, however, as his mom said that she would punish him if he dared to fall asleep in the class ever again. Haibara doesn’t care that much because her parents have gone since she was born. Conan reveals that his mom has returned to Japan by chance and she is going to the class today, much to the Detective Boys’ anticipation.

title.ja: 人喰い教室の怪（後編）
title.en: The Mystery of the Man-Eating Classroom (Part 2)

summary.en: At the Kudo residence, while preparing for the parents’ day visit at school, Yusaku Kudo and Yukiko Kudo recall the time they kidnapped Conan under the disguises of Night Baron and Fumiyo Edogawa, respectively, with the latter having met with Ran and Kogoro before, so they would suspect Conan again if some parent in the class takes a photo showing that the person attending the meeting for Conan is Yukiko instead of Fumiyo. They are also relieved of not having to explain the situation to Shuichi Akai, who is attending the FBI meeting requiring his present, as it could reveal Conan’s true identity, though Yusaku thinks that he could’ve figured it out for a while (and we can confirm that). They also discuss Rumi Wakasa's situation, knowing that she has been in the Teitan Elementary School as class 1’B deputy homeroom teacher to get close to the person who viewed her news posts the most, Conan. Even though Rumi seems to be not too harmful to Conan for now, Yusaku still warns Yukiko to be careful of her, as she will likely do anything to achieve her goal: Revenge. He then wonders why Yukiko comes here rather than just the disguise, to which she replies it is for the tablet. The fate of today's Parents' Day is unclear; who set fire to the flower bed, and what does Yukiko plan to do with the tablet?

title.ja: 執事になった理由（前編）
title.en: The Reason He Became a Butler (Part 1)

summary.en: On the Shinkansen where Iori is having his ride with Momiji, Heiji, and Kazuha, a drunk man accidentally spills his beer on Iori's sleeves, forcing Iori to wash it in the restroom. There, he notices a phone left behind that is also ringing, he answers the call trying to help the person receiving it back, only to realize that Momiji is dragged into a hostage situation that requires Iori to follow the order of that person or else she will be killed. The person asks him to wake up a man sitting near the window at the end of the train car no.14, Iori says that he couldn’t wake him up as the person admits his disgusting crime of killing the person, and the person requests him to take the USB from that person. It appears that the murder was performed accidentally while they happened to see Iori, whom they have known to be a former PSB officer as mentioned earlier, and they decided to use Momiji as a hostage to force Iori to do the dirty job of theirs. Tanigawa refused to give his USB and tried to fight back, only to receive a fatal stab to the chest from a knife.

title.ja: 執事になった理由（後編）
title.en: The Reason He Became a Butler (Part 2)

summary.en: Having been found by the scoundrels, Iori had no choice but to defeat them like other scoundrels. However, one of them managed to flee away from being subdued by the PSB officers later on and swore to make Iori pay one day. The story returns to the present where Iori still hasn’t found the USB yet, as the butler return to the body to finally notice how the victim hid it so well that the blackmailer couldn’t find in the first place, Heiji comes with message from Conan, hinting that they have acknowledged about the situation.

title.ja: オバケが出た

summary.en: There have been rumors about a ghost appearing around the Restaurant TOMO area every Thursday for the past two weeks, and that ghost appears again tonight at the rooftop of that restaurant in front of the Detective Boys and a college student who just moved in to live with an old woman named Motoko Kanazawa two weeks ago, Mami Mamiya. Kanazawa tells the Detective Boys and Mamiya that she has also been receiving suspicious calls ever since Mamiya moved in. And when Mamiya is about to see the Detective Boys off, numerous footprints are seen outside the accommodation where she and Kanazawa share. Location: Motoko's accommodation and Restaurant TOMO Witnesses: Motoko Kanazawa and Mami Mamiya Age: 75 years old (Kanazawa) and 19 years old (Mamiya) Time: Every Thursday since two weeks ago Kanazawa began receiving suspicious calls two weeks ago, while Mamiya began witnessing the ghost appearance every Thursday ever since she moved in. The Detective Boys take Haibara and Conan to join in with Mamiya at Restaurant TOMO so that the two could help them solve the mysteries on the next day. However, there is no result for now as a staff member named Haru Miyake tells them that there is no way to go to the rooftop of the restaurant, while the chef says they have never heard of any rumour like that. Later, the group decides to go to Kanazawa’s accommodation for further investigation, with Conan and Haibara arriving there for the first time and saying hello to the old lady. In the afternoon at the residence, we learn that Kanazawa was a former chef of a very famous restaurant, and she owns a secret recipe book that Conan saw earlier when he was trying to look inside the window. Both of the above explain why Kanazawa cooks so well, but she also has to deal with people wanting to have a look at that recipe book. Kanazawa's desk phone suddenly rings, which is quite strange as it is just the afternoon. She decides to answer in hope that the people won’t disturb her further just for the recipe, but there is no one answering the call. Suspicions about who made the call turns to scammers when Kanazawa reveals that she had helped the police solve a scam aiming toward her. Attempted scam (past) Victim: Motoko Kanazawa Culprits: Man A and Man B So they return to the restaurant and learn how the ghost even appears in the first place, and decide to have Genta and Mamiya pursue the man behind the ghost. Later that day, the two notice a man with suspicious behavior that turns out to be a door-to-door flyer distributor, Genta also smells something that is familiar with him inside the accommodation. Location: Restaurant TOMO Cause of injury: Fell from high place Meanwhile, Conan, Ayumi, Haibara, and Mitsuhiko are wondering why the two have gone so long when a sound behind the building catches their attention. It turns out that Miyake fell from the cargo boxes near the ladder connected to the rooftop of the building while trying to figure out what the chef did on the rooftop, as he did hear rumors about the ghost. At the same time after Conan goes to the rooftop to check again, Mamiya asks the boys where Genta went as he stated that the beef stew cooked by Motoko felt similar to one from Restaurant TOMO. It appears that the chef is the one behind everything, except for the scam, and Genta is in danger as he knew this after tasting that stew. Will the boy be safe?

title.ja: ガラスの水面（前編）

summary.en: Lawyer Hiroki Oi receives a request from his client, Kanta Tsuji, to investigate the mysterious death of Takeshi Yamaoka, which was said to be caused by the curse of Urashima Taro two weeks ago, and now he entrusts the case to Kogoro, Conan, and Ran. On the train to Kyoto Prefecture, where the client is, the Mouri family is discussing the plot of the Urashima Taro fairytale. Urashima Taro is a character who was brought down to the Dragon King's palace by the sea turtle he had rescued earlier to be the main guest of the gratitude party. However, when he returns to the village, several centuries have passed, and all of his friends and family have died. But one question remains for Ran’s perception: What is the curse of Urashima Taro? Upon arriving, they begin to hear Tsuji's account of the events two weeks ago: While searching for his missing friend Takeshi Yamaoka with a fisherman named Hironobu Matsuyama; and the head priest of the Urasawa Shrine, Akihide Kamikawa, the three heard a seemingly familiar melody related to the curse of Urashima Taro, and then they discovered Yamaoka's body on a boat with his hair seemingly turned white due to the curse. Tsuji suspects that one out of the following four people must have killed Yamaoka (He himself is a suspect as well, but there is no reason for him to suspect himself if he didn’t kill him anyways): Matsuyama, Kamikawa, Miku Nishino, and Yamaoka’s ex-girlfriend, Hitomi Togashi. So the Mouris begins asking them:

title.ja: ガラスの水面（後編）

summary.en: Inspector Ayanokoji expresses his surprise that he meets the Mouri family again because it just feels like a strange connection (for Ran, he even saved her life once), Conan also expresses his wonder if the seriousness of this case had attracted his attention, to which he assumes so. But since it is quite late at night now, he wants to rest and investigate tomorrow, perhaps as an excuse to go to Nishino's super luxurious ryokan (he comes from a wealthy family after all) to enjoy the hot springs with Maro. The old case could not be solved when Nishino avoided all the questions related to the death of the two brothers that Kogoro and Ayanokoji asked and it seemed like it would hit a dead end, until the Mouri family sees the arrow mark written in chocolate syrup by Togashi, giving them a glimmer of hope to discover what she was trying to tell Kogoro. This hope is suddenly extinguished when it rains, erasing the syrup marks she left. During that time, Inspector Ayanokoji's team informs them that they find a box similar to the small one stolen at Urasawa Shrine containing the poisonous frog that took Takeshi's life in Nishino's room. However, she tells them with great confidence that if they want to convict her, they will have to disprove her alibis.

title.ja: 石巻のヒーロー

summary.en: After the recording at the Ishinomaki Yaiba Hall, the Detective Boys, Conan, Haibara, Ran, and Kogoro are taken on a tour of the city. During that time, Conan and Haibara notice Chiba scanning QR codes with a serious expression. The next morning, while the group is waiting for Kanehara, Ayumi realizes that she had left her script in her room, so she has to go back for it. However, she becomes curious when she sees Chiba following a man, so she follows Chiba but the two end up being subdued by him and his accomplice. Location: Underground parking of hotel building Victims: Kazunobu Chiba and Ayumi Yoshida Age: 24 years old (Chiba) and 7 years old (Ayumi) Method: Shocking (Chiba), Unknown (Ayumi) Culprits: Dario and an unknown person Worried about why Ayumi is taking so long, Conan and Haibara begin investigating her whereabouts. In the process, someone told Haibara that they saw someone looking like Detective Chiba. Conan uses the name of Sleeping Kogoro to ask Takagi why Chiba is here. Takagi then tells Conan about an unsolved smuggling case, which shares the same culprit to the recently-reported murder. Smuggling and murder? Time: Recent years (smuggling) Stolen items: Rare goods of high value Takagi told Conan about the unsolved smuggling case involving the murder occurred recently. Mitsuhiko and Genta have sneaked out to investigate Ayumi's whereabouts, and the duo happen to meet Conan and Haibara, who have been doing the same. Upon learning that Ayumi is in some kind of danger, the four of them split up to scan the QR codes, since Chiba himself had also scanned the QR codes yesterday for peculiar circumstances. Just when the four are starting to get tired after finding some abnormalities with the two specific QR codes, Motomura happens to pass by and is asked by the kids to help with this tricky situation. They eventually are able to track the whereabouts of Ayumi, and Chiba, but will they be able to save them?

title.ja: 幻の大男を探せ
title.zhHans: 去寻找神秘的高大男子

summary.en: In the interrogation room, Takahiro Matoi tells the police that he could not recall a thing after he had drinks with the victim, Shiori Jojima, and two other colleagues. Location: Roadway in Beika Victim: Shiori Jojima Time: 7 PM on the previous night Cause of death: Suffocation Suspects: Takahiro Matoi, Shigeki Natsuhara and Shohei Yumura They were drinking with the victim before she was found dead, so they became the main suspects Meanwhile, Conan and Haibara just arrive, as they are asked by the Detective Boys to help find a cat for an old lady. While they are looking for it, they see Takagi and Chiba doing some kind of investigation. It turns out that the two are looking for a person that wore construction site uniform at the time where Matoi was drunk to confirm the alibi for him. The boys are also curious about what happened to Matoi, so they ask Takagi and Chiba, to which they tell that Matoi was drunk somewhere around the location the police and the boys are standing, and the man saw someone on the other side of a wall that is opposite to where he was sitting. However, the person is revealed to be Genta and Mitsuhiko standing on top of the sooner, as they were looking for the cat up in the wall for some reason. But a case couldn’t end when the culprit of the murder is not yet revealed, so the kids split up into two groups to investigate: Conan goes with Ayumi and Matoi to the building where the murder occurred while Haibara goes with Genta and Mitsuhiko. After a preliminary site inspection at the room, Conan and Matoi come outside and see Ayumi talking to Madoka Jojima, Shiori’s sister who hates Matoi due to his unkempt lifestyle, and is suspecting him for murdering her sister. After that, the group goes to see the company Shiori worked for, where Megure and another policeman are interrogating the two colleagues who drank with Matoi and Jojima the previous night, Shohei Yumura and Shigeki Natsuhara. There, Conan and Ayumi happen to know that someone in that company embezzled the money, and the two police assume that Shiori learned about who caused this and was silenced for that, the suspicion is further improved as Haibara’s group also learns about that embezzlement. Victim: Construction company Embezzled assets: Unknown amount of money Suspects: Shiori Jojima, Takahiro Matoi, Shigeki Natsuhara and Shohei Yumura Meanwhile, Haibara’s group couldn’t find anyone else in the convenience store where Matoi was in noticing his existence and the three raise doubt on him instead. But the doubt seems to suggest Conan something else about the truth of the murder as he suddenly causes the attention of Megure and the others.

title.ja: 鷲雄山の紅蓮髑髏（前編）
title.zhHans: 鹫雄山的火红骷髅（前篇）
title.zhHant: 鷲雄山的紅蓮骷髏（上集）
title.en: The Crimson Skeleton of Mt. Washio (Part 1)

summary.en: Conan, Ran, Kogoro, Heiji, and Kazuha are climbing to the top of Mount Washio when it rains. The umbrella Kazuha brought only has enough space for three people, so Kogoro and Heiji end up soaking in the rain. Luckily, Kogoro sees a shrine near the location where they are standing, so they decide to ask for permission to stay. The chief priest agrees to let them stay, and tells the other two monks to welcome them. The visit should be normal as the group rests at a room, until Conan suggests asking the fourth monks when Heiji’s amulet has been lost by accident, because the fourth monk has been missing for several days after being punished to go to the confessional for smoking. The monks also recall the appearances of the will-o’-the-wisp, which make everyone believe that the missing monk has been devoured by the monster appearing along with the will-o’-the-wisp, the crimson skeleton. Legend says that the crimson skeleton will devour the soul of wrongdoers and leave behind the corpse of victims.

title.ja: 鷲雄山の紅蓮髑髏（後編）
title.zhHans: 鹫雄山的火红骷髅（后篇）
title.zhHant: 鷲雄山的紅蓮骷髏（下集）
title.en: The Crimson Skeleton of Mt. Washio (Part 2)

summary.en: At the hallway of the room, Ran is crying over the fact that she and Kazuha could not find Kogoro, despite searching everywhere they could, and that Kogoro could have been devoured by the crimson skeleton. Kazuha reassures Ran that it isn’t the case because Conan said the crimson skeleton did not exist.

title.ja: 招き猫は見ていた

summary.en: At 11:30 during a bird watching trip, Kogoro, Ran, and Conan see a suspicious person looking around before going to his truck containing two electric appliances through binoculars, but Conan points out something that suggests their detective work is not going to be put on hold. Location: Shiro Kurotaki's house, Kitaokuho, Tokyo Prefecture[N 1] Victim: Shiro Kurotaki Time: Between 9 AM and 10 AM Cause of death: Blood loss from stab wound on the chest Suspects: Orie Shoyama, Takuro Shoyama, Sosuke Yumemura and Akihiro Kurotaki The police arrive at the scene as usual, and Takagi brings along the victim’s older brother, Akihiro Kurotaki, who also notices something unusual about his younger brother’s guitar case. In addition, the identity of the “suspicious” person that the Kogoro had noticed earlier is confirmed to be Takuro Shoyama, who is soon cleared of suspicion because his testimony is confirmed to be correct. But the case has another branch as Takuro received calls from his daughter, Orie, who hasn’t been on good terms with her father and has left the house for 6 years. Following this route, the police go to her apartment but one of her neighbours tells them that she had gone to find a missing item since 10:30 this morning in a panicking mood as Orie told in her phone: Papa, help me! The police then receive information that a person had fled the scene on a yellow motorcycle at the exact same time, making the search for the person a top priority. While the Mouris is discussing why Takuro hid his contact with his daughter, they notice her nearby, but strangely enough, after following her for a while, the three of them discover a person matching the suspect description and Orie is seen with him. After they lose sight of the two and stop to see if they are around, a scream attracts their attention, as Orie is reported to have fallen from the second floor of a building, before being taken to the hospital for first aid she says Shiro hasn't died, but what does this mean? Location: Shopping mall near Beika Station Victim: Orie Shoyama Cause of injury: Falling from second floor terrace Suspects: Orie Shoyama, Takuro Shoyama, Sosuke Yumemura and Akihiro Kurotaki After asking Akihiro for more information about Shiro, the police also get information about the yellow motorbike that Kogoro had seen earlier and its owner, Sosuke Yumemura. He states that Orie had killed Shiro because of a love conflict and had accidentally knocked Yumemura unconscious while escaping. After bandaging his head wound, he received a call from Orie asking him to take her to the police station, but halfway there, she said she had something to do and left. Takuro then arrives and reveals that he came to the scene to also collect the keys left in front of the victim's house by the daughter after she killed her boyfriend, because she was very angry after receiving a call from Shiro asking her to break up and not to come near again. In a moment of slip of the tongue, Conan accidentally reveals that the place where Orie is being treated is Beika General Hospital, but is that all to it?

title.ja: ブチの恩返し

summary.en: At Mouri Detective Agency, Takagi is showing his gratitude to the great detective for helping him solve a previous case when Detective Chiba makes a call to him. It turns out that a man claiming himself to be Buchi wants to meet Takagi at Todoroki Park so he can give him valuable information as a way to return a favor. When Conan, Kogoro, and Takagi arrive there, however, they find Katsuya Iwabuchi dead. Moreover, a note about a potential robbery at 10 a.m of the next day is also found near the body, so it's possible that Katsuya is the person behind Buchi. Location: Todoroki Park, Tokyo Victim: Katsuya Iwabuchi Cause of death: Stab wound to the chest Suspects: Three jewel robbers Assuming if this man was the one behind Buchi, then it could be inferred that he made a tip to Detective Takagi about a potential robbery but was killed by one of the three robbers who caught him doing so. Next day, close to 10 a.m, Conan, Kogoro, and the police ambush the hinted location to await the three jewel robbers. To Megure's surprise, no robbery happens at their place, and he receives reports that three people have attacked a Jewelry Store in Tsurui City. Oddly enough, every news outlet arrives at Megure's location, having received an anonymous tip that the police were misled. The police suspect the note was made by one of the three jewel robbers, more specifically, the ringleader, so they split up to investigate. Takagi, Kogoro, and Conan go to the apartment of Katsuya’s friend, Kazuo Kamegamori. He tells them that Iwabuchi showed fear when someone was looking for him half a month ago, he also reveals the reason Iwabuchi hated the police was because he was falsely accused of bicycle theft one year ago. This begs the question what Takagi did to Iwabuchi that made him an exception to his police hatred. Location: Tsurui Jewelry Store Stolen items: Low-value jewelry Culprits: Masayoshi Daimatsu, Jun Nakatake, and Minayo Koume Every news outlet received an anonymous tip about the robbery, and the note fooled the police about the potential robbery. One notable detail is that the store being robbed is fairly easy to access. Takagi is asked to return to the station as they have led two suspicious individuals for interrogation. There, the two admit to being hired by Masayoshi Daimatsu to perform the robbery but deny any acknowledgement about the murder. Some core information about Daimatsu is also provided: He was caught in a pawn robbery reported by an anonymous tip. He was released from custody half a month ago, the exact time Katsuya got terrified. He injured his leg whilst trying to escape from the police, and seemed to have hatred toward Megure, who caught him. Location: A pawn shop Stolen items: Unknown Culprit: Masayoshi Daimatsu Megure received an anonymous tip that reported to him about the case, and quickly caught him before he could escape. However, the culprit broke his leg while trying to escape. The police also find Daimatsu and confront him on the rooftop of a building, where Conan tranquilized Kogoro and begins his deduction as The Sleeping Kogoro.

title.ja: その顔を捕まえろ

summary.en: Ayumi sees a person's face after he blows his nose, which looks like the one who has been on the run for 5 years, so she calls for Conan, Haibara, Genta, and Mitsuhiko. While discussing the reward and how they should tackle the issue, a man named Koji Tanaka passes by and gets caught up in it as soon as he and Conan see the suspect's face. Robbery and Murder (past) Location: Victim's house Victim: Unnamed 80-year-old man To this day, Kito is still on the run. The reward for catching him is 3 million yen. However, Tanaka insists on chasing the person alone while having the kids call the police instead. But the suspected person slipped onto the river, forcing Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys to save him with the Elasticity Suspender. Accident or attempted murder? Location: An alley near the river Injury: Head injury from fall impact Suspects: Koji Tanaka The Detective Boys manage to save him, but for some reason, Tanaka fled the scene. However, the suspected person is actually Taro Yamada, who has been struggling in life and is the doppelgänger of the wanted criminal, Ken Kito. The police confirm their distinction and admit that they have previously received many tips on Yamada. However, with Tanaka nowhere to be found, the Detective Boys help the police sketch Koji Tanaka's appearance so they can investigate further.

title.ja: ザ・取調室 3

summary.en: Yusuke Kawashima held an audition the previous day where whoever passed would get to co-star with Miyuki Jono. Just some hours ago, someone got inside and murdered him, then got away on their motorcycle and nearly hit a café maid on their run. Assistant film director Akito Kubodera ran into the culprit when they rushed out of Kawashima's room; he found their appearance identical to Haruko Nagisa, one of the auditors. Kubodera’s testimony was strengthened via security camera footage collected by the police and testimony from nearby civilians. Unfortunately, he was the only one to see the culprit’s face since they wore a motorcycle helmet on their run. Reckless endangerment Consequence: Hit by a motorcycle The culprit nearly hit the café maid on their way to escape the scene.

title.ja: 赤レンガ倉庫 消えた誘拐犯（前編）
title.zhHans: 红砖仓库 消失的绑架犯（前篇）
title.zhHant: 紅磚倉庫 消失的綁架犯（上集）
title.en: The Red-Brick Warehouse and the Vanishing Kidnapper (Part 1)
title.enRaw: *The Red-Brick Warehouse and the Vanishing Kidnapper* (Part 1)

summary.en: A stray cat, carrying a piece of paper, appears at the spot where Mitsuhiko is showing off the Kamen Yaiba pin he has accidentally won to his friends. The cat hands the paper to Conan, much to everyone's surprise, revealing that someone needed help. Meanwhile, Sato and Takagi are chasing after the kidnapper of Ishigami Corporation's granddaughter, Shiori, because Sato mistook him for an ordinary illegal parking offender and let him leave without taking a suitcase that the kidnapper should have taken so that Inspector Hatori of the special investigation team could find the girl, potentially endangering her life. The car Sato is driving, chasing the kidnapper's motorcycle, reaches Kanagawa Prefecture, where we see Chihaya Hagiwara handling a traffic case. She also notices the red car speeding and decides to chase after it to see what is happening. The kidnapper is very stubborn, running red lights and honking loudly to scare away all passersby. However, he nearly left a young boy crashed by Sato’s car without Chihaya’s interference, as the boy was left stunned from the chaos and unaware of the car chasing for the motorbike. Just when it seems all hope of catching the culprit has vanished, some subsequent clues suggest to the three officers that the man is hiding in a red-brick warehouse near the scene of the near-accident.

title.ja: 赤レンガ倉庫 消えた誘拐犯（後編）
title.zhHans: 红砖仓库 消失的绑架犯（后篇）
title.zhHant: 紅磚倉庫 消失的綁架犯（下集）
title.en: The Red-Brick Warehouse and the Vanishing Kidnapper (Part 2)
title.enRaw: *The Red-Brick Warehouse and the Vanishing Kidnapper* (Part 2)

summary.en: Back at the warehouse, Inspector Jugo is going to enjoy pancakes with a police detective when he mistakes Sato for a motorcycle police officer and asks her to return to work, only to receive a terrifying glare in return. The two proceed and Jugo finds something even more shocking: Chihaya is sitting with Takagi. The shock hasn’t ended though, while enjoying pancakes with a mixture of jealousy and resentment, Chihaya approaches him and asks for his help, much to his surprise.

title.ja: 女子会ミステリー 4

summary.en: Haibara, Ayumi, Ran, Sonoko, and Sato go to an all-you-can-eat sweet shop in Haido Town Royal Hotel, celebrating the good health and future achievements of the girls. However... Murder/Attempted murder Location: An all-you-can-eat sweet shop in Haido Town Royal Hotel Victims: Satomi Amari (deceased) and Naoko Shimamura (hospitalized) Age: 21 years old (both victims) Method: Poisoning using snake venom Suspects: Kyoka Kasai, Ryuichiro Mita and Shunsuke Yoshimura The two ladies began to writhe in pain and suddenly collapsed after consuming the drink, with one having passed away. Ran tries to contact Shinichi Kudo for help solving the case, while Ayumi calls Conan. However, Conan (as well as Shinichi) couldn't hear the calls because he had left both of his phones elsewhere so that he can focus on fishing with Professor Agasa. With no help from either Conan or Shinichi, the girls will have to solve the case on their own. The girls decide to ask the people nearby, along with local police. Kyoka Kasai is the first to be asked; she is a sociology student at Haido Women's College who works here as her part-time job. In fact, Naoko Shimamura and Satomi Amari are both at Haido Town Royal Hotel to visit Kasai upon knowing she works there, which explains why she is crying over Amari's death. Moreover, Kasai states that both were such good and earnest individuals that no one hates them at all. Ryuichiro Mita is the second to be on-screen; he is an office worker at Haido Brotherhood Company. He knows Shimamura because he once saw her in his company, but was not sure if she was applying or not. Shunsuke Yoshimura is the third one on-screen; he is a municipal worker. It is worth noting that Ayumi has asked both Mita and Kasai what sweet they like before their respective interrogation ends, and she does the same with Yoshimura. This time, his answer is not delivered as smoothly as the two previous, and he also shows strange expressions upon seeing a piece of skin found at the scene. Both things prompt the girls to ask Yoshimura again. From there, we learn that he works as a snake hunter, and was afraid of being convicted for murder if he revealed to them about the skin. On a side note, the cause of poisoning is revealed to be snake venom. What a coincidence! Moments later, Kasai reaches out to the girls to confess that she herself is knowledgeable about snakes, as she is working very hard to become an underground snake charming idol. Kasai also notes that the snake she has for training, Kobu, has had its fangs removed so that Kobu can bite her all day and she’ll be just fine! After reviewing the information they’ve just gathered, Ayumi proposes using their imagination to figure out who poured the poison, which further confirms that anyone could be the culprit. Just then, Ran’s statement helps Haibara realize something, as she then asks the two police officers to confirm a few things.

title.ja: エピソード "ZERO" 工藤新一水族館事件（1 時間スペシャル）
title.zhHans: 第"0"集 工藤新一水族馆事件

title.en: Episode "ZERO" The Shinichi Kudo Aquarium Case

title.ja: 追跡！探偵タクシー 3

summary.en: Riding in a taxi driven by Kogoro-superfan Genki Ishikawa, Conan and Kogoro travel to Furai City to attend an event organized by the city. They had supposedly been recommended to be special guests of the event by Megure, but when Conan calls Megure himself to confirm (using Kogoro's voice), Megure denies any knowledge of this. Megure adds that, recently, a series of mysterious jewel robberies have occurred in the metropolitan area. Location: Various jewelry stores in Tokyo Stolen items: Expensive rings, necklaces, and crowns Culprits: Multiple, unnamed thieves-for-hire (crime boss is unknown) Although various jewels and crowns have been stolen, there is no sign of them being sold domestically. Therefore, it is likely that these stolen items will be smuggled out of the country. Group of robbers subdued by female employees Since there is no sign of the jewelry being sold domestically, the police suspect the jewels to be smuggled out of the country. Therefore, they have set up security checkpoints at every airport and dock in the country possible in an attempt to stop them. Despite this, another jewelry store was robbed today. Surprisingly, nothing was stolen; in fact, the thieves were captured by the jewelry store staff without needing the assistance of the police, making this robbery seem much less organized than the previous robberies. This makes Megure suspect that someone is toying with the police. After this call with Megure, Conan makes a connection between the sloppy robbery and the mysterious, almost absurd, nomination of Kogoro for the role of Frozen Mince Cutlet Kid. Both of these events seem to fool with their subjects, so could these events be more than just a coincidence? As Conan is deep in thought, Ishikawa's taxi arrives with Kogoro and Ran to pick him up. They intend to head home, but the mayor arrives once more to try to convince the group to stay. He starts chattering about the cutting-edge technology used in the city's new factory. A keyword within this talking, “finely mince,” catches Conan’s attention and helps him figure out the truth of the disappeared jewels.

title.ja: W・アリバイ

summary.en: In a hotel where Kogoro and Conan have an appointment with Kogoro's client, they happen to meet one of Kogoro’s huge fan, Natsumi Sasakawa, whom her dad soon appears to give a proper introduction to Kogoro. Then Kogoro’s client, Ryota Tanno, arrives and begins to discuss with the detectives about the recent threat letter he received. Meanwhile, Professor Agasa and Haibara are running on a road near the beautiful river when a boat without something to keep it from floating indefinitely catches the attention of the two, prompting Agasa to take a suitable stick to retrieve the boat. However, the content inside the boat is not as peaceful as the scenery… The initial estimated time of death is between 7:30 and 8:30 am, and with some extra factors, the estimated time is narrowed into from 7:40 and 8:30 am. When Megure, Takagi are questioning Haibara and Agasa about the time before the death of Masato Furubuchi, some people' gossip about him catches the attention of the four, as Haibara comes to ask them about the person Furubuchi argued with. Location: Okuho Pond, Tokyo Metropolis Victim: Masato Furubuchi Time: Between 7:40 and 8:30 AM Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Ryota Tanno Haibara makes a call to Conan to ask him if Kogoro's client today is Tanno, and informs him about what just happened. Kogoro after taking the phone and hearing what happened, soon concludes that Tanno fabricates alibis so that he can be out of suspicion. Kogoro asks Tanno about what he had done before he met Kogoro and Conan in the lobby of the hotel. Tanno says he received room service at 7:30 a.m, which is the beginning of the estimated time of death. Kogoro refutes the statement being alibi for him, as Tanno can easily go out through the window of his room to land on the truck that happened to park under to collect the used tower, even if he lives on the 3rd floor. This gets Conan and the audience to think about what kind of trouble he ran into the last time he went to the building to know the truck’s parking location. Kogoro continues his theory, after Tanno went to the crime scene and did his thing, he returned to his room via climbing the drainpipe at the same time of the puppet clock’s show to avoid any detection. Tanno admits to using the commute method, but explained that he did it simply to breathe fresh air without being disturbed. Conan also cites Haibara's explanation that it takes an hour to drive from the lake to the hotel, meaning that if Tanno went out to kill Furubuchi, he would only return after 9:30. Kogoro suggests that Tanno must have used a helicopter for the murder, but the boy and Tanno refute this, as there is probably no helipad at the hotel, while Conan states that Haibara and Agasa would notice the helicopter if it were operational. Suddenly, Natsumi handcuffs both Tanno and Kogoro, creating a hilarious situation for the audience, while Conan can have time to investigate the scene with Agasa and Haibara. Meanwhile, Megure and Takagi question Aoi Suzueda, another of Furubuchi's students, about what he did before his death. She cites his plan of going fishing at 7 a.m. and returning at 9 a.m. Takagi feels sorry for the loss of her and the other students, she quotes others who said this is a good opportunity to reevaluate their lives, while she also mentions that her master had always treated them unfairly. This leads Conan to ask her what bad things Furubuchi had done. Conan also asks the old woman owning the fishing equipment why there aren’t any fishing poles displayed outside, to which she answers there is nothing to catch at this time of the year. The boy begins to suspect why Furubuchi was trying to fish when there is practically nothing to catch in the lake. Suddenly, the episode’s forensic officer carries Conan and tells him that he is not supposed to be near the crime scene. Takagi also notes with the forensic officer about the strange flower petals, which certainly didn't come from the lake itself but from somewhere near the river connected to it, following Haibara searching. Once the investigation is done, the three quickly return to the hotel before the true culprit can escape from custody.

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are in the Limited Express “Super Hakuto” that leads them to Tottori Prefecture, as they will be taking a bus to arrive at the Misasa Onsen. On the way to the Yumemiya Ryokan, their resting place for the tour, they see Yasuto Utsubuki and Sachiyo Yumemiya talking about Yasuto’s father and Sachiyo’s aunt not allowing the two to be married. Seconds later, Kazuko Yumemiya and Hisao Utsubuki show up and do what the couple just told about earlier. In the Yumemiya Ryokan, the Mouris are welcomed by Teruki, Kazuko’s son, and a waitress named Yoshimi Komori. As Komori introduces to Ran and Conan about Yumezakura, a kimono that the waitresses walking behind Komori is going to wear for her wedding, the two instantly realize the woman behind as the one they met earlier. Kogoro also meets two Kurayoshi officers that the family has met in a past case, Katsuhiko Yamane and Ryo Okamoto. The two show their gratitude toward Kogoro for helping, and express their joyfulness of capturing the serial bag-snatcher one week ago, which is why they are here. In the dinner, Kogoro is drinking with Okamoto and Yamane as he tells the two detectives how he solved cases as Sleeping Kogoro, while Conan and Ran enjoy the dinner at another table when Conan receives the drink he orders from Sachiyo. The two ask her about the problem Sachiyo has, she explains that Kazuko once got into a property dispute with Hisao Utsubuki. Suddenly, Komori accidentally spills some kind of sauce on Conan's costume, so she has to take Conan to change the costume. From there, Conan realizes that some people have issues with Kazuko with their own matters: According to Kazuko Yumemiya, Yoshimi Komori’s carelessness is damaging the reputation of the inn. Kazuko also denies a loan for Masamichi Kasuga, even though his company is facing financial difficulties. Kazuko roasts his son for being in debt because of a girl from Osaka whom he spent money on. Kazuko tells Sachiyo that she never wants to keep the ryokan on her own, and she wants Sachiyo to marry a dependable man instead of Yasuto. Before the dawn of the next day, Teruki wakes Kogoro up, as Sachiyo has disappeared for some reason. As the two Kurayoshi officers are awaked from the sound, the two would request back up from the Misasa police box. Next morning, Kasuga tries to ask Yasuto if his niece was there or not, which Yasuto answers no, while he mumbles that Sachiyo actually did something. There are some possible suspects beside people in the inn, and Yasuto: The first person is Toshihiro Kitami, a photographer brought by Okamoto, Yamane, and a Misasa officer. The reason he became the suspect is that Sachiyo appears in some pictures he had taken yesterday when he was taking pictures of frogs in the Misasa. A second possibility is Sachiyo’s close friends who are members of Tottori Arts and Culture Association. So Ran and Conan go to the Yonago City Center to ask the tour guide, while Okamoto and Yamane go to Mount Daisen to ask the mountain guide, and Kogoro goes to find the sand sculptor (he is also seen in the Tottori Sand Dunes, where he used to tie up Conan and throw him down because of a sudden burst of inspiration). The investigation by the five people seems to yield no results, so they decide to interrogate Yasuto once again to see if he knew anything about the disappearance. This time, he admits that Sachiyo has temporarily taken refuge in the warehouse of the Misasa Violin Museum in the hope that her parents would understand the genuine feelings between her and Yasuto. However, Sachiyo is nowhere to be found there; instead, she has become the victim of an actual kidnapping for ransom. Kasuga recalls that a waitress noticed a black car parked near the mountains yesterday evening, meaning there could be a high chance that the people in the car were the kidnappers. Victim: Sachiyo Yumemiya Ransom: 100 million yen Suspects: Yasuto Utsubuki, Kazuko Yumemiya, Teruki Yumemiya, Yoshimi Komori, Masamichi Kasuga, and Toshihiro Kitami The captor will send two more videos every hour, and the ransom must be prepared within two hours. Yasuto points out that Sachiyo has never blamed anyone else for the unfortunate events that happened to her. Conan happens to pass by three waitresses, including Komori, discussing that no one has ever seen a car like what Kasuga told. The two things raise doubt if Sachiyo was really kidnapped or not, so Conan goes to some location for information, with Ran and Yasuto tagging along: On the road Sachiyo went after escaping the warehouse, there are two separate paths, one of them leads to Misasa Onsen. Conan sees the photographer again in the Kajika bridge when the three arrive at the hot spring through his telescopic lens. The three reach out to Kitami, and know that Sachiyo was trying to cross the river. The side she went to leads to Yumemiya’s parking lot, which has one black car with sand on it. Meanwhile, the inn receives a third message from the kidnapper. It seems like Kazuko is cornered when she agrees to pay the ransom to rescue Sachiyo, since she had promised her sister that she would take good care of Sachiyo. Suddenly, Conan notices something from the word "wave".

title.ja: 円谷光彦の探偵ノート 4

summary.en: Haibara and Mitsuhiko are waiting for Conan, Ayumi, and Genta to arrive so that Mitsuhiko can properly read his Holmes story The Adventure of the Abbey Grange for the first time with his friends. As the kids are walking on the road, a cat stops by Haibara, which catches Mitsuhiko’s attention as well. The cat takes the two to a room, a room where another man is terrified because of a corpse. It takes much longer than usual for the police to know the corpse belongs to Daiki Fujinai. Location: Toichiro Hakozaki's residence Victim: Daiki Fujinai Time: Around 1:30 PM Cause of death: Blunt force trauma to the head Suspects: Tomohiro Nojima, three robbers caught running in a hurry Before knowing the identity of the man, the police examine the scene and notice that some of the household’s belongings have been. In addition, there are three used wine glasses on the table, suggesting that the group of thieves were celebrating from hitting the jackpot, despite having to eliminate one of their members. The police decide to interrogate the man who was terrified earlier, Tomohiro Nojima. Nojima is a long-time fan of Toichiro Hakozaki, the owner of the residence, and both of them are acquainted with each other. About Hakozaki, Nojima mentions he is currently taking a break from column writing due to exhaustion, he has a favorite writing tool - fountain pen, and he does not own a smartphone. The reason Nojima was in the room is because he received a call from Hakozaki, asking if he could bring the fountain pen to Hakozaki. In addition, Hakozaki gave him proper guidance to enter the house and told him that he can take his time: "To enter the house, look for the potted plant at the entrance, you will find my spare key." – We can’t confirm if Hakozaki said that to Nojima, but he meant it. However, Nojima found the door not shut when he arrived, so he entered directly, which led to the scene we saw earlier in the episode. Outside, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys, having heard everything outside, begin to discuss certain details of the case. While the other members of the Detective Boys are off-screen, Conan follows Nojima, as he is exploring Hakozaki’s working space for the first time. Then Conan goes out somewhere and finds a schedule[1]: Conan looking at the trash collecting schedule. Burnable trash is collected on Monday/Thursday. Non-burnable trash is collected on Saturday. Recyclables are collected on Tuesday. Cans and bottles are collected on Friday. Note: The specific type of trash should only be disposed of on a designated day in the week. Trash is collected in the morning only. At this time, the police have known the identity of the body, and they have also caught the thieves. Conan calls Haibara, asking if the police know about Hakozaki’s whereabouts, this is because Conan has been investigating him ever since he saw the trash collecting schedule. The call makes Ayumi believe Hakozaki has been abducted instead of taking a real break, which Nojima disagrees with along with some nonsense of a fan. That nonsense reminds Haibara of the cat that led them to the scene earlier, so the four kids split to find it. As Mitsuhiko and Haibara are searching in the area of the residence, their attention shifts toward Detective Chiba, who arrives to report some details to Megure. Chiba reports that the thieves have nothing to do with the murder, and Nojima’s behaviour could be of a stalker. The report makes the two believe that he is the real murderer, so they contact Ayumi and Genta to warn them about Nojima. Worrying that the others might be in danger, Mitsuhiko contacts others with the Detective Badge while he and Haibara are rushing to the others’ location. Suddenly, the two find the cat and decide to chase it, up to Hakozaki's secret apartment. Meanwhile, Genta and Ayumi find Conan gathering something, along with Nojima, who are helping Conan look for evidence, as the two simply ran into each other a moment ago.

title.ja: キッド VS 白馬 青の王座（前編）
title.zhHans: 基德VS白马 蔚蓝的王座（前篇）
title.zhHant: 基德 VS 白馬 青玉王座（上集）
title.en: Kid VS Hakuba: The Azure Throne (Part 1)

summary.en: The Tokyo Bell Tree Tower of the Suzuki Conglomerate is attracting public attention once again due to its latest expansion, the exhibition room in the sky; along with Kaitou Kid’s newest target, the Azure Throne. At night, inside the building, Jirokichi quotes from his newest collaborator that the reason Kid often strikes when the skies are clear is because of his outfit being susceptible to humidity, which leads him to have Kichida Manufacturing build this new exhibition room. He then shows both Conan and Nakamori the security installed outside the room: The wall facing toward the camera has its three horizontal color lines changed randomly, but their color patterns are always synchronized with one from the security room monitor frame. The corridor before entering the exhibition room has some very powerful humidifiers installed on. Then, the exhibition room is going to have its final check before Jirokichi’s next encounter with Kid. However, just as when they finish their testing, the power is suddenly cut. Conan notices an abnormality in the camera footage, and rushes to the exhibition room. This scares off Satsuki Kichida as she is looking for a police to help address the strange message from her husband, who is also the president of Kichida Manufacturing, Yotaro. Strangely enough, Yotaro’s secretary Kyuuya Kamiji also receives a strange message from him, both say: “I will protect the jewel with my life”.
summary.zhHans: 怪盗基德相关作品以预告、变装、宝石目标和柯南的追踪对决为核心，属于独立角色专题线。

title.zhHant: 基德 VS 白馬 青玉王座（下集）
title.en: Kid VS Hakuba: The Azure Throne (Part 2)

summary.en: Masuo Kase, technical director of Kichida Manufacturing, recalls that Yotaro told him he needed time to check something in the room after they finished the testing. Kase also notes others about the rumor that Yotaro and his wife were fighting. Kamiji was a firefighter 10 years ago, but quit after breaking a bone from falling off a ladder. The reason he became Yotaro’s secretary is because he was the one to explain about fire prevention equipment during Yotaro’s visit to the fire department. Satsuki was sitting on her husband’s chair waiting for his return when she received that strange message from him. When Nakamori informs her about the rumor given by Kase, she clarifies that the one who often argues with her husband is actually Kase. Takagi and Megure finally make it to the scene due to heavy traffic. But not long after they arrive, they will have to go back to the police station with the culprit because both Conan and Hakuba figure out the truth after hearing the forensic report.

title.ja: 館ミステリー 渦巻館（前編）
title.zhHans: 馆之谜案 涡卷馆（前篇）
title.zhHant: 館之謎案 渦卷館（上集）

summary.en: A few days ago, Kogoro got hyped up when he saw Yoko Okino at the Spiral Mansion on TV, so he is taking Conan and Ran to the location today. The three are still debating about the tower of Babel when the curator Kaoru Neji arrives and explains to them about various spiral art and the owner of them, Kyu Tsurufuji. Later, the art magazine editor Kazumi Hayase arrives as he has an appointment with Neji and several members of Tsurufuji family: Kyu’s son Sensuke Tsurufuji, Sensuke’s younger sister Maimai Tsurufuji, and Sensuke’s wife Yoko Tsurufuji. While the Mouris continue their visit, Hayase tells them that the publication fee is 300.000 yenRoughly 1870 US Dollars as of June 13th, 2026, despite Kyu's contribution to conceptual art. Maimai accepts the deal, while both Sensuke and his wife refuse it, stating that they don’t have the money for that. Sensuke then leaves the room, with his sister trying to convince him to reconsider the offer. Yoko also leaves the meeting to return to her position. Hayase apologizes for messing up the atmosphere, to which Neji comforts him by saying it is not his fault and thanks him for coming to the meeting. Meanwhile, Kogoro and his family have just finished a room, and decide to go to another one. On their way outside of the room, they realize that there is no more room to visit that way, meaning they will have to go on another route. The three then hear a scream, which is followed by a gunshot.

title.ja: 館ミステリー 渦巻館（後編）
title.zhHans: 馆之谜案 涡卷馆（后篇）
title.zhHant: 館之謎案 渦卷館（下集）

summary.en: The body of Satoshi is found at the stream near the Spiral Mansion, much to Maimai’s misery. The police begin to verify the alibis of the remaining suspects at 1:15 PM, the estimated time when he died. Maimai was working at the studio again after the interrogation; while Neji was talking to Hayase; and Yoko was standing where Conan came to ask for the blueprint, with the only exception of going to the restroom. Conan arrives at the place where Satoshi was finishing his newest sketch for investigation, then he wanders around the mansion and overhears the conversation between Yoko and Maimai about splitting properties after the case is over. However, since Sensuke had already decided that his father’s art would belong to the museum, both of them will have "zero divided by any non-zero natural number equals zero" in terms of property. Maimai has no problem with that, but Yoko does as she angrily leaves the room. After she is not in Conan’s eyes range, Maimai comes out and asks him what he wants. He says that he wants to see her husband’s latest sketch, to which she agrees. Conan notices that the drawing is double-layered, with the outer layer usually used to correct the inner layer, making her wonder what is in the inner layer. Much to her shock, she finds out that Satoshi has been using his sketch as a way to sell her father’s art, even though she was extremely upset with the news, she still tells Conan not to reveal this to anyone. He agrees to.
