title.en: The Cosplay Rider of the Wind
title.enRaw: The Cosplay Rider of the Wind

summary.en: Over the past month, there have been four purse-snatching incidents caused by a pair of thieves on a motorcycle. Most notably, the most recent incident involved a large sum of money being stolen. Serial purse-snatching Time: Throughout the month Culprit: Two thieves in a motorcycle In the past month, there have been four purse-snatching incident caused by a pair of thieves in a motorcycle. As Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are talking to Kamen Yaiba cosplayer Takeshi Fujimiya, a purse-snatching incident occurs nearby. Location: A park near a construction site Time: Between 7 AM and 9 AM Target: A purse containing pamphlets Culprit: A thief on their motorcycle Later, Fujimiya suspects that this attempted purse-snatching is not caused by the duo responsible for the serial purse-snatching. The thief attempts to flee from the crime scene after his attempt fails, only to be followed by Conan riding his skateboard, and Kamen Yaiba riding a bicycle that he happens to see. The thief is able to escape thanks to the road that is still under construction, which Conan and Kamen Yaiba have close to no knowledge of. Takagi and Sato, after seeing the pursuit being followed by the four kids and the man that almost got his purse stolen, whose identity is revealed to be a salesman Hideo Saida, interrogate the five as their usual drill. Later, Conan and Fujimiya come to give information after the failed pursuit. Fujimiya is a night shift security guard that stops by the park to do his training after his shift is over. In addition, he confirms to Conan that he has been training from every 7 AM to 9 AM for four consecutive days. Conan then asks Takagi about details of the fourth purse-snatcher. Takagi recounted: Around 10 AM five days ago, just as the old lady was carrying a bag containing three million yen that she earned from selling artwork to the bank, two thieves on a motorcycle snatched the money from her, causing her to fall to the ground. The police pursued the thieves, but lost their trail in a park that happens to be near a construction site, and the vehicle was left in a bush in that park. Purse-snatching (past) Location: A busy street leading to the station Victim: An old woman Time: Around 10 AM, 5 days ago Property stolen: A purse containing three million yen Culprit: Two thieves in a motorcycle Note: This is the fourth incident of the aforementioned serial purse-snatching. The woman's back was injured following the snatching, and she still in the hospital for treatment. Takagi and Sato also confirm that due to noise complaints from the neighbors, the construction only starts from 9 AM, while the park does not allow anyone to enter from 7 PM to 7 AM of the next day. If someone were to enter within the restricted time, they would be caught by either a security guard, or some cameras working at night.

title.ja: シンデレラの靴

summary.en: At the previous day's prom at the Daigo residence, Yu Daigo was struck by love at first sight with a mysterious girl. However, she had to leave early for some reason and only left one of her shoes behind. This is the reason why Kogoro and Conan are at the mansion. Yu recalls that after he finished discussing work with his secretary over the phone, she ran away from the prom. Coincidentally, Daigo's call with his secretary contained terms that Reira may have misinterpreted as Daigo having a call with legal officials, leading him to believe that she was in some kind of legal trouble. The doubts become reality when Yu finds out that his pocket watch inherited from his father has disappeared, most likely taken by that girl. At the police station, Sato and Takagi are giving photos from criminals that had previously been caught for similar offenses for Yu to confirm who the mysterious girl is. He confirms the appearance of the girl is similar to Reira Made, and gets into the car with the other four to Reira’s house. Location: Daigo residence Time: One day before Property stolen: Pocket watch inherited from Yu's father Suspects: Reira Made In the middle of the ride, Yu receives a call from an unknown number, but still answers following Sato guides. The number turns out to be from Reira, as she is asking for his help. When the five arrive at the house, they discover that Reira has been beaten and tied up with some tapes. She is then taken to the hospital with the supervision of Yu and Sato, as the rest decide to investigate the scene with Chiba and some other officers. Location: Reira Made's house Cause of injury: Beating Suspects: Miyako and Juria She is found with bruise and tied with tape. Following the testimony of a neighbor and messages from Reira’s phone, the four conclude that Miyako and Juria forced Reira to commit multiple theft and abandoned her when they thought that the police were closing in on Reira. The problem is that how are they supposed to find Juria and Reira when they have already run away? Conan suggests that the four can use the phone to track their whereabouts, only to find a truck that is on its way to dump industrial waste illegally. It seems as if the investigation would gradually reach a dead end when the four detectives could not find useful information from the neighbors. Then, Kogoro's naive thoughts about the luxurious bed of the residence reminds Conan of something that makes him enter the room where Reira had been found with bruises and tied up.

title.ja: 少年探偵団 VS 老人探偵団 2
title.zhHans: 少年侦探团VS老年侦探团2
title.zhHant: 少年偵探團 VS 老年偵探團 2
title.en: The Detective Boys VS The Silver Detectives 2
title.enRaw: The Detective Boys VS The Silver Detectives 2

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are walking in the street when they see the Silver Detective having helped an old lady find her cat. Just as when the two groups of detectives are having a conversation after not seeing each other for a long time, a woman passing by the street hears the Silver Detective introducing themselves as detectives, and decides to ask them to find her missing husband. Victim: Shinsuke Sugamo Time: Half a month ago He went out his house to find a job, but has not returned since. The woman is Machiko Sugamo. Three months ago, the company Shinsuke Sugamo worked in went down, and he had to find a job. However, one morning around half a month ago, Sugamo went out to find a job opportunity, and hadn’t returned since. His whereabouts are unclear while his communication is also unavailable. Both detective groups reassure her that they will soon find him. Conan suggests two possibilities: Either the husband chose to disappear for some reason or he got caught up into something bad. The Silver Detectives volunteer to investigate the latter route while Conan and the Detective Boys will investigate the former route, and Haibara will look after the elderly so they won’t mess up the scene like last time. After a while, the Silver Detectives find a useful clue: A man working at Cheetah Delivery saw Shinsuke arguing with Tadao Yuge exactly three months ago, as the latter insisted on not selling his home, and even pushed Sugamo away. Coincidentally, after Haibara's efforts to stop the three elderly from acting recklessly to prove Tadao is guilty fail miserably as they go in and dig his yard, they find the skeleton of a person with a broken rib. A skeleton discovered by Mutsuhiko Akasaka and Ginta Oshima Shinsuke Sugamo with Conan and the Detective Boys Takagi, Megure, and Chiba arrive at the scene with some other officers. Haibara suggests that the person buried in this yard must have been killed. One problem is that could a body dissolve that fast in just half a month? Machiko also arrives at the yard to see if the skeleton belongs to her husband or not. Suddenly, Shinsuke appears with Conan and the Detective Boys. It turns out that he failed to find a job and felt guilty to his wife, to the point where he became very depressed and couldn’t figure out the timing to return. For the time he'd been missing, he had stayed at a friend’s place. The police bring Tadao to the interrogation room, but soon release him due to the fact that those bones are at least 300 years old, and Tadao couldn’t kill someone at Edo time. This report makes the Silver Detective very depressed, as according to them, he had signs that prove he is not entirely innocent. Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys decide to investigate Tadao’s acquaintances: Shinsuke recalls that Tadao insisted on not selling the home because he wanted to keep his memories of his deceased wife, and wanted the son who ran away to have a place to return to. Sugamo targeted the house since he heard that Tadao was planning to move to the countryside and live quietly, but gave up the intention after what happened to him. Shigeko Noda, a neighbor, recounts the events that had happened to Tadao’s family: Four years ago, his son Tatsuya messed things up at work. He resigned from the job and had been very depressed about his self-worth since. Then one day, he disappeared and left no communication to his family while Tadao reassured his wife that their son would be back stronger. However, Tadao’s wife passed away when she was talking with Noda about her son’s whereabouts being unclear for the past year.

title.ja: 置き配泥棒多発中

summary.en: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are staking out a door on the fifth floor of an apartment with a package in front of it in search of a package thief. The group gets distracted by a sudden draft of wind that places a leaf inside of Kogoro's clothing which Ran mistakes as a bug. While Kogoro and Ran are trying to get rid of the leaf, Conan notices the package thief running past with the package in hand trying to leave by elevator. The elevator shows the thief stops on the fourth floor and Conan gives chase via the stairs but eventually loses the thief when Conan reaches the fourth floor. Given that the entrance to the apartment building locks automatically and the thief was wearing sandals, the trio concludes the culprit most likely is a resident of the apartment building. Location: Fifth floor of an apartment building Stolen items: Delivery parcel Suspect: Nobuhiro Taninaka A chubby brown-haired man wearing glasses was seen taking a package from the entrance of someone's apartment. Later, the three go to find residents who knows anyone matching the description of the package thief. They stumble across the resident of room 402 Sumiyoshi who suspects the thief may be his neighbor Nobuhiro. Unable to get a hold of Nobuhiro by knocking on his door, Kogoro asks Sumiyoshi if he can borrow his balcony to try catch a glimpse of the suspect. To Kogoro's shock, he instead finds Nobuhiro dead on the floor. Victim: Nobuhiro Taninaka Cause of death: Cerebral contusion Suspects: Sumiyoshi Ito, Nami Tomishige, and Mariko Sakaguchi There are some details suggesting that this case is not a simple accident, but a murder: His eyes are bloodshot, and his mouth is drooling. Near the trash can, there is a piece of paper stating that the victim is being punished by the gods for stealing a package. Therefore, the murderer is most likely one of the owners of the seen packages. Thinking for a while, Kogoro deduces that the culprit must have put a bobby trap onto their package and purposely let it be stolen. Conan decides to check the package and find Sumiyoshi Ito’s package has a strange circle mark. However, Ito pushes him away and tries to escape from custody. It is revealed that he did put only pepper spray into his false package, but since pepper spray could not actually kill someone on their own, he could not be the one responsible for the murder.

title.ja: 私が犯人です

summary.en: Yoshiaki Kamata lives with his father Hajime; his younger brother Mitsumasa; and his wife Sachiko. Even though all of the three have their own dispute with Yoshiaki, they were genuinely worried when he had not come down for his breakfast, so they went to his room and broke the door because it was locked inside. However, they only found him dead with a knife on him, and the room was quite messy. The Mouris were invited to the scene because every member of the family admitted to having killed the victim on their own. To make things worse, another woman named Keiko Mitamura comes to the scene to admit that she was the murderer. Victim: Yoshiaki Kamata Cause of death: Blood loss caused by a stab wound to the back Suspects: Hajime Kamata, Sachiko Kamata, Mitsumasa Kamata, and Keiko Mitamura All four people admitted that they had killed the victim. All of them also had their motive to kill Yoshiaki. However, they could not tell the police how they killed the victim. Since none of them was able to tell the police how they committed the murder, it is clear that everyone was lying to protect someone, despite having their own motive to kill Yoshiaki: Yoshiaki said that everything that his father had was not genuine all along, but he still lives thanks to his father’s not genuine assets. From Sachiko’s perspective, she was blamed by her husband for her infidelity while he was the first one to cheat on her. Moreover, Yoshiaki’s abusive behaviour almost got her to end her life, as she would have jumped off a building without Hajime’s words. Mitsumasa reveals that he is in a relationship with Sachiyo, which practically means they are cheating. Keiko Mitamura is Yoshiaki's ex-girlfriend, but probably broke up when the two learnt that they were half-siblings. In addition, she is still delusional that Mitsumasa is her boyfriend. Ran constructed Kamata's family tree Conan then decides to investigate the scene on his own, and when he is thinking outside, Ran shows up and they have a conversation about this weird case whereas everyone is lying to protect someone. He then asks Ran if lying to protect someone is okay, she replies: If she has to lie, she prefers the type of lie that is both gentle and does not hurt anybody.

title.ja: アーチェリーに嘘はつけない

summary.en: The victim is Juro Dan, the chairman of Dan Juro Food. At first glance, everyone believes that someone stood at the top of the Dan Juro Food office to commit the killing shot. Kogoro suggests they test the theory with a dummy. Time: Between 11:30 AM and 11:55 AM Cause of death: Blood loss caused by an arrow shot to the throat Suspects: Hitotsu Dan, Futatsu Dan, and Chinatsu Tachibana There are three suspects and their respective alibis: The first one to discover the scene was Juro’s secretary Chinatsu Tachibana, who was working with him at 11:30 AM before he was found dead. At that time, she heard the doorbell, so she went there to take the food from the delivery man. Twenty-five minutes later, the food finished heating up in the microwave as she was preparing water for the two. However, when she brought the meal to the chairman, he had already been found dead. The second and third one are Juro’s sons, Hitotsu Dan and Futatsu Dan. Both of them were taught archery by their father. Recently, there have been grudges between each of them and their father; and grudges between the brothers. Both of them were eating at the Dan Juro Food cafeteria at the time the victim died. However, there were times during the lunch in which each of them were absent from the table due to circumstances.

title.ja: 園子とコナンの怪談ナイト
title.zhHans: 园子与柯南的怪谈之夜
title.zhHant: 園子與柯南的怪談之夜
title.en: Sonoko and Conan's Spooky Story Night
title.enRaw: Sonoko and Conan's Spooky Story Night

summary.en: Ran seeks safety from Conan after hearing scary story from Sonoko. During a sleepover at a mountain cabin, Sonoko has been telling Ran a story of Hannya, whom a woman was killed by when she got lost in the woods. The story easily scared the poor girl as she seeks safety from Conan. Conan and Sonoko decide to let Ran cook the dinner while they pick wild vegetables as a way for her to investigate the rumor. Victim: Unnamed woman Cause of death: Blood loss caused by stab wound During their vegetable searching, Sonoko experiences something that Ran had just gone through, so she suggests they should go back to the cabin instead. On their way home, Sonoko sees someone burying something, so Conan decides to dig up the land after the man leaves. The content that was buried earlier is a corpse of an unknown woman, terrifying Sonoko as she screams loudly, alerting the man to come back. The man, wearing a mask like Hannya, decides to silence them both. Fortunately, the duo are able to cut them off and take cover in tall grasses. Victims: Conan Edogawa and Sonoko Suzuki Age: 6-7 years old (Conan) and 17 years old (Sonoko) Having heard Sonoko's scream, Hannya returns and sees her and Conan, so they decide to silence both of them. Suddenly, Ema Tono appears out of nowhere when the duo are still hiding, scaring both girls in the process. Conan finds Ema’s ring does not fit her at all, and he also finds a cabin on top of a mountain, so he suggests the three heading there for refugees. Gonbei is the master of that mountain shack, and upon hearing pleas from the three, he reluctantly agrees to let them in. Minutes later, Masashi Inukai returns to the shack, and confirms to Sonoko and Conan that he was called by the police to find their whereabouts. Just as Sonoko is celebrating that Ran has called the police and they will be saved soon, Inukai reveals he dropped the communication radio by accident, meaning they should be residing at the shack until either it is morning or the police arrive. A moment later, Conan drags Sonoko outside as he reveals to her that the murderer they encountered earlier could be any of the three people they just met. Conan explains why he perceives it that way: The colour of Inukai’s vest is too dark for others to find him if he gets lost in the wood, whereas Ema’s current outfits are just too bright to keep her from nature predators or human predators. Meanwhile, Gonbei's appearance when they met him for the first time does not resemble that of a man who stayed at home all day, while Conan also smelled blood from him. Meanwhile, Ran and the policeman she called to find Sonoko and Conan haven’t found them yet, prompting her to depart with the policemen she is going with to speed up the progress. At the same time, in the room Conan and Sonoko are having rest, Conan wakes her up and the two begin to run. Outside the cabin, the two happen to find Hannya mask when they drop the hay bales by accident, which makes them believe Gonbei is the murder. They also find a bloody axe on a chopping stump, which further improve their inital conclusion. Just then, he approaches them with a fierce expression and carries a shotgun. The two are scared as they run for their lives and ignore his plea to wait. Shortly after, they slip off the slope down to a cliff, as they scream in fear, which Ran is able to hear. Bloody axe on a chopping stump. After Conan gives Sonoko first-aid as she got injured while saving him from the fall impact, he begins trying to throw his elasticity suspender to a tree branch, intending to use it as a pulley shaft. The efforts succeed thanks to Sonoko’s help, and as the two finally climb up the mountain, they are welcomed by Ema. She is also shocked upon learning that Gonbei is a murderer, and suggests that the three should escape together. Suddenly, Conan questions the girl about the ring, then he rummages through her handbag and finds a knife with ropes inside. Sonoko grabs Conan and runs back to the shack, wondering who is the murderer they encountered.

title.ja: コナンと梓 誘拐したのは誰（前編）
title.zhHans: 柯南与梓 绑架犯是谁？（前篇）
title.zhHant: 誰綁架了柯南與小梓（上集）

summary.en: Sonoko, thinking that there must be other matchstick puzzles that require one to take only one match to fulfil a certain requirement, decides to search for them on the Internet. However, she stumbles upon news of a murderer who takes one finger away from bodies that he killed as trophies. Masumi mentions that the murderer has been caught and confessed to their crime, but no one is certain if the criminal has accomplices or not, and their whereabouts, if they exist. Azusa says she has seen the face shown in the news somewhere, but she is not certain at the same time.

title.ja: コナンと梓 誘拐したのは誰（後編）
title.zhHans: 柯南与梓 绑架犯是谁？（后篇）
title.zhHant: 誰綁架了柯南與小梓（下集）

summary.en: From the picture shown by Sonoko, we can see Omura’s laptop screen being reflected on the glass, along with the solution of the matchstick puzzle Azusa gave them earlier. This is because Sonoko took pictures of the solution from various angles. Masumi mentions to Sonoko and Ran that she went to the restroom for a while when the three are in Poirot, and asks the two if they told something that might become the cause for the kidnapping. The two recall that they were talking about the upcoming tug-of-war tournament, whose women's division competes in a team of six, with the winning team earning a ten thousand yen gift certificate. The two intended to have Masumi in for the tournament, while were still discussing if they should invite Azusa as well, but decided not to because she is light and does not seem to have the strength for it. Amuro and Masumi realize something, and want to have another look at the first picture shown by Sonoko.

title.ja: 転げ落ちてきた男
title.en: The Man Who Came Falling Down
title.enRaw: The Man Who Came Falling Down

summary.en: At the bench near the stairs that lead to an abandoned temple, an old couple, named Hirunosuke Yanaka and Sayo Nezu, are talking about how each of them had a dream about the other one, when they see Kogoro and Conan looking for a notebook. The notebook has been kept by Nezu ever since she found it earlier this morning, and is then given back to Kogoro. Location: Somewhere near the stairs at the abandoned temple Victim: Takashi Koiwai Cause of death: Head trauma from falling down stairs Suspect: Ren Tsubota Tsubota's words: Stop! Wait! catch the attention of Kogoro, Conan, and an old couple. Then a man is seen falling down the stairs near the bench the old couple are sitting at. Suddenly, the four hear the voice of a man telling someone else: “Stop! Wait!” before seeing a man falling down from the stairs and going straight to the afterlife. Before Kogoro could assess anything further, the man that has said the words expresses his disbelief: “No way!” along with his odd facial expression. Still, the man asks if Kogoro can call another ambulance for another victim. Location: At the same location, but upstair Victim: Rokuro Oshiba Cause of death: Blunt force trauma on both sides of his head Suspects: Ren Tsubota, and Takashi Koiwai Ren Tsubota mentions he saw Koiwai hitting Oshiba, but Conan is not convinced because the only things that he and the others near the bench knew were Tsubota's words. The man with an odd expression is Ren Tsubota, the one falling to his death is Takashi Koiwai, and the victim Tsubota was trying to help is Rokuro Oshiba. Oshiba was hit on both sides of his head, leading to inevitable death if his head wasn’t as tough as someone’s. By questioning Asao Sendagi, one of Koiwai’s friends, everyone learns that Koiwai hated Oshiba because the latter plagiarized one of his works and earned an award from that plagiarized work. However, Sendagi notes to everyone that Koiwai is not crazy enough to kill anyone. Koiwai’s motive is clear, but the way he executed the murder does not feel natural, so Megure orders his subordinates to find everything they can that is related to the crime. Kogoro and Conan also decide to investigate Koiwai themselves to help the police end the case. Conan finds a restaurant employee that is acquainted with Koiwai and contacts Kogoro as the Great Detective just finishes asking probably one of Koiwai’s neighbours. The employee recalls that she heard Koiwai discussing that he and someone else could make it work together, which could imply the existence of accomplice(s) responsible for Oshiba’s death.

title.ja: J リーグ 開幕の警笛
title.zhHant: J 聯賽 開幕的警笛

summary.en: Renji Matsuo is working as secretary for Nanako Eguchi, mayor of Toraharu city. He has been waiting at one of Eguchi’s cars, waiting for her, when his phone suddenly rings. When he picks up the call, the other end of the line blares the referee’s whistle loudly, causing the pipe bomb installed under the car Matsuo has been standing to explode. The man is left gravely injured for the rest of the episode. Bombing - Attempted murder Location: In front of Toraharu City Hall Victim: Renji Matsuo Matsuo went off with a bang after the other end of his call blared the referee's whistle loudly. He barely survived from the explosion and was taken to the hospital. Meanwhile, Agasa, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are at an undisclosed stadium to watch the football match between Big Osaka and Tokyo Spirits, the opening match of this year’s J-League. While the match is going on, Conan notices a man who wears a dark yellow shirt and a yellow cap looking elsewhere in the stadium. His behavior makes Conan suspect what he is plotting to. At the time, Haibara finds Kogoro sitting with Nanako in a room for special guests to spectate the match, so she points Conan to her direction. Coincidentally, Just as when Conan has a look at the old man, Takagi and Megure reach out to Kogoro and Nanako for something. Haibara searches the internet as she fears something is off, and discovers the bombing that happened earlier. Meanwhile, Takagi and Megure have brought Kogoro and Nanako to an undisclosed room inside the stadium to inform them about the bombing that just happened. This prompts Nanako to show the police about the threat message that she received this morning, which she believes to be from someone who opposes her city land use plan. She also recalls about a man who sent her a cut-off ball, believing him to be from the people who want to buy the youth soccer team’s field for cheap and flip it. Moments later, the first round of the match ends and Conan takes advantage of the break to investigate the situation, of which the Detective Boys are soon aware when Haibara explains to Agasa. They decide to carry out their own investigation, much to Haibara and Agasa’s dismay. To sum up with the investigation, Conan finds a connection between the man he saw in the first round of the match, named Iwashimizu, and the people targeting Toraharu city mayor. He then gets in touch with VAR team members and their video operation room when the Detective Boys are investigating on their own, as they mistook them for suspicious people. He once again meets Takagi and Megure, who are trying to find Iwashimizu, and suggests doing so with the help of the video operation room.

title.ja: おいでよ石器人の里
title.en: Welcome to the Stone Age Village
title.enRaw: Welcome to the Stone Age Village

summary.en: A video of a man who lives a prehistoric lifestyle has gone viral on the Internet. It was filmed by Eita Nakamura while having Tsutomu Iwata as the main reporter, at a waterfall situated near the Mount Hiehata trail in Stone Age village, Hiehata city. Kogoro arrives at the village with Conan and Ran without a disclosed purpose, though they are still looking for the prehistoric man like most others. They find the man when they are hiking on the mountain trail, but unable to catch up with him while finding someone else dead nearby. Location: Near the stairs that lead to an abandoned temple in Mount Hiehata Victim: Saneo Kurauchi Cause of death: Blunt force trauma on his head Suspects: Stone Age Man, Tsutomu Iwata, Fukusuke Tsuzuki, Kotaro Nagakura, and Eita Nakamura At the same time, Fukusuke Tsuzuki appears out of nowhere and asks why the three are in the woods. Kogoro tells him that the man is dead and asks who he is. Tsuzuki introduces himself as the city’s tourism director, and is about to give his business card to the detective when he urges the director to call the police. Takagi and some forensic officers arrive to handle the case, and are able to identify the victim as investigative reporter Saneo Kurauchi. Conan asks what is the thing sticking on Kurauchi’s shirt, and Ran answers it is a seed of a plant. After a little explanation to Takagi about the recent Stone Age man rumour, he and Kogoro wonder why the victim was here in the first place, to which Conan suggests asking the supermarket cosplayer employee because he saw the cosplayer talking to the victim outside the supermarket before hiking on the trail. Surprisingly, the current cosplayer testifies that he does not know about the victim. At the same time, Iwata walks past the commotion, now having bruised in one of his two eyes. Iwata sees a seed on the cosplayer's costume, so he reminds the man that there is a seed on his body. But the problem is that he did so by pointing at the seed and saying "ba-ka", which no one understands at all. Kogoro wonders why the cosplayer says he did not know the victim, while Conan said he saw the victim did so with him, to which Iwata steps in and asks when did Conan witness the thing. It is then revealed that the man is telling the truth, as he is Kotaro Nagakura–Nagakura supermarket president, while the man Kurauchi talked to was Eita Nakamura. At first, Iwata tries to testify to Nagakura's alibi by saying he… punched him in the eyes due to his clumsiness. Kogoro replies that Nagakura’s action is assault, but tells the two to recreate the scene nonetheless. Behind the supermarket, Nagakura is trying to recreate how he punched his employee in the eye when he accidentally steps on Iwata’s injured foot. Iwata then explains how he got those injuries, including the bruise he currently has. Still, he insists on saying that his boss is not the culprit by mentioning how he never uses physical violence on him, no matter how many times he screwed up. Conan happens to find a blood trail near the backyard, so he follows it. He then asks for Iwata’s permission to see the video. After seeing just the first 15 seconds of the footage, Conan then searches something on the Internet.

title.ja: 狙われたのは誰

summary.en: Two days ago, some of the cyanide in the Teitan University research lab was stolen. In the present, Takagi stumbled upon a person who was holding cyanide, so he had him taken to the police station for interrogation. He then finds Conan and Kogoro walking on the street, so he comes for consultation about this particular case. Takagi mentions that the man kept looking at his watch for some reason, and that the amount of cyanide he was holding is less than the amount stolen from the lab. These two may suggest that the three still have time to prevent someone from consuming the cyanide since the target was absent when the man put the poison. The location is quickly narrowed down to buildings on their south, which is still too broad for them to find the exact target. Conan then asks Takagi for photos of the man, and one of the photos reminds Kogoro of a restaurant 500 meters away from them in the south called Namikawa. This is because the owner of the restaurant sometimes splashes nearby when she sprinkles water in front of the shop. The amount he was keeping, though was less than the stolen amount, is more than enough to kill multiple people, so we can assume the same with the stolen amount.

title.ja: 呪いの隣家

summary.en: Three days ago, Mutsumi Seino suddenly told her husband Daiichiro and her mother-in-law Ura that all of them should move away like what the Sasakis did that morning because Mrs.Sasaki told her that they were fleeing from their cursed house, which both Daiichiro and Ura laughed it off. The next night, Mutsumi told her husband that she was experiencing symptoms often seen in a cold–which she just put all the blame on the curse, and demanded everyone to move away before things could have gotten any worse. Daiichiro decided to peek at the house this morning since he was worried about his wife’s behavior. He is doing so when spotted by Conan and Kogoro, who then decide to take on the case when Daiichiro mentions the house is cursed. In Mouri Detective Agency, Daiichiro recounts the situation to Kogoro and Conan, and how rushed Mutsumi was when convincing everyone to move away. Kogoro then calls the Sasakis to ask why they moved–they moved away because of work, and did not mention anything about the rumor. Kogoro then asks Daiichiro if his wife showed any change in her behavior, which he recalls the morning three days before: "When he was watering the plants, Mutsumi went home from shopping. However, she looked dazed while mentioning something five years ago that was not over." Kogoro and Conan discuss the situation again after Daiichiro goes home, and conclude that Mutsumi wanted to move away so that the mistake she made five years ago remained a secret. They choose to go to the Seino residence to talk it out with her about the mistake. Meanwhile, Daiichiro receives information from a hospital that Mutsumi fell down the steps at the Beika Station, so he needs to go see his wife there. He is about to leave when he runs into Kogoro and Conan, who allow him to do so upon hearing the situation. Moments later, Daiichiro and Mutsumi get to the location with a taxi, but the husband leaves to buy the bandages he was supposed to buy on their way home, letting his wife confront Kogoro and Conan alone as they expose her lies. Self-defense? (past) Location: Kazahaya Art Museum Park Victim: Kenji Murakumo Age: 25 years old (five years ago) Time: Five years ago Cause of death: Blunt force trauma on the back of his head Suspects: Mutsumi Seino, and Atsuko Uryu Mutsumi confesses having pushed a man when he tried to grab her five years before. However, news reports on the next day showed that the man had died from a blow on the back of his head. She also ran into Atsuko Uryu when she just started to slip away. Eventually, she confesses the past mistake she made five years ago when she was visiting Kazahaya Art Museum: "She was at the park outside when a drunkard named Kenji Murakumo tried to grab her. She pushed him away, and once she saw him lying unconscious on his side, she slipped away from the scene before running into Atsuko Uryu, who was going in the opposite direction. On the next day, she saw news of Murakumo's death on TV, and was worried since the police could come at any moment to arrest her, which hadn’t happened since." The reason she demanded to move away was that she saw Uryu again one week ago, as Uryu moved in her neighborhood half a month ago, and was afraid that Uryu would report her to the police if the two ran into each other again. The catch is she needed a reason to do so, which was sparked when she saw the Sasakis moving away. Now, she has come up with the decision to turn herself in to the police. Just then, Conan asks how she got injured, and she recalls that she was pushed by someone from behind. Moreover, she presents the letter she found in the family mailbox, which she believes to be the punishment she deserved for lying. Location: Beika Station Victim: Mutsumi Seino Method: Pushing from the top of the steps Suspects: Mutsumi Seino At first, Conan suspects Mutsumi for faking her accident. However, it turns out that someone pushed her. Moments after Mutsumi leaves the park, Kogoro and Conan decide to look into the case five years ago to see if it can help with the bizarre letter. The two arrive at Kazahaya city police department where Kogoro meets Hitoshi Yukigaya, a police detective he worked with in a robbery case during his time on the force. They learn from the police perspective that the people who reported the body to the police were, in fact, an elderly couple. The case was tough because they didn’t get a single tip about any suspicious people in the area, thus Mutsumi never came up in the investigation. Moreover, the case went unsolved with the direction that Murakumo was killed by someone who had a grudge on him because they found nothing conclusive on the possible suspects.

title.ja: 鳥人間コンテスト爆破事件（前編）
title.zhHans: 鸟人大赛爆炸事件（前篇）
title.zhHant: 鳥人大賽爆炸事件（上集）

summary.en: Kogoro took his kids to the Birdman Rally held at Hikone, where Beika University will be participating in the manual division for the first time in ten years. Heiji also took Kazuha there as they never miss this yearly event. Two of the Beika University members come to say hi to Kogoro–Aero Quest airframe designer Yuma Masaki, and Aero Quest pilot Sho Ishizumi. The event kicks off as Beika University members are making final adjustments to the Aero Quest, while Yuma has to get something he left on the school bus–where he gets knocked out, dragged away, and shoved in a vehicle. Moments later, Ran and Kazuha spot Yuma’s younger sister Rin looking for him, so they decide to search for him. Eventually, the tablet Yuma never goes without is found under the school bus, to which Conan and Heiji also find the traces left from the kidnapping. Rin has to leave early because it’s almost Aero Quest’s turn to compete; and Conan entrusts her with one of his detective badges, saying it was a lucky charm for Ishizumi. At the end of the kidnapping traces is an empty slot of the parking lot, so while Ran and Kazuha return to their seats, Heiji and Conan inquire the security guard about the car that used to park at the said slot. The guard recognizes the vehicle, and remembers a valuable detail about its driver: A young man wearing a bracelet engraved with the word “shita”–reminding Conan of a serial robber gang.

title.ja: 目撃者、毛利蘭

summary.en: Ran was approached by Junta Misato, who somehow convinced her to have a hairdress at his workplace. Ran also texts Shinichi about the hairstyle she should change into. Coincidentally, when Misato pointed her to the building he worked at, both of them saw someone/something collapsing inside the third floor of the said building. Location: System Development Company "Butterfee" office, third floor of a building Victim: Sayaka Ishii Cause of death: Strangulation Suspects: Junta Misato, Kazuhiko Chozuka, and Nako Muto Ran was waiting at a station when Misato reached out to her about hairdressing stuff. When Misato pointed to the location he worked at, both he and Ran saw someone/something collapsing down from the third floor of the said building. Ran and Misato arrived at the complex to check what happened, with Misato finding Sayaka Ishii dead on the third floor of the building. Coincidentally, Kazuhiko Chozuka came out, unbeknownst to what had just happened. Takagi and Megure come to investigate while Chiba goes to ask the people nearby. Ran also informs Shinichi about the case when he is still struggling to find her a hairstyle he wants for her. Conan runs to the building and says Shinichi told him to check on her since Shinichi was busy. Chozuka recounts that before he saw Misato and the body, he went to the company to address his work, took some coffee in the fridge, watered the plants, and fell asleep inside the toilet–which he believes to be due to his heavy workload he has been carrying recently. In addition, he also reveals why he fired Ishii: Ishii rooted an idea of a new service, but was consumed with greed. The episode shows only one person Chiba talks to during his work, and the person is Nako Muto, a used clothing shop manager.

title.ja: 茜色の千秋楽（初日）
title.zhHans: 茜红色的最终日（首演日）

summary.en: Once upon a time in Kyoto, a detective play about Heiji and Kogoro was set to be produced, featuring big names in the acting industry such as Osamu Kenzaki, Hyouga Koumoto, and Ninka Gyouda. During the writing process though, an affair between Gyouda and Reisuke Inaba (who was married) caused irreversible damage to the production staff, to the point that the play should have been cancelled. It ended up getting more attention, and the replacement staff were paid a ridiculous amount of money to finish the script. The Mouri family, Heiji, and Kazuha (who is currently wearing a facemask due to sickness) are at Naniwa Art Theater, Osaka to see that heavily altered detective play. Once the play is over, the group comes to the dressing room to visit Kenzaki and Koumoto. From there, we learn that Kenzaki is now engaged with fellow actress Yuki Takeno after she proposed to him on the observation deck of Naniwa Harukas on a glowing sunset evening. The scenery has since become a famous spot for love proposals. Heiji’s expressions show that he wants to confess his feelings to Kazuha, but he also gets nervous due to previous failed attempts. Kogoro finds it strange because Momiji, the model of Heiichi’s fiancée Kadeo Ootsuka, is not present in the theater. Koumoto and Kenzaki explain that she had to go for a Karuta match, even though she wanted to join in. More actors from the play appear in the dressing room: Toshikata Yoshiura introduces to Kogoro that he is Kenzaki’s stand-in just in case he couldn’t appear in the play due to schedule. The two actresses going with Yoshiura are Youka Kuraishi and Miku Narasawa. Kuraishi takes the role of Heiichi’s fiancée Kaede Ootsuka, while Narasawa does so with Ootsuka’s rival Ochiba Toyama–who is obviously modeled after Kazuha. Narasawa asks Kazuha if her performance was good. Kazuha reluctantly says yes, but Ayari Kakiwaki comes in and says it just showed how frustrated Narasawa was when she wasn’t assigned with the role of Kaede. Kakiwaki was the one behind Rieko Mouri–who was modeled after Eri Kisaki. The last two are Nobuya Nagakubo and Tenma Anzaka. Nagakubo takes the role of Suruga Iori–modeled after Momiji’s butler Muga Iori, while Tenma is Koumoto’s stand-in just like Kenzaki’s case. Tenma reveals that he just wants to get over with his final performance as the play was deemed to be cursed. He explains that after the script was finished by the replacement staff, the scriptwriter caught a fever while the director got caught in an accident. Tenma also reveals how Kabumoto behaved previously to the cast, thus earning him the nickname "the fiendish puppeteer". Kogoro’s group then leaves the room. The men comment they have just witnessed the dark side of the acting industry while Ran asks Kazuha what surprise she has been keeping for her. Suddenly, they hear a strange sound outside the building, followed by sounds of people talking about someone who died from falling. Heiji and Conan have to go down to the location since their views are blocked by a curious crowd. Once they get inside the crowd, they find Narasawa hit her head too hard on the ground, posing herself like a puppet. In addition, a cellphone is seen falling down to her place, which displays a message stating they are the fiendish puppeteer. Location: Naniwa Art Theater, Kyoto Prefecture Victim: Miku Narasawa Cause of death: Blunt force trauma by falling Suspects: Toshikata Yoshiura, Youka Kuraishi, Ayari Kakiwaki, Nobuya Nagakubo, and Tenma Anzaka Narasawa’s detective play colleagues also come to confirm if the person who fell down was her or not, with Tenma loudly asking if she actually jumped off from the building. Before his colleagues can ask why he said so, Heiji asks who this cell phone belongs to. Kuraishi finds it similar to Narasawa’s, and Tenma asks if it has something written, to which Conan shows the words on the screen. Kuraishi becomes shocked and faints, while Kakiwaki watches her with a smile. The incident impacted the cast of the play, as redistribution of roles is required and rehearsals have to be carried out afterward. Therefore, they insisted on having the interrogation made inside the theater troupe building. Kogoro’s group also has to go with Inspector Otaki to verify the suspects’ statement since they were the only ones to meet the main cast after the play. The interrogation happens in the following order: Tenma becomes the first since Kogoro’s group saw Narasawa trying to go with him. He explains she did so because she had a crush on him and wanted to confess her feelings to him at Naniwa Harukas. Tenma was then in the restroom as a way to shake her off, and did not meet her until the scene. Otaki asks him who might have something against her, and he mentions Kuraishi since Narasawa repeatedly teased her Kyoto dialect. One notable thing is that Otaki and Tenma seem to have met previously. Kuraishi admits her Kyoto dialect speaking was helped by Kabumoto, whose curse she thought to be affecting her next when she saw the message. Notably, she denies Kogoro’s accusation in panic when he suggests there had to be something else between her and the victim. Otaki also asks whom she finds to have something against the victim, and she mentions Kakiwaki since both did not get along well despite being from the same agency. Kakiwaki objects what Kuraishi thinks of her since she and Narasawa were just rivals. She mentions it was herself who revealed to her about the weakness of her love rival, whom she does not reveal in full detail and says the police should do it instead. She suggests Nagakubo as a suspect because his attempts to hit on Narasawa were all rejected. Nagakubo denies the accusation and believes his attempts would eventually catch her attention, to which Ran and Kazuha view as creep. Otaki asks if he was the one calling the police. He explains the reason he did so was because he felt Tenma had been in the scene prior but acted as if he just came with the others. However, Heiji points out Tenma’s alibi that he did not mention, suggesting he was unlikely to be the murderer. Yoshiura then catches strays because Nagakubo remembers how he seemed to be predicting things in a previous conversation. However, Yoshiura is nowhere to be seen in the interrogation room. A police officer in the room explains he has been in the toilet because he ate something that upsetted his stomach in the morning, so the only option is to interrogate him in the restroom. Nothing worth bothering here, let’s just return to the rehearsal room! Among the people in the rehearsal room, all suspects beside Kuraishi are not present. This is because Nagakubo went outside to buy cigarettes, Kakiwaki went out for a phone call, and Tenma took a nap 30 minutes ago (we just interrogate Yoshiura just now, let him alone in the toilet!). Coincidentally, now it’s the time for her to wake him up, so she goes to his room to do so, with Heiji and Conan tagging along. Not long after they reach the room and fail to wake him up, a scream can be heard outside the room, so they go to the balcony and find Kakiwaki dead in the parking lot. Location: Theater troupe building Victim: Ayari Kakiwaki Cause of death: Blunt force trauma by falling Suspects: Toshikata Yoshiura, Youka Kuraishi, Nobuya Nagakubo, and Tenma Anzaka The Penultimate Show The two detectives rush to the parking lot along with Kogoro and Otaki. Kakiwaki’s death shares similarities to Narasawa’s since her pose resembles that of a puppet while a message is found in her phone, stating there are two more left. Another round of interrogation is carried out: The puppet poses of the victims remind all suspects of the semaphore symbols board that Kabumoto made Tenma and Kuraishi remember for a previous play, while the others didn’t have to remember. Aznaka, after having his alibi proven to be legitimate, volunteers to take the symbols board while Nagakubo continues his interrogation. After his alibi is also proven to be legitimate, he asks for permission to smoke in the balcony of this room. Yoshiura’s second interrogation is ignored since it is just his stomach acting up, while Kuraishi’s interrogation did not go out well because she fainted again upon seeing pictures of murder scenes. She was then taken to the rehearsal room by Ran and Kazuha. Once she woke up, the two went out to fetch some drinks for her, but she silently went out the other way while reassuring her colleagues that she would like to pick on her own. Location: Theater troupe building Victim: Youka Kuraishi Modus operandi: Jumping off from a building Desperate because of recent deaths, she decides to commit suicide so that no more of her colleagues is in danger. It turns out that she intends to commit suicide without anyone acknowledging, desperate because of the recent deaths. Ran and Kazuha are able to reach her before she can jump off of the building, though the atmosphere is cut off completely when Nagakubo falls to his death. From the semaphore symbol board Tenma gets, everyone begins identifying the letters the victims resemble – Narasawa displays an E; Kakiwaki displays an V; and Nagakubo displays an I. Location: Theater troupe building Victim: Nobuya Nagakubo Cause of death: Blunt force trauma by falling Suspects: Toshikata Yoshiura, Youka Kuraishi, and Tenma Anzaka Galium is found on the railing. Ginsiro Toyama arrives at the scene and scolds Otaki for letting two murders occur during his investigation. He demands to have two officers guard the remaining suspects, and warns Otaki that Heizo Hattori will beat him beyond recognition if he lets another murder occur. Notably, before warning Otaki, Ginsiro also mentions someone shouldn’t have been here at all, to which Tenma reacts harshly while Otaki says the former’s case was legitimate self-defense. Meanwhile, the message from Nagakubo’s phone displays non-straightforward meaning – from below; Conan and Heiji notice the aluminum railing on the ground has signs of liquid gallium, surprising Otaki as he remembers having someone clean the room pre-interrogation stage. Otaki then reveals about Tenma’s self-defense to the duo when asked: “It happened eight years ago when Tenma was put on trial for excessive self-defense, with the accusers being accomplices of the thugs who died from head trauma. In court, Toshikata Yoshiura came as the witness with the footage he recorded from the altercation. The footage showed that Tenma was trying to defend a girl from being forcibly taken by the deceased thug and his accomplice – a girl named Youka Kuraishi who just transferred to Osaka not long ago. Therefore, Tenma’s self-defense was not excessive at all. In the end, Yoshiura invited both of them to Tokyo to keep them away from the remaining thugs.” Victim: Thug gang leader Cause of death: A blow in front of his head Culprit: Tenma Anzaka Yoshiura was walking when he saw Anzaka fight a thug gang, so he recorded with his cellphone. The footage helped in proving Anzaka's innocence, as even though his action led to the death of the gang leader, it showed that he did so when trying to protect Kuraishi from being taken away by the gang. Coincidentally, the police found a picture of an article about the past case on Narasawa's phone, so there is likely to be a connection between it and the current one. Kogoro tells Otaki to join the interrogation while Heiji and Conan don’t have to do so, still, Conan gives Otaki one of his detective badges so that he and Heiji can eavesdrop the whole interrogation. The interrogation does not show anything useful, so the duo go around the building. In the corridor where they can see certificates inside picture frames, they notice a strange gap. Two employees of the theater group explain it belongs to a certificate that has been missing since this morning, with the tablet it was saved on also missing. Just then, another employee comes to inform the others about Tenma’s mother, as she claims her son had an alibi at the time Narasawa died, so the two reach out to her at the back entrance. It is revealed that Narasawa fell at the same time she and Tenma took pictures together, however, she was told by her son not to share the pictures to anybody after he checked on the body. She also mentions Tenma is having a terminal illness, which only Yoshiura was the other to learn about. Suddenly, Conan and Heiji are able to figure out the truth.

title.ja: 茜色の千秋楽（前楽）
title.zhHans: 茜红色的最终日（压轴日）
title.en: The Crimson Closing Day (The Penultimate Show)

The footage showed that Tenma was trying to defend a girl from being forcibly taken by the deceased thug and his accomplice – a girl named Youka Kuraishi who just transferred to Osaka not long ago. In the end, Yoshiura invited both of them to Tokyo to keep them away from the remaining thugs.” Victim: Thug gang leader Cause of death: A blow in front of his head Culprit: Tenma Anzaka Yoshiura was walking when he saw Anzaka fight a thug gang, so he recorded with his cellphone. summary.en: Once upon a time in Kyoto, a detective play about Heiji and Kogoro was set to be produced, featuring big names in the acting industry such as Osamu Kenzaki, Hyouga Koumoto, and Ninka Gyouda. During the writing process though, an affair between Gyouda and Reisuke Inaba (who was married) caused irreversible damage to the production staff, to the point that the play should have been cancelled. It ended up getting more attention, and the replacement staff were paid a ridiculous amount of money to finish the script. The Mouri family, Heiji, and Kazuha (who is currently wearing a facemask due to sickness) are at Naniwa Art Theater, Osaka to see that heavily altered detective play. Once the play is over, the group comes to the dressing room to visit Kenzaki and Koumoto. From there, we learn that Kenzaki is now engaged with fellow actress Yuki Takeno after she proposed to him on the observation deck of Naniwa Harukas on a glowing sunset evening. The scenery has since become a famous spot for love proposals. Heiji’s expressions show that he wants to confess his feelings to Kazuha, but he also gets nervous due to previous failed attempts. Kogoro finds it strange because Momiji, the model of Heiichi’s fiancée Kadeo Ootsuka, is not present in the theater. Koumoto and Kenzaki explain that she had to go for a Karuta match, even though she wanted to join in. More actors from the play appear in the dressing room: Toshikata Yoshiura introduces to Kogoro that he is Kenzaki’s stand-in just in case he couldn’t appear in the play due to schedule. The two actresses going with Yoshiura are Youka Kuraishi and Miku Narasawa. Kuraishi takes the role of Heiichi’s fiancée Kaede Ootsuka, while Narasawa does so with Ootsuka’s rival Ochiba Toyama–who is obviously modeled after Kazuha. Narasawa asks Kazuha if her performance was good. Kazuha reluctantly says yes, but Ayari Kakiwaki comes in and says it just showed how frustrated Narasawa was when she wasn’t assigned with the role of Kaede. Kakiwaki was the one behind Rieko Mouri–who was modeled after Eri Kisaki. The last two are Nobuya Nagakubo and Tenma Anzaka. Nagakubo takes the role of Suruga Iori–modeled after Momiji’s butler Muga Iori, while Tenma is Koumoto’s stand-in just like Kenzaki’s case. Tenma reveals that he just wants to get over with his final performance as the play was deemed to be cursed. He explains that after the script was finished by the replacement staff, the scriptwriter caught a fever while the director got caught in an accident. Tenma also reveals how Kabumoto behaved previously to the cast, thus earning him the nickname "the fiendish puppeteer". Kogoro’s group then leaves the room. The men comment they have just witnessed the dark side of the acting industry while Ran asks Kazuha what surprise she has been keeping for her. Suddenly, they hear a strange sound outside the building, followed by sounds of people talking about someone who died from falling. Heiji and Conan have to go down to the location since their views are blocked by a curious crowd. Once they get inside the crowd, they find Narasawa hit her head too hard on the ground, posing herself like a puppet. In addition, a cellphone is seen falling down to her place, which displays a message stating they are the fiendish puppeteer. Before his colleagues can ask why he said so, Heiji asks who this cell phone belongs to. Kuraishi finds it similar to Narasawa’s, and Tenma asks if it has something written, to which Conan shows the words on the screen. Kuraishi becomes shocked and faints, while Kakiwaki watches her with a smile. The incident impacted the cast of the play, as redistribution of roles is required and rehearsals have to be carried out afterward. Therefore, they insisted on having the interrogation made inside the theater troupe building. Kogoro’s group also has to go with Inspector Otaki to verify the suspects’ statement since they were the only ones to meet the main cast after the play. The interrogation happens in the following order: Tenma becomes the first since Kogoro’s group saw Narasawa trying to go with him. He explains she did so because she had a crush on him and wanted to confess her feelings to him at Naniwa Harukas. Tenma was then in the restroom as a way to shake her off, and did not meet her until the scene. Otaki asks him who might have something against her, and he mentions Kuraishi since Narasawa repeatedly teased her Kyoto dialect. One notable thing is that Otaki and Tenma seem to have met previously. Kuraishi admits her Kyoto dialect speaking was helped by Kabumoto, whose curse she thought to be affecting her next when she saw the message. Notably, she denies Kogoro’s accusation in panic when he suggests there had to be something else between her and the victim. Otaki also asks whom she finds to have something against the victim, and she mentions Kakiwaki since both did not get along well despite being from the same agency. Kakiwaki objects what Kuraishi thinks of her since she and Narasawa were just rivals. She mentions it was herself who revealed to her about the weakness of her love rival, whom she does not reveal in full detail and says the police should do it instead. She suggests Nagakubo as a suspect because his attempts to hit on Narasawa were all rejected. Nagakubo denies the accusation and believes his attempts would eventually catch her attention, to which Ran and Kazuha view as creep. Otaki asks if he was the one calling the police. He explains the reason he did so was because he felt Tenma had been in the scene prior but acted as if he just came with the others. However, Heiji points out Tenma’s alibi that he did not mention, suggesting he was unlikely to be the murderer. Yoshiura then catches strays because Nagakubo remembers how he seemed to be predicting things in a previous conversation. However, Yoshiura is nowhere to be seen in the interrogation room. A police officer in the room explains he has been in the toilet because he ate something that upsetted his stomach in the morning, so the only option is to interrogate him in the restroom. Nothing worth bothering here, let’s just return to the rehearsal room! Among the people in the rehearsal room, all suspects beside Kuraishi are not present. This is because Nagakubo went outside to buy cigarettes, Kakiwaki went out for a phone call, and Tenma took a nap 30 minutes ago (we just interrogate Yoshiura just now, let him alone in the toilet!). Coincidentally, now it’s the time for her to wake him up, so she goes to his room to do so, with Heiji and Conan tagging along. Not long after they reach the room and fail to wake him up, a scream can be heard outside the room, so they go to the balcony and find Kakiwaki dead in the parking lot. Location: Theater troupe building Victim: Ayari Kakiwaki Cause of death: Blunt force trauma by falling Suspects: Toshikata Yoshiura, Youka Kuraishi, Nobuya Nagakubo, and Tenma Anzaka The Penultimate Show The two detectives rush to the parking lot along with Kogoro and Otaki. Kakiwaki’s death shares similarities to Narasawa’s since her pose resembles that of a puppet while a message is found in her phone, stating there are two more left. Another round of interrogation is carried out: The puppet poses of the victims remind all suspects of the semaphore symbols board that Kabumoto made Tenma and Kuraishi remember for a previous play, while the others didn’t have to remember. Aznaka, after having his alibi proven to be legitimate, volunteers to take the symbols board while Nagakubo continues his interrogation. After his alibi is also proven to be legitimate, he asks for permission to smoke in the balcony of this room. Yoshiura’s second interrogation is ignored since it is just his stomach acting up, while Kuraishi’s interrogation did not go out well because she fainted again upon seeing pictures of murder scenes. She was then taken to the rehearsal room by Ran and Kazuha. Once she woke up, the two went out to fetch some drinks for her, but she silently went out the other way while reassuring her colleagues that she would like to pick on her own. Location: Theater troupe building Victim: Youka Kuraishi Modus operandi: Jumping off from a building Desperate because of recent deaths, she decides to commit suicide so that no more of her colleagues is in danger. It turns out that she intends to commit suicide without anyone acknowledging, desperate because of the recent deaths. Ran and Kazuha are able to reach her before she can jump off of the building, though the atmosphere is cut off completely when Nagakubo falls to his death. From the semaphore symbol board Tenma gets, everyone begins identifying the letters the victims resemble – Narasawa displays an E; Kakiwaki displays an V; and Nagakubo displays an I. Location: Theater troupe building Victim: Nobuya Nagakubo Cause of death: Blunt force trauma by falling Suspects: Toshikata Yoshiura, Youka Kuraishi, and Tenma Anzaka Galium is found on the railing. Ginsiro Toyama arrives at the scene and scolds Otaki for letting two murders occur during his investigation. He demands to have two officers guard the remaining suspects, and warns Otaki that Heizo Hattori will beat him beyond recognition if he lets another murder occur. Notably, before warning Otaki, Ginsiro also mentions someone shouldn’t have been here at all, to which Tenma reacts harshly while Otaki says the former’s case was legitimate self-defense. Meanwhile, the message from Nagakubo’s phone displays non-straightforward meaning – from below; Conan and Heiji notice the aluminum railing on the ground has signs of liquid gallium, surprising Otaki as he remembers having someone clean the room pre-interrogation stage.
